summary.en: Hash Table (Chaining) is a ds algorithm.

summary.zh: 二叉堆属于ds类别。
summary.en: Binary Heap is a ds algorithm.

complexity.time: O(log n) 插入/弹出，O(n) 建堆

summary.zh: KD树属于ds类别。
summary.en: KD-Tree is a ds algorithm.

summary.zh: 左偏树属于ds类别。
summary.en: Leftist Heap is a ds algorithm.

summary.zh: LFU缓存属于ds类别。
summary.en: LFU Cache is a ds algorithm.

summary.zh: 单链表属于ds类别。
summary.en: Singly Linked List is a ds algorithm.

complexity.time: O(1) 头插 / O(n) 查找

summary.zh: 链表栈属于ds类别。
summary.en: Linked List Stack is a ds algorithm.

summary.zh: LRU缓存属于ds类别。
summary.en: LRU Cache is a ds algorithm.

summary.zh: 莫队算法属于ds类别。
summary.en: Mo is a ds algorithm.

summary.zh: 单调队列属于ds类别。
summary.en: Monotonic Queue is a ds algorithm.

summary.zh: 单调栈属于ds类别。
summary.en: Monotonic Stack is a ds algorithm.

summary.zh: 八叉树属于ds类别。
summary.en: Octree is a ds algorithm.

summary.zh: 配对堆属于ds类别。
summary.en: Pairing Heap is a ds algorithm.

summary.zh: 用持久化双栈表示队列，每次操作返回新版本、旧版本不变。
summary.en: A queue represented by two persistent stacks; each op returns a new version, leaving old ones intact.

summary.zh: 可持久化线段树属于ds类别。
summary.en: Persistent Segment Tree is a ds algorithm.

summary.zh: 优先队列属于ds类别。
summary.en: Priority Queue is a ds algorithm.

summary.zh: 四叉树属于ds类别。
summary.en: Quad Tree is a ds algorithm.

summary.zh: 数组队列属于ds类别。
summary.en: Queue (Array) is a ds algorithm.

complexity.time: O(1) 入队 / O(n) 出队

summary.zh: 链式队列属于ds类别。
summary.en: Queue (Linked) is a ds algorithm.

complexity.time: O(1) 入队 / O(1) 出队

summary.zh: R树属于ds类别。
summary.en: R-Tree is a ds algorithm.

summary.zh: 环形缓冲区属于ds类别。
summary.en: Ring Buffer is a ds algorithm.

summary.zh: 尺寸平衡树属于ds类别。
summary.en: Size Balanced Tree is a ds algorithm.

summary.zh: 替罪羊树属于ds类别。
summary.en: Scapegoat Tree is a ds algorithm.

summary.zh: 线段树属于ds类别。
summary.en: Segment Tree is a ds algorithm.

complexity.time: O(log n) 查询/更新，O(n) 建树

summary.zh: 跳表属于ds类别。
summary.en: Skip List is a ds algorithm.

summary.zh: 伸展树属于ds类别。
summary.en: Splay Tree is a ds algorithm.

summary.zh: 数组栈属于ds类别。
summary.en: Stack (Array) is a ds algorithm.

summary.zh: 后缀树属于ds类别。
summary.en: Suffix Tree is a ds algorithm.

summary.zh: 树堆属于ds类别。
summary.en: Treap is a ds algorithm.

summary.zh: 旋转式 Treap：BST 按键、堆按随机优先级，插入删除用旋转维护。
summary.en: A rotation-based Treap: BST by key, heap by random priority, maintained via rotations.

summary.zh: 字典树属于ds类别。
summary.en: Trie is a ds algorithm.

complexity.time: O(L) 插入/查找，L = 键长

summary.zh: 压缩字典树 Radix Tree属于ds类别。
summary.en: Radix Tree (Compressed Trie) is a ds algorithm.

summary.zh: 并查集属于ds类别。
summary.en: Union-Find (DSU) is a ds algorithm.

summary.zh: 按秩并查集属于ds类别。
summary.en: Union-Find by Rank is a ds algorithm.

summary.zh: vEB树属于ds类别。
summary.en: van Emde Boas Tree is a ds algorithm.

summary.zh: 两数相加（链表）属于list类别。
summary.en: Add Two Numbers (Linked List) is a list algorithm.

title.zh: 两数相加 II（正向存储）

summary.zh: 两条链表正向存储整数，相加返回正向存储的和链表。
summary.en: Two lists store integers most-significant-first; add them and return the sum in the same order.

summary.zh: 递归 + 哈希记忆化深拷贝带任意 next 结构的链表，处理环与重入。
summary.en: Recursively deep-copies a list with arbitrary linkage via a memoized hash map, handling cycles.

title.zh: 复制带随机指针的链表

summary.zh: 复制带随机指针的链表属于list类别。
summary.en: Copy List with Random Pointer is a list algorithm.

title.zh: 删除排序链表重复元素

summary.zh: 删除排序链表重复元素属于list类别。
summary.en: Remove Duplicates from Sorted List is a list algorithm.

title.zh: 删除排序链表重复元素 II

summary.zh: 删除排序链表重复元素 II属于list类别。
summary.en: Remove Duplicates II is a list algorithm.

summary.zh: 环入口属于list类别。
summary.en: Cycle Start is a list algorithm.

summary.zh: 展平多级链表属于list类别。
summary.en: Flatten Multilevel Doubly Linked List is a list algorithm.

summary.zh: Floyd 环检测属于list类别。
summary.en: Floyd is a list algorithm.

summary.zh: 链表相交属于list类别。
summary.en: Intersection of Two Linked Lists is a list algorithm.

summary.zh: 判断链表有环属于list类别。
summary.en: Linked List Cycle is a list algorithm.

summary.zh: 链表插入排序属于list类别。
summary.en: Insertion Sort List is a list algorithm.

summary.zh: 两个链表的交集属于list类别。
summary.en: Intersection of Two Lists (Set) is a list algorithm.

summary.zh: 两个逆序链表表示的数相加，返回逆序结果链表。
summary.en: Add two numbers represented as reversed lists.

summary.zh: 逆序链表表示的两数逐位相加，进位向前。
summary.en: Add two numbers in reversed-list form digit by digit with carry forward.

summary.zh: 链表每个节点是 0/1，从高位到低位表示二进制数，求十进制值。
summary.en: Each node holds a bit (MSB first); compute the decimal value.

summary.zh: 把链表 b 接到链表 a 的末尾。
summary.en: Append list b to the end of list a.

summary.zh: 线性查找链表是否含某值。
summary.en: Linear search for a value in the list.

title.en: Copy List with Random Pointer v2

summary.zh: 深拷贝每个节点带 next 与 random 指针的链表。
summary.en: Deep-copy a list whose nodes carry next and random pointers.

title.zh: 带随机指针深拷贝（穿插法）
title.en: Copy List with Random Pointer (Weave Variant)

summary.zh: O(1) 空间穿插复制节点再分离，深拷贝带随机指针的链表。
summary.en: O(1) space: weave copied nodes between originals then split to deep-copy random pointers.

summary.zh: 遍历统计链表节点数。
summary.en: Traverse and count nodes.

summary.zh: 快慢指针判环：快走2步、慢走1步，相遇即有环。
summary.en: Floyd tortoise/hare: if they meet, a cycle exists.

summary.zh: 有序链表中如果一个值出现多次，全部删除。
summary.en: In a sorted list, delete every value that appears more than once.

summary.zh: 删除链表第 k 个节点（0-based）。
summary.en: Delete the node at index k (0-based).

summary.zh: 删除有序链表中的重复节点，保留唯一副本。
summary.en: Drop duplicates from a sorted list, keeping one copy each.

summary.zh: 快慢指针定位并删除链表正中节点（LeetCode 2095）。
summary.en: Fast/slow pointers locate and remove the middle node (LeetCode 2095).

summary.zh: 删除链表中所有值等于 x 的节点。
summary.en: Remove all nodes whose value equals x.

summary.zh: Floyd 判环后定位环的入口节点。
summary.en: Locate the cycle entry after Floyd detection.

summary.zh: 双指针求 A − B 的差集。
summary.en: Two-pointer set difference A − B.

summary.zh: 把带 child 指针的多级链表拍平为单级。
summary.en: Flatten a multilevel doubly list with child pointers into one level.

summary.zh: 把带 child 指针的多级双向链表扁平化为单级（LeetCode 430）。
summary.en: Flatten a multilevel doubly linked list into one level (LeetCode 430).

summary.zh: 返回链表第 k 个节点（0-based）的值，越界返回 null。
summary.en: Return value of the kth node (0-based); null if out of range.

summary.zh: 在链表第 k 个位置插入值为 x 的节点。
summary.en: Insert a node with value x at index k.

title.en: Insert into a Sorted Circular List

summary.zh: 将节点插入升序循环链表并保持有序。
summary.en: Insert a node into an ascending circular list keeping it sorted.

summary.zh: 对链表做插入排序。
summary.en: Insertion sort on a linked list.

summary.zh: 双指针走完自身再走对方，相遇即交点。
summary.en: Two pointers swap heads after reaching the end; meet at the intersection.

summary.zh: 双指针求两条升序链表的交集。
summary.en: Two-pointer intersection of two ascending lists.

title.zh: 回文链表（快慢+反转后半）

summary.zh: 快慢指针找中点，反转后半段后与上半段逐一比较。
summary.en: Find midpoint with fast/slow pointers, reverse the second half and compare.

summary.zh: 一次遍历返回倒数第 k 个节点值。
summary.en: Return the kth node from the end in one pass.

summary.zh: 蓄水池抽样从未知长度链表中均匀随机取一个节点（LeetCode 382）。
summary.en: Reservoir sampling picks a uniform random node from a list of unknown length (LeetCode 382).

summary.zh: 遍历链表找最大节点值。
summary.en: Traverse to find the maximum value.

summary.zh: 迭代合并两个升序链表为一个新的升序链表。
summary.en: Iteratively merge two ascending lists into one.

summary.zh: 顺序两两合并 k 个有序链表。
summary.en: Merge k sorted lists by pairwise sequential merge.

title.zh: 合并有序链表（哑节点变种）

summary.zh: 用哑节点逐节点拼接两条升序链表。
summary.en: Merge two ascending lists node-by-node with a dummy head.

summary.zh: 快慢指针一次遍历找链表中点。
summary.en: One-pass middle via fast/slow pointers.

summary.zh: 快慢指针一次找到链表中间节点。
summary.en: Fast and slow pointers find the middle node in one pass.

summary.zh: 把奇数位节点放前、偶数位节点放后，保持相对顺序。
summary.en: Group odd-indexed nodes before even-indexed nodes.

summary.zh: 快慢指针找中点后反转后半段比较判断回文。
summary.en: Check palindrome by reversing the second half and comparing.

summary.zh: 把小于 x 的节点移到前面，保持相对顺序。
summary.en: Move nodes smaller than x to the front, preserving order.

summary.zh: 按基准值把链表拆成小于/大于等于两段再拼接。
summary.en: Split a list into less-than and greater-than-or-equal sublists, then concatenate.

summary.zh: 删除链表中所有等于给定值的节点。
summary.en: Delete all nodes whose value equals the given target.

summary.zh: 一次遍历删除倒数第 n 个节点。
summary.en: Remove the nth node from end in one pass.

summary.zh: 把 L0→L1→...→Ln 重排为 L0→Ln→L1→Ln-1→...。
summary.en: Reorder L0,L1,...,Ln as L0,Ln,L1,Ln-1,...

summary.zh: 用三指针迭代原地反转单链表。
summary.en: Reverse a singly linked list iteratively with three pointers.

summary.zh: 每 k 个一组，但只反转偶数序的组。
summary.en: Reverse every other group of k nodes.

summary.zh: 每 k 个节点一组反转；不足 k 个保持原序。
summary.en: Reverse in groups of k; leave the last partial group as-is.

summary.zh: 反转链表中从位置 left 到 right 的一段。
summary.en: Reverse the sublist between positions left and right (1-based).

summary.zh: 反转链表第 m 到第 n 个节点（1-based）。
summary.en: Reverse nodes from position m to n (1-based).

summary.zh: 把链表向右旋转 k 位。
summary.en: Rotate the list to the right by k positions.

summary.zh: 将链表向左旋转 k 位。
summary.en: Rotate the list left by k positions.

summary.zh: 把链表向左旋转 k 位。
summary.en: Rotate the list left by k positions.

summary.zh: 将链表首尾相连成环，在断点处切开实现右旋。
summary.en: Close the list into a ring and cut at the break point to rotate right.

summary.zh: 相邻节点比较并在需要时交换数值。
summary.en: Compare adjacent nodes and swap values when out of order.

summary.zh: 对链表做冒泡排序（交换值）。
summary.en: Bubble sort a linked list by swapping values.

summary.zh: 逐节点摘下并插入到已排序哑链表中的正确位置。
summary.en: Detach each node and insert it into the sorted dummy list at the right place.

summary.zh: 对链表做归并排序（O(n log n) 时间 O(1) 空间）。
summary.en: Merge sort a linked list in O(n log n), O(1).

summary.zh: 以头节点为基准三路划分后递归排序。
summary.en: Three-way partition around the head pivot then recursively sort.

summary.zh: 每轮在剩余段中找最小值并与当前位置交换。
summary.en: Each round find the minimum in the remaining sublist and swap into place.

summary.zh: 对链表做选择排序（交换值）。
summary.en: Selection sort a linked list by swapping values.

summary.zh: 求 A - B（A 中不在 B 的元素）。
summary.en: Set difference A minus B for sorted lists.

summary.zh: 求两个有序链表的交集（共同元素）。
summary.en: Intersection of two sorted lists.

summary.zh: 求两个有序链表的并集（去重）。
summary.en: Union of two sorted lists, dedup.

summary.zh: 把链表按值 x 拆成 <x 与 >=x 两段（返回两个头）。
summary.en: Split a list into two (<x and >=x) by a pivot value.

summary.zh: 以 pivot 为界将链表一分为二。
summary.en: Split a list into two parts by a pivot value.

summary.zh: 遍历链表求所有节点值之和。
summary.en: Sum all node values.

summary.zh: 相邻节点两两交换：A→B→C→D → B→A→D→C。
summary.en: Swap every two adjacent nodes.

summary.zh: 哑节点法两两交换链表中相邻节点。
summary.en: Swap every two adjacent nodes using a dummy head.

summary.zh: 交换链表正数第 k 个与倒数第 k 个节点的值。
summary.en: Swap values of the kth node from head and kth from end.

summary.zh: 把链表拍平成数组。
summary.en: Flatten a linked list into an array.

summary.zh: 双指针归并两条升序链表为去重并集。
summary.en: Two-pointer merge into a deduplicated ascending union.

summary.zh: 把两链表交替合并：a1,b1,a2,b2,...。
summary.en: Interleave two lists: a1,b1,a2,b2,...

title.zh: 合并 K 个有序链表

summary.zh: 合并 K 个有序链表属于list类别。
summary.en: Merge K Sorted Lists is a list algorithm.

summary.zh: 用哑节点 + 双指针逐节点比较，原地重连 next，不新建节点。
summary.en: A dummy node plus two pointers relinks next in place, creating no new nodes.

summary.zh: 合并两个有序链表属于list类别。
summary.en: Merge Two Sorted Lists is a list algorithm.

summary.zh: 链表组件数量属于list类别。
summary.en: Linked List Components is a list algorithm.

summary.zh: 奇偶链表属于list类别。
summary.en: Odd Even Linked List is a list algorithm.

summary.zh: 回文链表属于list类别。
summary.en: Palindrome List is a list algorithm.

summary.zh: 分隔链表属于list类别。
summary.en: Partition List is a list algorithm.

summary.zh: 删除倒数第 N属于list类别。
summary.en: Remove Nth From End is a list algorithm.

summary.zh: 重排链表属于list类别。
summary.en: Reorder List is a list algorithm.

summary.zh: 反转链表 II属于list类别。
summary.en: Reverse Linked List II is a list algorithm.

summary.zh: 反转链表属于list类别。
summary.en: Reverse Linked List is a list algorithm.

summary.zh: 每 k 个节点一组就地反转，不足 k 个的末尾保持原序。
summary.en: Reverses the list in groups of k in place; any trailing group shorter than k is left as-is.

summary.zh: 旋转链表属于list类别。
summary.en: Rotate List is a list algorithm.

summary.zh: 链表排序属于list类别。
summary.en: Sort List is a list algorithm.

summary.zh: 分割链表属于list类别。
summary.en: Split Linked List in Parts is a list algorithm.

summary.zh: 两两交换节点属于list类别。
summary.en: Swap Nodes in Pairs is a list algorithm.

summary.zh: 把相邻两个节点交换并接回前驱，奇数个末尾节点保持不动。
summary.en: Swaps each adjacent pair and re-links to the predecessor; a trailing odd node stays put.

summary.zh: 经典双递归函数：A(m,n)=A(m-1, A(m,n-1))，可计算但非原始递归，增长极快。
summary.en: A classic nested-recursion function: A(m,n)=A(m-1, A(m,n-1)); computable yet not primitive-recursive, grows astronomically.

summary.zh: 用显式栈模拟 Ackermann 递归，避免爆调用栈。
summary.en: Use an explicit stack to simulate Ackermann recursion, avoiding call-stack overflow.

summary.zh: 经典「选/不选」回溯：对每个元素选或不选，生成所有 k 元子集。
summary.en: Classic take/skip backtracking: choose or skip each element to enumerate k-subsets.

summary.zh: 递归入门经典：n! = n × (n-1)!，基线 0! = 1，演示调用栈与回归。
summary.en: A recursion classic: n! = n × (n-1)! with base case 0! = 1; illustrates the call stack and unwinding.

summary.zh: 斐波那契属于recursion类别。
summary.en: Fibonacci is a recursion algorithm.

summary.zh: gcd(a,b) = gcd(b, a mod b)，直至 b=0，递归天然。
summary.en: gcd(a,b) = gcd(b, a mod b) until b = 0; recursion falls out naturally.

summary.zh: 回溯经典：在「右括号数 ≤ 左括号数」约束下枚举所有 n 对合法括号组合。
summary.en: Backtracking classic: enumerate all well-formed combinations of n pairs of parentheses under "close ≤ open" constraint.

summary.zh: 比较首尾字符后递归判定中段，lo ≥ hi 时为真。
summary.en: Compare end chars then recurse on the middle; true when lo >= hi.

title.zh: 第 K 个语法符号（779）

summary.zh: 第 n 行由上一行翻转得到；递归找 k 位与首行第 ceil(k/2) 位的关系。
summary.en: Row n+1 = row n followed by its bitwise complement; recurse via ceil(k/2).

summary.zh: 反直觉的递归函数：M(n)=M(M(n+11))（n≤100），对任意 n≤100 恒返回 91。
summary.en: A counterintuitive recursive function: M(n)=M(M(n+11)) for n≤100 always returns 91 for any n≤100.

summary.zh: isEven 调用 isOdd，isOdd 调用 isEven，两函数互相递归。
summary.en: isEven calls isOdd and vice versa; two functions recurse into each other.

summary.zh: 排列生成属于recursion类别。
summary.en: Permutation Gen is a recursion algorithm.

summary.zh: 分治地算 a^n：偶数次平方、奇数次乘一次，O(log n) 次乘法。
summary.en: Divide-and-conquer a^n: square on even, multiply once on odd; O(log n) multiplications.

summary.zh: 先递归到 1 再回溯打印，或先打印再递归，演示递归顺序。
summary.en: Recurse down to 1 then print on the way back, or print then recurse; demonstrates recursion order.

summary.zh: 用递归求所有元素连乘积：prod(a) = a[0] * prod(a[1..])。
summary.en: Compute the product of all elements recursively: prod(a) = a[0] * prod(a[1..]).

summary.zh: 用分治递归求和：sum(a) = a[0] + sum(a[1..])，演示最朴素的递归思维。
summary.en: Sum via divide-and-conquer recursion: sum(a) = a[0] + sum(a[1..]).

summary.zh: A(m,n)：经典的非原始递归函数，增长极快。基线 A(0,n)=n+1。
summary.en: A(m,n): classic non-primitive-recursive function with explosive growth. Base A(0,n)=n+1.

summary.zh: 用记忆化缓存递归 Ackermann(m,n)，避免重复子问题计算。
summary.en: Memoize the recursive Ackermann(m,n) to avoid recomputing overlapping subproblems.

summary.zh: 递归沿 nums[i] 指针跳转直到回到起点，找最长环，O(n) 时间。
summary.en: Recursively hop along nums[i] pointers until returning to the start to find the longest cycle in O(n).

title.zh: 除自身以外数组的乘积（递归）

summary.zh: 递归前缀积 + 后缀积，O(n) 求每个位置除自身外所有元素的乘积，不用除法。
summary.en: Recursively compute prefix and suffix products to get, in O(n) and without division, each positions product of all other elements.

summary.zh: B(n) = Σ_{k=0}^{n} S(n,k)，n 个元素的划分数总数。
summary.en: B(n) = Σ_{k=0}^{n} S(n,k). Total number of partitions of n elements.

summary.zh: 用帕斯卡递推 C(n,k)=C(n−1,k−1)+C(n−1,k) 递归计算二项式系数。
summary.en: Compute binomial coefficient via Pascal recurrence C(n,k)=C(n−1,k−1)+C(n−1,k).

summary.zh: 递归枚举 C(n,k)：维护已选个数与起始下标，选满 k 个即记录一个组合。
summary.en: Recursively enumerate C(n,k): track chosen count and a start index; record a combination once k are chosen.

summary.zh: 把 n 写成 k 个正整数之和（顺序不同算不同方法）。comp(n,k) = comp(n−1,k−1) + comp(n−k,k)。
summary.en: Write n as sum of k positive integers where order matters. comp(n,k) = comp(n−1,k−1) + comp(n−k,k).

summary.zh: 递归求整数各位数字之和：基线 n<10 返回 n。
summary.en: Recursively sum digits of an integer; base n<10 returns n.

summary.zh: 用累加器把阶乘写成尾递归形式 fact(n, acc)，可被尾调用优化。
summary.en: Rewrite factorial as a tail recursion fact(n, acc) using an accumulator, enabling tail-call optimization.

summary.zh: 带记忆化的递归 fib：用缓存消除重叠子问题，降到 O(n)。
summary.en: Memoized recursive fibonacci: cache eliminates overlapping subproblems, O(n).

summary.zh: 朴素递归 fib(n) = fib(n−1) + fib(n−2)，基线 fib(0)=0, fib(1)=1。
summary.en: Naive recursive fibonacci: fib(n) = fib(n−1) + fib(n−2).

summary.zh: 用双累加器把斐波那契写成尾递归 fib(n,a,b)，O(n) 时间、O(1) 栈空间。
summary.en: Rewrite Fibonacci as a tail recursion fib(n,a,b) with two accumulators: O(n) time, O(1) stack under TCO.

summary.zh: 从起点 DFS 四向扩展，把连通的同色区域改为新颜色。
summary.en: DFS from a start point across 4 neighbors to recolor a connected region of the same color.

summary.zh: 欧几里得算法：gcd(a,b) = gcd(b, a mod b)，基线 gcd(a,0)=a。
summary.en: Euclidean algorithm: gcd(a,b) = gcd(b, a mod b), base gcd(a,0)=a.

summary.zh: 欧几里得算法 gcd(a,b)=gcd(b,a mod b) 本身就是尾递归，天然可被 TCO 优化。
summary.en: The Euclidean algorithm gcd(a,b)=gcd(b,a mod b) is inherently tail-recursive and naturally benefits from TCO.

summary.zh: 递归枚举每个元素的「选/不选」位掩码，生成所有 2^n 个子集。
summary.en: Recursively enumerate a choose/skip bitmask per element to generate all 2^n subsets.

summary.zh: 递归扩展法：从当前位置 start 向后选元素，每层产生一个子集，避免重复。
summary.en: Recursive extension: pick elements forward from a start index; each recursion level yields one subset without duplicates.

title.zh: 最长递增子序列（DFS+记忆化）

summary.zh: DFS 递归 lis(i) = 以 nums[i] 结尾的最长递增子序列长度，配记忆化 O(n²)。
summary.en: DFS recursion lis(i) = length of LIS ending at nums[i], with memoization for O(n²).

summary.zh: lcm(a,b) = a·b / gcd(a,b)，递归求 gcd 后算 lcm。
summary.en: lcm(a,b) = a·b / gcd(a,b); recursively compute gcd then derive lcm.

summary.zh: Trie + DFS：每次只能加一个字母地构造单词，找可由单词字典逐步构建的最长单词。
summary.en: Trie + DFS: build words by adding one letter at a time; find the longest word that can be constructed step-by-step from the dictionary.
M(n) = n−10 (n>100), else M(M(n+11)). Always returns 91 for n≤100.

summary.zh: a mod b：递归从 a 中减 b 直到 a < b。
summary.en: a mod b: recursively subtract b from a until a < b.

summary.zh: 递归实现 a×b = a + a×(b−1)，用加法替代乘法。
summary.en: Recursive multiply: a×b = a + a×(b−1) using addition instead of multiplication.

summary.zh: 递归求嵌套列表的深度权重和：每个整数乘以其所在深度后求和。
summary.en: Recursively compute the depth-weighted sum of a nested list: each integer multiplied by its depth.

title.zh: 嵌套列表权重和 II (反向深度)
title.en: Nested List Weight Sum II (Inverse Depth)

summary.zh: 递归求反向深度权重和：越深的整数权重越大（权重 = 最大深度 - 当前深度 + 1）。
summary.en: Recursively compute the inverse depth-weighted sum: deeper integers get larger weight (weight = maxDepth - depth + 1).

summary.zh: 从两片海域反向 DFS：水只能从高流向低，找能同时流向两海的位置。
summary.en: Reverse DFS from both oceans: water flows high-to-low; find cells that can reach both oceans.

summary.zh: P(n,k) = P(n−1,k−1) + P(n−k,k)。把 n 划分为 k 个正整数之和的方法数。
summary.en: P(n,k) = P(n−1,k−1) + P(n−k,k). Ways to write n as sum of k positive integers.

summary.zh: P(n,k) = n · P(n−1, k−1)。从 n 中选 k 个的有序排列数。
summary.en: P(n,k) = n · P(n−1, k−1). Ordered arrangements of k from n.

summary.zh: Heap 算法：每次只交换两个元素即可生成下一个排列，n! 个排列仅需 n! 次交换。
summary.en: Heaps algorithm: generates each next permutation with a single swap, producing n! permutations in n! swaps.

summary.zh: 二进制拆分指数 + 累加器，使每次递归是尾调用，O(log n)。
summary.en: Binary decomposition of the exponent with an accumulator, each recursive call being a tail call. O(log n).

summary.zh: 递归实现 a^b = a · a^(b−1)，整数幂。
summary.en: Recursive power: a^b = a · a^(b−1) for integer exponent.

summary.zh: S(n,k) = k·S(n−1,k) + S(n−1,k−1)。把 n 个不同元素分成 k 个非空子集的方法数。
summary.en: S(n,k) = k·S(n−1,k) + S(n−1,k−1). Number of ways to partition n distinct elements into k non-empty subsets.

summary.zh: 递归+记忆化统计字符串的不同非空子序列个数，对大数取模。
summary.en: Count distinct non-empty subsequences of a string via recursion with memoization, modulo a large prime.

summary.zh: 子集数：S(n,k) = S(n−1,k−1) + S(n−1,k)。从 n 元素中选大小为 k 的子集。
summary.en: Subset count: S(n,k) = S(n−1,k−1) + S(n−1,k). Subsets of size k from n elements.

summary.zh: 回溯 DFS：逐个空格尝试 1-9，检查行/列/宫约束，失败则回溯。
summary.en: Backtracking DFS: try 1-9 in each empty cell checking row/column/box constraints, backtracking on failure.

summary.zh: 把中间结果作为累加器参数下传，使递归调用成为函数尾调用，便于编译器优化。
summary.en: Thread intermediate results through an accumulator so the recursive call is a tail call, enabling compiler optimization.

complexity.space: O(n) 栈 / O(1) 若 TCO

summary.zh: 经典汉诺塔：T(n)=2·T(n−1)+1，最少 2^n−1 步。
summary.en: Classic Hanoi: T(n)=2·T(n−1)+1, minimum 2^n−1 moves.

summary.zh: 4柱汉诺塔（Reve 难题）：Frame-Stewart 算法，比 2^n−1 更少步数。
summary.en: 4-peg Hanoi (Reve puzzle): Frame-Stewart algorithm uses fewer moves than 2^n−1.

summary.zh: 在字符网格中 DFS 回溯搜索单词：四向扩展，已用格子临时标记防重。
summary.en: Search for a word in a character grid via DFS backtracking: expand in 4 directions, marking used cells to avoid reuse.

summary.zh: 在有序数组中递归折半查找目标，每步把区间减半。
summary.en: Recursively halve the search interval to locate a target in a sorted array.

summary.zh: 空链表返回 0，否则返回 1 + length(rest)。
summary.en: Empty list returns 0; otherwise 1 + length(rest).

summary.zh: 链表为空返回 0，否则返回 head + sum(rest)。
summary.en: Empty list returns 0; otherwise head + sum(rest).

summary.zh: 对每个元素「含/不含」二选一回溯，生成 2^n 个子集。
summary.en: Take/skip backtrack over each element to enumerate all 2^n subsets.

summary.zh: 不用 .length，靠 1 + length(slice(1)) 递归数清字符数。
summary.en: Count characters without .length via 1 + length(slice(1)).

summary.zh: 空树高 0；否则 1 + max(左子高, 右子高)。
summary.en: Empty tree height 0; otherwise 1 + max(left, right subtree heights).

summary.zh: lastChar + reverse(前缀)，或首尾对调；递归深度 O(n)。
summary.en: lastChar + reverse(prefix), or swap ends; recursion depth O(n).

summary.zh: 递归+记忆化经典：到第 n 阶方法数 = ways(n-1)+ways(n-2)，即平移斐波那契。
summary.en: A recursion + memoization classic: ways to reach step n equals ways(n-1)+ways(n-2), a shifted Fibonacci.

title.zh: 递归统计子序列出现次数

summary.zh: 统计 t 作为 s 子序列在 s 中出现的次数（递归双指针）。
summary.en: Count how many times t occurs as a subsequence of s (recursive two-pointer).

summary.zh: 取 n mod 10 得末位 + 递归 n/10，直至 n=0。
summary.en: Take n mod 10 for the last digit plus recursion on n/10, until n = 0.

summary.zh: 二分查找属于searching类别。
summary.en: Binary Search is a searching algorithm.

summary.zh: 在含重复的有序数组中二分找等于 target 的最左下标。
summary.en: Binary search the leftmost index equal to target in a sorted array with duplicates.

summary.zh: 统计出现次数属于searching类别。
summary.en: Count Occurrence is a searching algorithm.

summary.zh: 指数搜索属于searching类别。
summary.en: Exponential Search is a searching algorithm.

title.zh: 指数搜索变体（Galloping / 下界）

summary.zh: 指数搜索变体（Galloping / 下界）属于searching类别。
summary.en: Galloping Search (Lower Bound) is a searching algorithm.

summary.zh: 步长按 2 的幂倍增定位上界，再在 [i/2, i] 内做二分。
summary.en: Doubles the bound by powers of two, then binary-searches the [i/2, i] window.

summary.zh: 分块二分：先在块摘要上二分定位块，再在块内二分。
summary.en: Block binary search: binary search block summaries, then binary search within the block.

summary.zh: 斐波那契搜索属于searching类别。
summary.en: Fibonacci Search is a searching algorithm.

summary.zh: 用斐波那契数划分区间，仅靠加减法逼近目标，无乘除。
summary.en: Splits the range with Fibonacci numbers, approaching the target using only add/subtract.

title.en: Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array

summary.zh: 旋转数组最小值属于searching类别。
summary.en: Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array is a searching algorithm.

summary.zh: 寻找峰值属于searching类别。
summary.en: Find Peak Element is a searching algorithm.

summary.zh: 跳跃查找属于searching类别。
summary.en: Gallop / Exponential Search is a searching algorithm.

summary.zh: 以 2 的幂指数倍增步长飞驰定位候选区间，再在区间内二分。
summary.en: Doubles the step exponentially to gallop into a candidate window, then binary-searches it.

summary.zh: H 指数属于searching类别。
summary.en: H-Index is a searching algorithm.

summary.zh: 插值搜索属于searching类别。
summary.en: Interpolation Search is a searching algorithm.

summary.zh: 按值域线性插值估计位置，迭代逼近目标的有序表搜索。
summary.en: Probe by linear value interpolation, iterate to the target in a sorted table.

summary.zh: 跳跃搜索属于searching类别。
summary.en: Jump Search is a searching algorithm.

summary.zh: 用 ⌊√n⌋ 步长跳跃后线性回扫，最优块大小 √n。
summary.en: Jump by ⌊√n⌋ then linear-scan back; the optimal block size is √n.

title.zh: 第 k 个斐波那契数

summary.zh: 第 k 个斐波那契数属于searching类别。
summary.en: K-th Fibonacci is a searching algorithm.

summary.zh: 线性查找属于searching类别。
summary.en: Linear Search is a searching algorithm.

summary.zh: 元二分查找属于searching类别。
summary.en: Meta Binary Search is a searching algorithm.

summary.zh: 递归地逐位构建答案下标的元二分查找。
summary.en: Recursively build the answer index bit-by-bit.

summary.zh: 用位运算逐位构造目标下标，无需显式中点比较。
summary.en: Builds the target index bit by bit with shift operations, no explicit midpoint.

summary.zh: 峰值下标（山脉数组）属于searching类别。
summary.en: Peak Index in Mountain Array is a searching algorithm.

summary.zh: 二维矩阵搜索属于searching类别。
summary.en: Search a 2D Matrix is a searching algorithm.

summary.zh: 从右上角起，每次比较后向左或向下走，O(m+n)。
summary.en: Start at the top-right; on each comparison move left or down; O(m+n).

summary.zh: 在降序排列的数组上做二分查找，比较方向与升序相反。
summary.en: Binary search on a descending-sorted array, with reversed comparison directions.

summary.zh: 在有重复元素的有序数组中找目标首次出现的位置（lower bound）。
summary.en: Find the first (leftmost) occurrence of the target in a sorted array with duplicates (lower bound).

summary.zh: 在有重复元素的有序数组中找目标最后出现的位置（upper bound - 1）。
summary.en: Find the last (rightmost) occurrence of the target in a sorted array with duplicates.

summary.zh: 标准迭代二分：命中即返回，时间 O(log n)。
summary.en: Standard iterative binary search; return on hit, O(log n).

summary.zh: 在有序数组中用 while 循环折半查找目标值。
summary.en: Iteratively halve a sorted array with a while loop to locate a target value.

summary.zh: 在有序数组中递归地折半查找目标值。
summary.en: Recursively halve a sorted array to locate a target value.

summary.zh: 在升序数组中找目标值最右一次出现的下标，不存在返回 -1。
summary.en: Find the rightmost index of a target in a sorted array; -1 if absent.

summary.zh: 在先增后减的双调数组中 O(log n) 查找目标：先找峰值再两段二分。
summary.en: Search a bitonic (first-increasing then-decreasing) array in O(log n): find the peak then binary-search each side.

summary.zh: 先找双峰数组峰值，再在升序左半与降序右半各二分。
summary.en: Find the bitonic peak, then binary-search the ascending left and descending right halves.

summary.zh: 在升序数组中找最小的 >= target 的元素下标，不存在返回 -1。
summary.en: Find the smallest index with arr[i] >= target in a sorted array; -1 if none.

summary.zh: 用下界与上界二分查找统计有序数组中目标值的出现次数。
summary.en: Count occurrences of a target in a sorted array via lower-bound and upper-bound.

summary.zh: 用上界/下界二分统计升序数组中值落在 [lo,hi] 的元素数。
summary.en: Count elements of a sorted array whose values fall in [lo,hi] via upper/lower bounds.

summary.zh: 在含重复的有序数组中用两次二分定位 target 的出现区间与次数。
summary.en: Locate a target's range and count via two binary searches in a sorted array with duplicates.

summary.zh: 把值当下标成链，用快慢指针找环入口即重复数。
summary.en: Treat values as next-index to form a linked cycle; slow/fast pointers find the entry = duplicate.

summary.zh: 先倍增区间定位边界，再在小区间内二分查找。
summary.en: Find the bounding range by doubling, then binary search within the small range.

summary.zh: 先以 2 的幂扩大搜索范围定位候选段，再在段内二分。
summary.en: Gallop by powers of two to bound a candidate range, then binary-search within it.

summary.zh: 结合跳步定位与二分：先大步粗定位再细二分。
summary.en: Combine stepping and binary search: coarse-locate with big steps, then refine with binary.

summary.zh: 用斐波那契数列划分区间，类似二分但用加法代替除法。
summary.en: Partition the interval using Fibonacci numbers; like binary search but uses addition instead of division.

summary.zh: 用斐波那契数划分区间代替二分，避免除法，适合某些硬件。
summary.en: Partition the range with Fibonacci numbers instead of halving; division-free, suits some hardware.

summary.zh: 查找第一个等于属于searching类别。
summary.en: Find First Occurrence is a searching algorithm.

summary.zh: 二分查找单调布尔数组中第一个 true（坏版本）的位置。
summary.en: Binary search for the first true (bad version) in a monotone boolean array.

summary.zh: 在「前好后坏」的版本序列上二分找第一个坏版本（LeetCode 278）。
summary.en: Binary search the first bad version in a good-then-bad sequence (LeetCode 278).

summary.zh: 升序互异数组中找 i 使 arr[i] == i，二分 O(log n)。
summary.en: Find i with arr[i] == i in a sorted distinct array via binary search, O(log n).

summary.zh: 在升序数组中找最大的 <= target 的元素下标，不存在返回 -1。
summary.en: Find the largest index with arr[i] <= target in a sorted array; -1 if none.

summary.zh: 指数倍增跳跃至越过目标，再二分精确定位，适合大数组前段定位。
summary.en: Exponentially gallop past the target then binary-search the bracket; great for large arrays when the target is near the front.

summary.zh: 指数扩大下标定位块，块内线性回扫；适合目标靠前的有序数据。
summary.en: Exponentially grow the index to bound a block, then linear-scan back; good when the target is near the front.

summary.zh: 排序后线性找最大的 h 使至少 h 篇论文引用 >= h。
summary.en: Sort then linearly find the largest h with at least h papers having >= h citations.

summary.zh: 查找插入位置属于searching类别。
summary.en: Search Insert Position is a searching algorithm.

summary.zh: 找 target 应插入升序数组的位置（保持有序），等价 lower_bound。
summary.en: Find where to insert target to keep a sorted array ordered; equivalent to lower_bound.

summary.zh: 在有序数组中二分找 target 的插入下标并判定是否已存在。
summary.en: Binary search the insertion index for target and report whether it exists.

summary.zh: 根据目标值在区间值的比例估计位置，对均匀分布数据期望 O(log log n)。
summary.en: Estimate probe position from the value ratio; expected O(log log n) for uniformly distributed data.

summary.zh: 按值分布估计位置：pos = lo + (target-a[lo])/(a[hi]-a[hi])*(hi-lo)。
summary.en: Estimate position by value distribution: pos = lo + (target-a[lo])/(a[hi]-a[lo])*(hi-lo).

summary.zh: 双指针扫描两个升序数组找共同元素。
summary.en: Two-pointer scan of two sorted arrays for common elements.

summary.zh: 以步长 √n 跳过元素，定位目标所在块后线性回扫。
summary.en: Jump by step size √n to bracket the target block, then linear-scan backward.

summary.zh: 经典跳跃查找：步长 sqrt(n)，定位块后线性扫描。
summary.en: Classic jump search: step sqrt(n), locate a block then linear-scan.

summary.zh: 用黄金比例 0.618 作为步长因子的跳跃查找。
summary.en: Jump search using the golden ratio 0.618 as the step factor.

title.zh: 查找第 k 个斐波那契数

summary.zh: 迭代计算第 k 个斐波那契数（F(0)=0, F(1)=1）。
summary.en: Iteratively compute the k-th Fibonacci number (F(0)=0, F(1)=1).

title.zh: 第 k 小元素（排序）

summary.zh: 排序后直接取第 k 小（下标 k-1）。
summary.en: Sort then take the k-th smallest (index k-1).

summary.zh: 查找最后一个等于属于searching类别。
summary.en: Find Last Occurrence is a searching algorithm.

summary.zh: 递归实现：找目标值最左一次出现的下标。
summary.en: Recursive implementation: find the leftmost index of the target.

summary.zh: 从头到尾逐个比较找目标值，无序数组也可用。
summary.en: Compare one by one from start to end; works on unsorted arrays.

summary.zh: 把目标值放到数组末尾做哨兵，省去每次循环的越界判断。
summary.en: Place the target at the array end as a sentinel, removing the bound check inside the loop.

summary.zh: 在有序数组上线性扫描，遇到大于目标的元素即提前结束。
summary.en: Linear scan over a sorted array; bail out as soon as an element exceeds the target.

summary.zh: 二分找比相邻元素都小的局部最小（互异数组），O(log n)。
summary.en: Binary search for a local minimum (smaller than neighbors) in a distinct array, O(log n).

summary.zh: 找第一个 >= target 的下标（标准 C++ lower_bound 语义）。
summary.en: Find the first index with arr[i] >= target (C++ lower_bound semantics).

summary.zh: Boyer-Moore 投票：维护候选与计数，O(n) O(1) 找出现超过 n/2 次的元素。
summary.en: Boyer-Moore voting: maintain a candidate and counter; O(n) O(1) for the element appearing more than n/2 times.

summary.zh: 对较短数组二分切分点，使左右两半元素数相等且边界有序，O(log(min))。
summary.en: Binary search the partition on the shorter array so both halves are equal-sized and ordered; O(log(min)).

summary.zh: 用位构造法（不显式维护 lo/hi）直接构造目标索引。
summary.en: Construct the target index by bit-by-bit decisions without explicit lo/hi maintenance.

summary.zh: 从最高位起逐位构造候选下标，比较后决定该位置 0 或 1。
summary.en: Build the candidate index bit by bit from the MSB, comparing to decide each bit.

summary.zh: 二分找旋转升序数组中的最小元素下标。
summary.en: Binary search for the minimum element's index in a rotated sorted array.

summary.zh: 0..n 中缺失一个数，用求和公式减去实际和得到缺失值。
summary.en: Of 0..n one number is missing; subtract the actual sum from the expected sum.

summary.zh: 在 0..n 中找出唯一缺失的数字，三种方法（异或、求和、二分）。
summary.en: Find the single missing number in 0..n via xor, sum, or binary search.

summary.zh: 在「每个元素偏离原位置不超过 k」的数组中用带偏移的二分查找。
summary.en: Binary search with offsets in an array where each element is at most k away from its sorted position.

summary.zh: 升序数组双指针找差为 d 的一对。
summary.en: Two-pointer on a sorted array to find a pair with a given difference.

summary.zh: 升序数组用左右双指针找和等于 target 的一对。
summary.en: Two-pointer scan on a sorted array to find a pair summing to target.

summary.zh: 二分找任意一个峰值：比相邻元素大的元素，O(log n)。
summary.en: Binary search for any peak (greater than its neighbors) in O(log n).

summary.zh: 在矩阵中用列二分 + 行最大找二维峰值，O(n log m)。
summary.en: Find a 2D peak via column binary search + row-max, in O(n log m).

summary.zh: 用二分在无序数组中 O(log n) 找到一个峰值（比相邻元素大）。
summary.en: Use binary search to find a peak element (greater than neighbors) in an unsorted array in O(log n).

title.zh: 快速选择（第 k 小）

summary.zh: 类快排的分区法，平均 O(n) 找第 k 小元素。
summary.en: Quicksort-style partitioning to find the k-th smallest in average O(n).

summary.zh: 查找区间属于searching类别。
summary.en: Search For a Range is a searching algorithm.

summary.zh: 返回 target 在升序数组中首次与末次出现的下标区间 [-1,-1] 表示无。
summary.en: Return the [first, last] indices of target in a sorted array; [-1,-1] if absent.

summary.zh: 旋转数组搜索属于searching类别。
summary.en: Search in Rotated Sorted Array is a searching algorithm.

summary.zh: 在旋转过的升序数组（无重复）中二分查找 target。
summary.en: Binary search for target in a rotated sorted array with no duplicates.

summary.zh: 把目标放到数组末尾作为哨兵，省去每次循环的越界判断。
summary.en: Place the target as a sentinel at the end of the array to eliminate the bounds check from the inner loop.

summary.zh: 二分找有序数组中唯一只出现一次的元素（其余成对）。
summary.en: Binary search for the only once-occurring element in a sorted array (others in pairs).

summary.zh: 二分查找最大的整数 r 使 r*r <= x。
summary.en: Binary search for the largest integer r with r*r <= x.

summary.zh: 每次取两个中点把区间三等分，比较两次再缩到三分之一段。
summary.en: Pick two midpoints to trisect the range; two comparisons then shrink to one third.

summary.zh: 把搜索区间三等分，在有序数组中递归定位目标。
summary.en: Split the search interval into thirds and recursively locate the target in a sorted array.

summary.zh: 找第一个 > target 的下标（C++ upper_bound 语义）。
summary.en: Find the first index with arr[i] > target (C++ upper_bound semantics).

summary.zh: 把目标当作哨兵放末尾，循环省去越界判断，加快线性查找。
summary.en: Places the target as a sentinel at the tail so the scan loop skips the bounds check.

summary.zh: 哨兵查找属于searching类别。
summary.en: Sentinel Search is a searching algorithm.

summary.zh: 有序数组单一元素属于searching类别。
summary.en: Single Element in Sorted Array is a searching algorithm.

summary.zh: 整数平方根属于searching类别。
summary.en: Integer Square Root is a searching algorithm.

summary.zh: 三分查找属于searching类别。
summary.en: Ternary Search is a searching algorithm.

summary.zh: 珠排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Bead Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 双调排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Bitonic Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 猴子排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Bogo Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 交替执行奇数位和偶数位相邻比较交换，适合并行处理器。
summary.en: Alternately compare-swap odd-indexed and even-indexed adjacent pairs; parallel-friendly.

summary.zh: 冒泡排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Bubble Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 提前终止 + 记录最后交换位置，跳过已有序尾部。
summary.en: Early exit plus last-swap tracking to skip the already-ordered tail.

summary.zh: 桶排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Bucket Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 鸡尾酒排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Cocktail Shaker Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 记录最后一次交换位置，跳跃式收缩未排序区间的双向冒泡。
summary.en: Shaker sort that jumps the unsorted boundary to the last-swap position.

summary.zh: 梳排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Comb Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 使用最终阶段冒泡短路 + 1.3 收缩因子的梳排序。
summary.en: Comb sort with a bubble-shortcut final pass and the 1.3 shrink factor.

summary.zh: 计数排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Counting Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 圈排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Cycle Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 用 (值, 原下标) 配对作为键，使圈排序保持相等元素的相对顺序。
summary.en: Pair each value with its original index so cycle sort becomes stable.

summary.zh: 按值域分桶后用置换循环就地归位，无需桶数组的分布排序。
summary.en: Distribution sort that bins by value range then permutes in place.

summary.zh: 侏儒排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Gnome Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 用模拟「珠子受重力下落」的位矩阵对非负整数排序。
summary.en: Sort non-negative integers by simulating beads falling under gravity in a bit matrix.

summary.zh: 堆排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Heap Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 插入排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Insertion Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 用二分查找定位插入点，减少比较次数到 O(log n) 每元素。
summary.en: Locates each insertion point with binary search, cutting compares to O(log n) per element.

summary.zh: 内省排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: IntroSort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 图书馆排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Library Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 归并排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Merge Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 利用输入中已有的有序段（run），逐轮两两归并直至整体有序。
summary.en: Exploits existing ordered runs in the input, merging them pairwise until sorted.

summary.zh: 奇偶排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Odd-Even Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 煎饼排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Pancake Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 煎饼排序加「已就位跳过」与「顶部免翻」短路，翻转次数 ≤ 2n−3。
summary.en: Pancake sort with in-place and at-top short-circuits, ≤ 2n−3 flips.

summary.zh: 耐心排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Patience Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 穷举所有排列，找到第一个有序者（Bogo 的确定性变种）。
summary.en: Enumerate all permutations until the first sorted one is found.

summary.zh: 鸽巢排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Pigeonhole Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 快速排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Quick Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 基数排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Radix Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 从最高位（Most Significant Digit）开始，递归按位分桶。
summary.en: Partitions by the most significant digit first, then recurses on each bucket.

summary.zh: 采样排序：采样若干主元做 (k+1) 路划分，递归收尾。
summary.en: Samplesort: sample pivots, partition into (k+1) buckets, recurse.

summary.zh: 选择排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Selection Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 用「插入式」搬移代替交换，保证相等元素的相对顺序不变。
summary.en: Shifts elements instead of swapping to keep equal keys in original order.

summary.zh: 希尔排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Shell Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 睡眠排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Sleep Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 慢排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Slow Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 用「珠子层数」模拟重力下落：每列珠数即为该值的排序后位置计数。
summary.en: Simulate beads falling under gravity; the per-column bead count gives the sorted order.

summary.zh: 用二分查找定位插入点，再整体后移；减少比较次数到 O(n log n)。
summary.en: Binary-search the insertion point then shift; cuts comparisons to O(n log n).

title.zh: 二分插入排序变种（带重复计数）

summary.zh: 在有序前缀中用二分查找定位插入点，并保证相等元素的相对顺序（稳定）。
summary.en: Locate the insertion point by binary search over the sorted prefix, preserving the order of equal keys (stable).

summary.zh: 迭代版双调排序网络：对每级 k 做 bitonic 归并，并行友好。
summary.en: Iterative bitonic sorting network: for each level k do a bitonic merge; parallel-friendly.

summary.zh: 把数组分成大小为 √n 的块，逐块排序后再用块级归并，空间 O(1)。
summary.en: Split the array into blocks of size √n, sort each block, then merge blocks with O(1) extra space.

title.zh: 冒泡排序（末次交换优化）

summary.zh: 记录每趟最后一次交换的位置作为下趟的右边界，跳过已排好尾部。
summary.en: Record the last swap index each pass as the next pass's right bound, skipping the sorted tail.

summary.zh: 经典朴素冒泡：每趟相邻比较交换，无任何优化。
summary.en: Classic naive bubble: compare-swap adjacent pairs each pass, no optimizations.

summary.zh: 均匀分数组分到 sqrt(n) 个桶，各桶内插入排序后拼接。
summary.en: Scatter values into sqrt(n) buckets, insertion-sort each, then concatenate.

summary.zh: 用环形缓冲区实现双缓冲归并，原地完成两段有序子序列的合并。
summary.en: Merge two sorted runs using a circular buffer as a rotating swap area, in-place.

summary.zh: 双向鸡尾酒排序记录左右最后一次交换位置，跳过已排好区间。
summary.en: Bidirectional cocktail sort records the last swap on each side to skip sorted ranges.

summary.zh: 单一收缩因子 1.25 的梳排序，间隔序列略密。
summary.en: Comb sort with a single shrink factor of 1.25; a denser gap sequence.

summary.zh: 用收缩因子 1.33 的梳排序，间隔序列更陡。
summary.en: Comb sort with shrink factor 1.33; a steeper gap sequence.

summary.zh: 梳排序用两个交替收缩的间隔因子，加速消除小乌龟值。
summary.en: Comb sort alternating between two shrinking gaps to kill turtles faster.

summary.zh: 通过值偏移把负数也纳入计数排序的非负桶范围。
summary.en: Counting sort that supports negative values by offsetting them into a non-negative bucket range.

summary.zh: 循环节长为 2 的循环排序变体，每轮至多两次写入，减少写次数。
summary.en: Cycle-sort variant that processes cycles two at a time, minimizing writes per round.

summary.zh: 按值线性映射到 m 个桶，桶内插入排序后收集，近似线性。
summary.en: Linearly map values to m buckets, insertion-sort each, then collect; near-linear on uniform input.

summary.zh: 经典侏儒排序：逐位前进，遇逆序则交换并后退一位。
summary.en: Classic gnome sort: step forward; on an inversion swap and step back one.

summary.zh: 经典侏儒排序加跳跃回退：交换后跳回上次位置而非逐位回退。
summary.en: Optimized gnome sort jumps back to the previous position after a swap instead of stepping one by one.

summary.zh: 用每列珠子数等于该值的高度，让珠子受「重力」下落，再按每行珠子数读出排序结果。
summary.en: Represent numbers as columns of beads; let gravity pull beads down, then read row counts to obtain sorted order.

summary.zh: 用 4-叉完全堆做堆排序，每节点 4 个孩子，深度更浅。
summary.en: Heap sort over a 4-ary complete heap (four children per node), shallower depth.

summary.zh: 显式构建三叉大顶堆，再反复取堆顶到末尾。
summary.en: Explicitly build a ternary max-heap, then repeatedly extract the root to the tail.

summary.zh: 通过手摇算法（三段反转）在不申请额外数组的情况下原地合并两段有序序列。
summary.en: Merge two sorted runs in-place using a three-block rotation (reverse-based) technique.

summary.zh: 用一个「已排序链」+「剩余」两段，逐个把剩余首插入已排序链正确位置。
summary.en: Maintain a sorted prefix and a remainder; insert each remainder head into its sorted position.

summary.zh: 先把最小值移到首位作哨兵，内层循环省去边界判断。
summary.en: Move the minimum to the front as a sentinel so the inner loop skips boundary checks.

summary.zh: 插入排序的带空位版：预留空槽让插入只需少量后移。
summary.en: Insertion sort with gaps: pre-reserve empty slots so insertions shift few elements.

title.zh: 归并排序（自底向上迭代）

summary.zh: 迭代地归并长度 1,2,4,8... 的子段，无需递归。
summary.en: Iteratively merge runs of length 1,2,4,8... without recursion.

summary.zh: 原地归并的简化版：归并时用旋转把元素移到正确位置，避免辅助数组。
summary.en: Simplified in-place merge using rotation to move elements during merge, avoiding an auxiliary array.

summary.zh: 递归到小段（<=16）时改用插入排序，减少递归与归并开销。
summary.en: Switch to insertion sort for runs <= 16 to cut recursion/merge overhead.

summary.zh: 经典分治：递归拆半排序再归并，稳定 O(n log n)。
summary.en: Classic divide-and-conquer: recursively split in half, sort, and merge; stable O(n log n).

summary.zh: 每轮同时选最小和最大，分别压入结果两端。
summary.en: Each round select both min and max, pushing them to the two ends of the result.

summary.zh: Batcher 奇偶归并网络：递归归并奇/偶子序列，适合并行/硬件。
summary.en: Batcher odd-even merge network: recursively merge odd/even subsequences; parallel/hardware-friendly.

summary.zh: 每轮用翻转把当前未排序段的最大值送到段尾，n-1 轮完成排序。
summary.en: Each round use flips to send the current max of the unsorted segment to its tail; n-1 rounds.

title.zh: 耐心排序变种（栈式合并）

summary.zh: 把元素逐个放到「牌堆顶」上，再对各牌堆做 k 路归并得到有序序列。
summary.en: Deal elements onto card piles, then k-way merge the piles to produce the sorted output.

summary.zh: 把元素按 patience 规则放入牌堆，再用最小堆合并各堆顶。
summary.en: Deal elements into piles by patience rules, then merge pile tops via a min-heap.

summary.zh: 把值域内每个可能值映射到一个鸽巢，按值域顺序收集。
summary.en: Map each possible value in the range to a pigeonhole; collect in value order.

summary.zh: 按值线性映射到「近邻桶」，桶内插入排序后即得全局有序。
summary.en: Map values linearly to proxmap buckets, insertion-sort within, then collect globally sorted.

summary.zh: Dijkstra 三路划分：按小于/等于/大于 pivot 三段递归，高效处理大量重复键。
summary.en: Dijkstra 3-way partition splits into <,=,> pivot segments; fast on many duplicate keys.

summary.zh: 用首/中/尾三数中位数做 pivot，避免最坏情况，递归改迭代栈。
summary.en: Use the median of first/middle/last as pivot to avoid worst case; iterative stack.

title.zh: 基数排序（LSD 十六进制）

summary.zh: 以 16 为基数按位 LSD 基数排序，每趟 16 个桶，趟数为 hex 位数。
summary.en: LSD radix sort with base 16; 16 buckets per pass, passes = number of hex digits.

summary.zh: 从最高位起递归地按十进制位分桶，桶内递归直到个位。
summary.en: Recursively bucket by the most significant decimal digit first, recursing down to the units.

summary.zh: 每轮同时选出最小和最大，分别放到两端，趟数减半。
summary.en: Each round pick both min and max, placing them at the two ends; halves the rounds.

summary.zh: 每轮在未排序段线性找最小，与段首交换。朴素版无任何优化。
summary.en: Each round linearly find the min in the unsorted segment and swap it to the segment head; no optimizations.

summary.zh: 朴素双向冒泡：奇数趟向右、偶数趟向左，无边界优化。
summary.en: Naive bidirectional bubble: odd passes go right, even passes go left, no bound optimization.

summary.zh: 使用 Marcin Ciura 实验得出的最优间隔序列的希尔排序。
summary.en: Shell sort using Marcin Ciura's experimentally-optimal gap sequence.

summary.zh: 使用 Knuth 经典间隔序列 (...,109,41,15,5,1) 的希尔排序。
summary.en: Shell sort with the classic Knuth gap sequence (...,109,41,15,5,1).

summary.zh: 排序前先随机打乱数组，避免在已有序/特殊构造的输入上触发最坏情况。
summary.en: Randomly shuffle the array before sorting to avoid worst-case behavior on sorted or adversarial inputs.

summary.zh: 用 Leonardo 数列大小的堆组成森林，已有序时接近 O(n)。
summary.en: A forest of heaps sized by Leonardo numbers; near O(n) when already sorted.

summary.zh: 模拟 V8/标准库的混合排序：小段用插入排序，大段用快速排序，深度过深时退化为堆排序。
summary.en: Mimics the V8/standard-library hybrid sort: insertion for small runs, quicksort otherwise, with introsort-style heap fallback.

summary.zh: 经典 Stooge：递归排序前 2/3、后 2/3、再前 2/3，教学用极慢排序。
summary.en: Classic stooge: recursively sort the first 2/3, then last 2/3, then first 2/3 again; a pedagogically slow sort.

summary.zh: 反复从剩余元素抽出递增子链，归并到结果中。
summary.en: Repeatedly pull an increasing subsequence (strand) from the remainder and merge it into the result.

summary.zh: 归并时用二分/加速模式跳过连续取自同一侧的长段，减少比较。
summary.en: Merge using galloping/binary search to skip long runs taken from one side, cutting comparisons.

summary.zh: 依次插入 BST，中序遍历得有序序列；本版先排序去重再平衡建树。
summary.en: Insert into a BST, in-order traverse for sorted output; this version builds a balanced tree from sorted unique values.

summary.zh: 用 3-叉完全堆（每个父节点有 3 个孩子）做堆排序，相比二叉堆深度更浅。
summary.en: Heap sort over a 3-ary complete heap (three children per node), shallower than a binary heap.

summary.zh: 意大利面排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Spaghetti Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 基于位/分布的桶划分 + 小桶比较排序的混合排序。
summary.en: Hybrid sort: distribution-based bucketing plus comparison-based cleanup.

summary.zh: Stooge 排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Stooge Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: Strand 排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Strand Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 自适应归并：自然 run 检测 + 小段插入 + 自底向上归并。
summary.en: Adaptive merge: detect natural runs, insertion-sort small runs, merge bottom-up.

summary.zh: Tim排序v2（galloping 归并）属于sorting类别。
summary.en: TimSort v2 (galloping merge) is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: Tim排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: TimSort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 树排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Tree Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 动态数组属于ds类别。
summary.en: Dynamic Array is a ds algorithm.

summary.zh: AVL数据结构属于ds类别。
summary.en: AVL Tree (Data Structure) is a ds algorithm.

summary.zh: 二项堆属于ds类别。
summary.en: Binomial Heap is a ds algorithm.

summary.zh: 用两个 BIT 实现区间加 + 区间和查询，O(log n) 双操作。
summary.en: Two BITs implement range-add plus range-sum query, both in O(log n).

summary.zh: 树状数组（区间更新）属于ds类别。
summary.en: Binary Indexed Tree (Range Update) is a ds algorithm.

summary.zh: 分块数组属于ds类别。
summary.en: Block Array is a ds algorithm.

summary.zh: 二维分块属于ds类别。
summary.en: Blocking 2D is a ds algorithm.

summary.zh: 布隆过滤器属于ds类别。
summary.en: Bloom Filter is a ds algorithm.

summary.zh: 二叉搜索树属于ds类别。
summary.en: Binary Search Tree is a ds algorithm.

summary.zh: 块状链表属于ds类别。
summary.en: Chunk List is a ds algorithm.

summary.zh: 固定容量的环形缓冲：读写指针取模回绕，生产者/消费者语义。
summary.en: A fixed-capacity ring buffer: read/write pointers wrap mod capacity, producer/consumer semantics.

summary.zh: 循环链表属于ds类别。
summary.en: Circular Linked List is a ds algorithm.

paths.label: 面试高频
paths.description: 按面试高频主题组织，覆盖数组、图、动态规划、字符串、贪心与回溯。

summary.zh: 可回溯的束搜索变体。
summary.en: Backtrackable beam search.

summary.zh: 回溯 + AC-3 弧一致性传播：每步赋值后剪除不可能取值。
summary.en: Backtracking + AC-3 arc consistency: prune impossible values after each assignment.

summary.zh: 在已知 MDP 上交替进行策略评估与策略改进直至策略稳定，求得最优策略。
summary.en: Alternate policy evaluation and policy improvement on a known MDP until the policy stabilizes, yielding an optimal policy.

summary.zh: 在已知 MDP 上反复对贝尔曼最优方程做同步更新，直接逼近最优状态价值。
summary.en: Repeatedly apply synchronous Bellman-optimality backups on a known MDP to converge directly to the optimal state value.

summary.zh: 统计 1..n 的优美排列数量（第 i 位能被 i 整除或反之）。
summary.en: Count beautiful arrangements of 1..n (i divides value or value divides i).

summary.zh: 回溯判断数字字符串能否拆成前两数之和等于后续的累加序列。
summary.en: Backtracking to decide whether a digit string can split into an additive sequence (a+b=c).

summary.zh: 枚举图中从源到汇的所有简单路径。
summary.en: All simple paths from source to sink in a graph.

summary.zh: 回溯枚举给定长度的所有合法 Android 九宫格解锁序列。
summary.en: Backtracking to enumerate all valid Android grid unlock patterns of a given length.

summary.zh: 1..n 排列满足 perm[i] 整除 i 或 i 整除 perm[i] 的方案数。
summary.en: Count permutations where perm[i] divides i or vice versa.

summary.zh: 枚举长度 n 的所有二进制字符串。
summary.en: Enumerate all binary strings of length n.

summary.zh: 展开 {a,b}c{d,e} 形式的表达式为所有单词。
summary.en: Expand {a,b}c{d,e} into all words.

summary.zh: 回溯展开含并集与连接的花括号表达式，生成所有可能字符串。
summary.en: Backtracking to expand brace expressions with union and concatenation into all possible strings.

summary.zh: 判断 4 张牌能否通过 + - * / 得到 24。
summary.en: Can 4 cards reach 24 via + - * / ?

summary.zh: 回溯求 2×n 网格用 1×2 多米诺铺满的方法数。
summary.en: Count ways to tile 2xn grid with 1x2 dominoes.

summary.zh: 从无重复正整数候选中选若干（可重复）使和为 target。
summary.en: Pick candidates (with repeat) summing to target.

summary.zh: 从 1-9 选 k 个不同数使和为 n。
summary.en: Pick k distinct numbers from 1-9 summing to n.

summary.zh: 枚举 1..n 中选 k 个的所有组合。
summary.en: All k-combinations of 1..n.

summary.zh: 回溯枚举从 1..n 中选 k 个的所有组合。
summary.en: Backtracking to enumerate C(n,k) combinations.

summary.zh: 回溯枚举从 1..n 中选出 k 个的所有组合。
summary.en: Backtrack to list all k-element combinations chosen from 1..n.

summary.zh: 回溯找出所有和等于 target 的组合（数字可重复使用）。
summary.en: Backtracking to find all combinations summing to target (elements reusable).

summary.zh: 回溯选最多互不时间冲突的预约。
summary.en: Backtrack to pick max non-overlapping appointments.

summary.zh: 回溯统计 [1,n] 中所有旋转后变成不同有效数字的「困惑数」个数。
summary.en: Backtracking to count confusing numbers in [1,n] that differ after 180° rotation.

summary.zh: 解码 3[a2[c]] → accaccacc。
summary.en: Decode 3[a2[c]] into accaccacc.

summary.zh: 给表达式加不同括号得到的所有可能值。
summary.en: All possible values by adding parens differently.

summary.zh: 在数字串中插入 + - * 使表达式等于目标值。
summary.en: Insert + - * into digit string to reach target.

summary.zh: 回溯在数字间插入 + - * 使表达式等于目标值。
summary.en: Backtrack inserting + - * between digits so the expression evaluates to target.

summary.zh: 回溯列出 n 的所有因数乘积分解（不含 n 本身）。
summary.en: Backtracking to list all factor-product decompositions of n (excluding n itself).

summary.zh: 通过回溯枚举排列求最小相邻时间差（演示用）。
summary.en: Backtracking permutations to find min time difference (demo).

summary.zh: 回溯 + SG 值判断 ++ 字符串先手能否必胜。
summary.en: Backtracking with SG values to decide if the first player wins the flip game.

summary.zh: 生成 n 对括号的所有合法组合。
summary.en: All valid combinations of n pairs of parentheses.

summary.zh: 从左上到右下的所有只向右/下路径。
summary.en: All right/down paths from top-left to bottom-right.

summary.zh: 回溯找出数组所有长度 ≥2 的非递减子序列。
summary.en: Backtracking to find all non-decreasing subsequences of length ≥2.

summary.zh: 在 n×n 棋盘找骑士访问每格一次的路线。
summary.en: Find a knight tour visiting every square once.

summary.zh: 回溯生成字符串中每个字母的大小写所有组合。
summary.en: Backtracking to generate all case combinations of letters in a string.

summary.zh: 按键数字串对应的所有字母组合。
summary.en: All letter combos for a phone digit string.

summary.zh: 判断无向图能否用 m 种颜色着色使相邻不同色。
summary.en: Can color graph with m colors so adjacent differ.

summary.zh: 判断能否用所有火柴拼成正方形（4 边相等）。
summary.en: Can form a square using all matchsticks.

summary.zh: 从字符串数组选若干拼接，使字符唯一且最长。
summary.en: Pick strings to concatenate with all unique chars, maximize length.

summary.zh: 回溯选若干字符串拼接，使拼接结果字符全唯一，求最大长度。
summary.en: Backtracking to choose strings to concatenate with all-unique characters, maximizing total length.

summary.zh: 把字符串拆成尽量多的互不相同的子串。
summary.en: Split string into max number of distinct substrings.

summary.zh: 回溯枚举所有可达路径，记录从起点到终点的最短路径。
summary.en: Backtracking to enumerate all reachable paths and record the shortest from start to goal.

summary.zh: 点击扫雷盘格，自动展开 0 区域。
summary.en: Click a minesweeper cell, auto-expand zero region.

summary.zh: 在 n×n 棋盘放 n 个互不攻击的皇后，求方案数。
summary.en: Count ways to place n non-attacking queens.

summary.zh: 回溯验证给定皇后列位置数组是否构成合法的 N 皇后布局。
summary.en: Backtracking-based validation of a given column array as a legal N-Queens placement.

summary.zh: 回溯+剪枝把 n 拆成最少完全平方数之和。
summary.en: Min perfect squares summing to n (backtrack).

summary.zh: 回溯统计 Android 解锁图案中长度在 [m,n] 范围的模式总数。
summary.en: Backtracking to count Android unlock patterns with length in [m,n].

summary.zh: 给一串正整数连除，加括号使结果最大，返回加括号表达式。
summary.en: Add parentheses to a chain of divisions of positive integers to maximize the result, returning the expression.

summary.zh: 把字符串分割成若干回文子串的所有方案。
summary.en: All ways to partition a string into palindromic substrings.

summary.zh: 回溯枚举每个回文前缀，递归剩余后缀，列出所有分割方案。
summary.en: Backtrack over palindromic prefixes, recurse on the rest, list all partitions.

summary.zh: 回溯 + 记忆化求把字符串分成回文子串的最少切割次数。
summary.en: Backtracking with memoization to find the minimum cuts partitioning a string into palindromes.

summary.zh: 判断字符串能否重排成回文（至多一个字母出现奇数次）。
summary.en: Check whether a string can be rearranged into a palindrome (at most one odd-count letter).

summary.zh: 回溯生成所有可重排成回文的字符串。
summary.en: Backtracking to generate all palindromic permutations of a string.

summary.zh: 判断数组能否划分成 k 个和相等的子集。
summary.en: Can partition array into k equal-sum subsets.

summary.zh: 找二叉树中从根到叶和等于 target 的所有路径。
summary.en: All root-to-leaf paths summing to target.

summary.zh: 回溯枚举数组的所有全排列。
summary.en: Backtracking to enumerate all permutations.

summary.zh: 枚举含重复元素数组的所有不重复全排列。
summary.en: All distinct permutations of array with duplicates.

summary.zh: 判断能否从底串构建到金字塔顶。
summary.en: Can build pyramid from bottom to top.

summary.zh: 在 N×N 迷宫找从左上到右下的路径。
summary.en: Find path from top-left to bottom-right in a maze.

summary.zh: 回溯实现支持 . 与 * 的正则匹配（LeetCode 10）。
summary.en: Backtracking regex matching supporting . and * (LeetCode 10).

summary.zh: 从字符串复原所有合法 IPv4 地址。
summary.en: Restore all valid IPv4 addresses from a string.

summary.zh: 把字符串拆成斐波那契式序列。
summary.en: Split string into a Fibonacci-like sequence.

summary.zh: 用最少贴纸拼出目标词（回溯+剪枝）。
summary.en: Min stickers to spell target word.

summary.zh: 回溯 + 记忆化求拼出目标词所需最少贴纸数。
summary.en: Backtracking with memoization to find minimum stickers to spell a target word.

summary.zh: 枚举含重复元素数组的所有不重复子集。
summary.en: All distinct subsets of array with duplicates.

title.zh: 含重复元素的子集 II

summary.zh: 对含重复元素的数组枚举去重后的所有子集。
summary.en: Enumerate all deduplicated subsets of an array with duplicates.

summary.zh: 枚举 n 元素中大小恰为 k 的所有子集。
summary.en: All subsets of size exactly k from n elements.

summary.zh: 排序后回溯，对同层重复元素跳过，枚举所有不重复子集。
summary.en: Sort then backtrack, skipping same-level duplicates to list all unique subsets.

summary.zh: 回溯求解 9×9 数独。
summary.en: Backtracking to solve 9x9 sudoku.

summary.zh: 检查 9×9 数独每行、每列、每个 3×3 宫内数字 1-9 不重复。
summary.en: Check each row, column, and 3x3 box of a 9x9 board has no duplicate digits 1-9.

summary.zh: 判断字符串能否按模式匹配（双射）。
summary.en: Match string to pattern (bijection).

summary.zh: 回溯统计用瓷砖字母能组成的所有非空序列数。
summary.en: Backtracking to count all non-empty sequences buildable from letter tiles.

summary.zh: 把数组分成大小相差不超过 1 的两子集，使和差最小。
summary.en: Split into two nearly-equal subsets with min sum difference.

summary.zh: 回溯实现 ? 与 * 的通配符匹配，记录星号位置回退。
summary.en: Backtracking wildcard matching with ? and *, recording star positions for backoff.

summary.zh: 把字符串拆成字典词的所有句子。
summary.en: All sentences splitting string into dictionary words.

summary.zh: 回溯双射匹配 pattern 与 str，每个模式字母对应一个非空子串。
summary.en: Backtrack a bijection between pattern letters and non-empty substrings of str.

summary.zh: 在字符网格中找是否存在给定单词（四向相邻）。
summary.en: Find if word exists in char grid (4-dir adjacent).

summary.zh: 把字符串按之字形排列后按行读出。
summary.en: Convert string to zigzag rows then read row by row.

summary.zh: 组合总和属于backtracking类别。
summary.en: Combination Sum is a backtracking algorithm.

summary.zh: 组合总和II属于backtracking类别。
summary.en: Combination Sum II is a backtracking algorithm.

summary.zh: 从 1..9 中选 k 个不同数字使其和为 n。
summary.en: Pick k distinct numbers from 1..9 that sum to n.

summary.zh: 在数字串中插入 +、-、* 使其求值等于目标。
summary.en: Insert +, -, * into a digit string so it evaluates to target.

summary.zh: 括号生成属于backtracking类别。
summary.en: Generate Parens is a backtracking algorithm.

summary.zh: 图着色属于backtracking类别。
summary.en: Graph Coloring is a backtracking algorithm.

summary.zh: 哈密顿路径属于backtracking类别。
summary.en: Hamilton Path is a backtracking algorithm.

summary.zh: 骑士巡游属于backtracking类别。
summary.en: Knight Tour is a backtracking algorithm.

summary.zh: 电话号码字母组合属于backtracking类别。
summary.en: Letter Combos is a backtracking algorithm.

summary.zh: 把若干火柴分成 4 组，每组总长相等（拼成正方形）。
summary.en: Split matchsticks into 4 groups of equal total length (a square).

summary.zh: N 皇后属于backtracking类别。
summary.en: N-Queens is a backtracking algorithm.

summary.zh: 不列举解，仅统计 N×N 棋盘上互不攻击皇后的摆放方案总数。
summary.en: Count (without listing) the number of distinct N-Queens solutions.

summary.zh: 回文分割回溯属于backtracking类别。
summary.en: Palindrome Partition BT is a backtracking algorithm.

summary.zh: 判断数组能否分成两个和相等的子集。
summary.en: Determine if an array can be partitioned into two subsets of equal sum.

summary.zh: 全排列属于backtracking类别。
summary.en: Permutations is a backtracking algorithm.

summary.zh: 数组含重复元素，生成所有不重复的全排列。
summary.en: Generate all distinct permutations of an array with duplicates.

summary.zh: 迷宫老鼠属于backtracking类别。
summary.en: Rat in Maze is a backtracking algorithm.

summary.zh: 复原IP属于backtracking类别。
summary.en: Restore IP is a backtracking algorithm.

summary.zh: 把字符串分割成若干回文子串，求最少分割次数。
summary.en: Partition a string into palindromes with the minimum number of cuts.

summary.zh: 子集枚举属于backtracking类别。
summary.en: Subsets is a backtracking algorithm.

summary.zh: 数组含重复元素，枚举所有不重复的子集。
summary.en: Enumerate all distinct subsets of an array that may contain duplicates.

summary.zh: 数独求解属于backtracking类别。
summary.en: Sudoku Solver is a backtracking algorithm.

summary.zh: 单词搜索属于backtracking类别。
summary.en: Word Search is a backtracking algorithm.

summary.zh: 在字符网格上找出词典中所有出现的单词（Trie + 回溯）。
summary.en: Find all dictionary words present in a character grid (Trie + backtracking).

summary.zh: LZ 通用：滑动窗口 + 前看缓冲，输出 (距离, 长度) 二元组。
summary.en: Generic LZ: sliding window + lookahead, emit (distance, length) pairs.

summary.zh: LZSS：位标志 + (距离, 长度)，比 LZ77 更紧凑。
summary.en: LZSS: bit flag + (distance, length); more compact than LZ77.

summary.zh: Kadane 算法 O(n) 求最大子数组和，动态规划经典。
summary.en: Kadane's algorithm finds the maximum subarray sum in O(n) — a DP classic.

summary.zh: 对每个窗口计算聚合值（和/最大/最小），对比朴素、前缀和、单调队列三种策略。
summary.en: Compute aggregates (sum/max/min) per window, comparing naive, prefix-sum, and monotonic-queue strategies.

summary.zh: 用哈希计数表维护窗口内各值频次，新增/移除时增减计数，O(1) 维护不同元素个数。
summary.en: A hash frequency map over the window increments/decrements counts, maintaining distinct count in O(1).

summary.zh: 单调递减队列维护窗口候选最大，每个位置均摊 O(1)。
summary.en: A monotone-decreasing deque maintains window maxima at amortized O(1) per position.

summary.zh: 用大小顶堆（含懒删除）维护窗口，平衡堆大小即可 O(log k) 取中位数。
summary.en: Maintain a max-heap and min-heap (with lazy deletion) over the window; balance sizes to get median in O(log k).

summary.zh: wqs二分DP属于dp类别。
summary.en: Alien Trick is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 状压 DP（TSP 旅行商）属于dp类别。
summary.en: Bitmask DP (Traveling Salesman) is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 有界背包属于dp类别。
summary.en: Bounded Knapsack is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 戳气球属于dp类别。
summary.en: Burst Balloons is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 分糖果属于dp类别。
summary.en: Candy is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 零钱兑换属于dp类别。
summary.en: Coin Change is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 凸优化DP属于dp类别。
summary.en: Convex Hull Trick is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 计数 DP属于dp类别。
summary.en: Counting DP is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 解码方法属于dp类别。
summary.en: Decode Ways is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 依赖背包属于dp类别。
summary.en: Dependent Knapsack is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 数位 DP属于dp类别。
summary.en: Digit DP is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 分治DP属于dp类别。
summary.en: Divide DP is a dp algorithm.

title.zh: 参加最多活动（按结束时间 dp）

summary.zh: 给定若干区间 [start,end)，求不重叠地参加最多活动数。
summary.en: Given intervals, attend max number of non-overlapping meetings.

summary.zh: 长度为 n 的串，A<2 且无连续 3 个 L，统计合法出勤记录方案数。
summary.en: Count attendance strings of length n with <2 A and no "LLL", modulo 1e9+7.

summary.zh: scores[i]+scores[j]+i-j，求最大值（i<j）。
summary.en: Maximize scores[i]+scores[j]+i-j with i<j.

title.zh: 买卖股票最佳时机（单次）
title.en: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock (Once)

summary.zh: 只允许一次买入一次卖出，求最大利润。
summary.en: At most one buy and one sell; maximize profit.

summary.zh: m×n 棋盘从左上到右下，只能向右或向下，求不同路径数。
summary.en: Count distinct paths from top-left to bottom-right on an m×n grid, moving only right or down.

title.zh: 爬楼梯（最多 k 步）

summary.zh: 每次可爬 1..k 阶，求到达顶部的方案数。
summary.en: Climb 1..k steps each move; count distinct ways to top.

summary.zh: 每次可走 steps 中任一阶，求到达第 n 阶的方案数。
summary.en: Each time you may climb any step count in a set; count ways to reach stair n.

summary.zh: 每次可爬 1 或 2 阶，但某些台阶是障碍不能踩，求到达顶部的方案数。
summary.en: Climb 1 or 2 steps, but avoid obstacle steps; count distinct ways to the top.

summary.zh: 可爬 1 或 2 阶，每阶有代价，求到顶最小累计（O(1) 空间滚动数组版本）。
summary.en: Climb 1 or 2 steps each with a cost; reach the top with min total (O(1) space rolling DP).

title.zh: 零钱兑换（求最少硬币数）

summary.zh: 给定硬币面额，凑出金额 amount 所需的最少硬币数。
summary.en: Minimum number of coins to make up amount.

summary.zh: 求凑成总金额的最少硬币数，并输出字典序最小的方案。
summary.en: Fewest coins to make amount, returning the lexicographically smallest combination.

title.zh: 零钱兑换（贪心失败判定）

summary.zh: 对比贪心与 DP：贪心在某些面值下会失败，DP 永远给出最优解。
summary.en: Contrast greedy with DP: greedy can fail on certain denominations, DP always returns the optimum.

summary.zh: 用若干面额凑成总金额的组合数（不计顺序）。
summary.en: Count combinations of coins that sum to a target amount.

summary.zh: 从左上走到右下，每格有金币，只能向右或向下，求最大收益。
summary.en: Walk top-left to bottom-right collecting coins; only right/down moves; maximize total.

summary.zh: 用 nums 凑成 target 的排列数（顺序不同算不同）。
summary.en: Count permutations of nums that sum to target.

summary.zh: 统计字符串中不同回文子序列的个数。
summary.en: Count the number of distinct palindromic subsequences in a string.

summary.zh: 统计字符串中所有回文子序列的个数。
summary.en: Count the total number of palindromic subsequences of a string.

summary.zh: 网格只能向右或向下，求从左上到右下的路径总数。
summary.en: Count grid paths from top-left to bottom-right moving only right or down.

summary.zh: 从两个数组各取若干位保持相对顺序，拼成长 k 的最大数。
summary.en: Pick digits from two arrays (order preserved) to form the max number of length k.

summary.zh: 顺序运送最多 maxBoxes 个同色段不超过 maxPorts 的盒子，求最少行程。
summary.en: Deliver up to maxBoxes with limited port-segments per trip; minimize trips.

summary.zh: 快递员在数轴上送完所有点的最小路程（区间 DP）。
summary.en: Min travel distance for a courier to deliver to all points on a line (interval DP).

summary.zh: 用 m 面骰子掷出总和为 n 的方法数。
summary.en: Number of ways to roll sum n with an m-faced die.

summary.zh: 从右下到左上逆向 DP，求救出公主所需的最小初始血量。
summary.en: Reverse DP from bottom-right to top-left; find minimum initial HP to rescue the princess.

title.zh: 地下城游戏（最小初始血量）

summary.zh: 从左上到右下，每格增/减血，血须始终 >0，求最小初始血量。
summary.en: Top-left to bottom-right, each cell +/- HP, HP must stay >0; find min initial HP.

summary.zh: 骑士从左上到右下救公主，每格加血或扣血，血量须恒 >0，求最少初始血量。
summary.en: Knight rescues princess; each cell adds/removes HP (must stay >0); find min initial HP.

summary.zh: 把字符串 a 变成 b 的最少插入/删除/替换次数。
summary.en: Minimum insert/delete/replace ops to transform a into b.

summary.zh: 带相邻交换的编辑距离：插入、删除、替换、转置四种操作。
summary.en: Edit distance with adjacent transposition (insert/delete/substitute/swap).

summary.zh: 求两串的 Levenshtein 距离并回溯出最少编辑操作序列。
summary.en: Levenshtein distance plus the actual edit operations via backtracking.

summary.zh: 按顺序把书放上书架，每层限宽限高，最小化总高度。
summary.en: Place books in order on shelves; each shelf has a width limit; minimize total height.

summary.zh: 求两个数组的最长公共连续子数组长度。
summary.en: Find the length of the longest common contiguous subarray of two arrays.

summary.zh: 青蛙每次跳 1 或 2 块石头，求到终点的最小累计代价。
summary.en: A frog jumps 1 or 2 stones at a time; minimize total cost to the last stone.

summary.zh: 青蛙每次可跳 1~K 步，代价为高度差绝对值，求到终点的最小代价。
summary.en: A frog may jump 1..K stones; cost is the absolute height difference; minimize total.

summary.zh: 青蛙从一岸跳到对岸，每跳消耗能量，求最小总代价。
summary.en: Frog crosses stones; each jump costs energy; find minimum total cost to the far bank.

summary.zh: 青蛙最多跳 cost 步远，求到达终点的最小代价。
summary.en: Frog can jump up to cost steps at a time; find min cost to reach the end.

summary.zh: 相邻房屋不可同时选，求最大收益（线性 DP）。
summary.en: Maximize loot without choosing two adjacent houses (linear DP).

summary.zh: 环形排列首尾相邻，拆成两段线性子问题取最大。
summary.en: Circular layout: split into two linear ranges and take the max.

summary.zh: 二叉树形村庄，相邻节点不能同时抢，求最大收益。
summary.en: Tree-shaped village; cannot rob adjacent nodes; maximize the loot.

summary.zh: 房屋排成二叉树，相邻父子不能同抢，求能偷到的最大金额。
summary.en: Houses arranged in a binary tree; cannot rob both parent and child. Maximize loot.

summary.zh: 判断 s3 是否由 s1、s2 交错组成。
summary.en: Determine whether s3 is formed by interleaving s1 and s2.

summary.zh: 求 1..n 的排列中恰有 k 个逆序对的数目（取模）。
summary.en: Count permutations of 1..n with exactly k inverse pairs (mod).

summary.zh: n 个物品、容量 W，每物品取或不取，求最大价值。空间 O(W)。
summary.en: 0-1 knapsack with 1D rolling array, space O(W).

summary.zh: 经典 01 背包，用一维 dp 数组倒序滚动节省空间。
summary.en: Classic 0/1 knapsack with a 1D rolling array, iterating capacity backwards.

summary.zh: 同时含 0/1、完全、多重三种物品的背包求最大价值。
summary.en: Knapsack combining 0/1, unbounded, and bounded items to maximize value.

summary.zh: 骑士按 8 个日字方向随机走 k 步，求仍留在棋盘的概率。
summary.en: A knight makes k random L-shaped moves; find the probability it stays on the board.

summary.zh: 任选两块石头相撞粉碎，差值留下，求最后一块石头的最小可能重量。
summary.en: Smash two stones each turn; the difference remains; minimize the last stone weight.

summary.zh: 求同时包含两字符串为子序列的最短字符串长度。
summary.en: Find the length of the shortest string containing both strings as subsequences.

title.zh: LCS 三维（三串最长公共子序列）

summary.zh: 求三个字符串的最长公共子序列长度，三维 DP。
summary.en: Longest common subsequence among three strings via 3D DP.

title.zh: 最长公共子序列（滚动数组优化）

summary.zh: 两序列的最长公共子序列，用滚动数组把空间降到 O(min(n,m))。
summary.en: Longest common subsequence with rolling array, space O(min(n,m)).

summary.zh: 求最长递增子序列的长度并统计达到该长度的子序列个数。
summary.en: Find LIS length and count how many distinct LIS achieve it.

title.en: LIS via Binary Search (O(n log n))

summary.zh: 用「牌堆」二分法求最长递增子序列长度，时间复杂度降为 O(n log n)。
summary.en: Patience sorting: binary search on piles to compute LIS length in O(n log n).

title.zh: 最长递增子序列（贪心+二分）

summary.zh: O(n log n) 贪心二分求最长严格递增子序列长度。
summary.en: O(n log n) greedy + binary search for LIS length.

summary.zh: DP 求（可重排选取的）最长等差子序列长度。
summary.en: DP for the longest arithmetic subsequence length.

summary.zh: 记忆化 DFS：每步走向数值更大的相邻格，求最长路径。
summary.en: Memoized DFS: move to larger-value neighbors; find the longest path.

summary.zh: DP 求括号串中最长有效（正确配对）子串长度。
summary.en: DP for the length of the longest valid (well-formed) parentheses substring.

summary.zh: 同时维护当前最大积与最小积，遇负数翻转，求全局最大乘积。
summary.en: Track current max and min products (swap on negative); return global maximum.

summary.zh: 找出数组中乘积最大的连续子数组，返回该乘积。
summary.en: Find the contiguous subarray with the largest product.

summary.zh: n 城每周可飞，求 W 周内最大休假天数。
summary.en: Fly between n cities each week to maximize vacation days over W weeks.

summary.zh: 数组中连续子数组的最大乘积（含负数）。
summary.en: Maximum product of a contiguous subarray (may include negatives).

summary.zh: 每阶有代价，可爬 1 或 2 阶，求到顶的最小累计代价。
summary.en: Each step has a cost; climb 1 or 2 steps; minimize total cost to reach the top.

summary.zh: 把数组分成两个子集，使两子集和的差的绝对值最小。
summary.en: Partition an array into two subsets to minimize the absolute difference of their sums.

summary.zh: 在带障碍的网格上从左上走到右下，每次只能向右或向下，求最小权和。
summary.en: From top-left to bottom-right on a grid with obstacles; move right/down; minimize cost.

summary.zh: 从三角形顶点到底部相邻结点的最小路径和。
summary.en: Minimum path sum from triangle top to bottom via adjacent numbers.

summary.zh: 3 道青蛙跳跃，避开障碍物，最少侧跳到达终点。
summary.en: A frog on a 3-lane road dodges obstacles; minimize side jumps to finish.

summary.zh: m×n 网格，从左上到右下每次只能右移或下移，求最小路径和。
summary.en: Top-left to bottom-right moving only right/down; minimize path sum.

title.zh: 歌单组合（恰好 K 首 N 分钟）

summary.zh: 从 n 首歌中选若干首拼成总长恰好 target 的歌单，每首最多用一次，求方案数。
summary.en: Pick songs (0/1) to form a playlist of exact target length; count ways.

title.zh: 歌曲列表（不同歌间隔 k）

summary.zh: 从 n 首歌、目标长度 L 的歌单，每首歌与前 k 首不同（歌单可循环），求方案数。
summary.en: Count playlists of length L from n unique songs; same song repeats only after k other songs.

summary.zh: 概率 DP：抽 1..W 累分，停手后分数 ≤ N 的概率。
summary.en: Probability DP: drawing 1..W until threshold, find P(final score <= N).

summary.zh: 求数组最长严格递增子序列的个数。
summary.en: Count the number of longest strictly increasing subsequences.

summary.zh: DP 计数：n 首歌、长 L 的播放列表，每首至少一次、间隔≥k。
summary.en: DP counting: playlists of length L over n songs, each at least once, gap >= k.

summary.zh: n 首歌组播放列表长 goal，两首同歌间隔至少 k，求方案数取模。
summary.en: Build a goal-length playlist from n songs with gap k between repeats; count mod 1e9+7.

summary.zh: 二维 0/1 背包：用 m 个 0、n 个 1 最多拼出多少个字符串。
summary.en: 2D 0/1 knapsack: form as many strings as possible with m zeros and n ones.

summary.zh: 网格四向移动，maxMove 步内走出边界的路径数（取模）。
summary.en: Count paths leaving an m-by-n grid within maxMove moves (mod).

summary.zh: n 个房子，每房只能粉刷红/蓝/绿一种颜色，相邻不能同色，求最小成本。
summary.en: n houses, paint each red/blue/green, no two adjacent same color; min cost.

title.zh: 栅栏涂色（最多 2 同色）

summary.zh: k 种颜色涂 n 根栅栏，任意 3 相邻不能同色，求方案数。
summary.en: Paint n fences with k colors; no three adjacent fences may share a color.

summary.zh: 已有部分上色的 m 栋房，用 n 种色形成 target 个街区，求最小成本。
summary.en: Paint m houses with n colors to form target neighborhoods at minimum cost.

summary.zh: n 栋房子、k 种颜色，相邻不同色，求最小粉刷成本。
summary.en: Paint n houses with k colors, adjacent houses different color; minimize total cost.

summary.zh: 区间 DP 统计字符串中所有回文子串个数。
summary.en: Interval DP counting all palindromic substrings.

summary.zh: n 门课有先修依赖，可并行修读，求修完最少学期数。
summary.en: n courses with prerequisites; take them in parallel; find the minimum semesters.

summary.zh: 首尾相连的环形街，不能同时偷相邻两家，求最大金额。
summary.en: Houses in a circle; cannot rob two adjacent; maximize loot.

summary.zh: 把整数 n 拆成至少两个正整数之和，使乘积最大。
summary.en: Split n into >=2 positive integers to maximize product.

title.zh: 分割数组最大和（二分答案）

summary.zh: 将数组分成 m 个连续段，最小化最大段和。用二分答案求解。
summary.en: Split array into m contiguous subarrays to minimize the largest sum; via binary search on the answer.

summary.zh: 将数组分成 m 段连续子数组，使最大段和最小。
summary.en: Split array into m contiguous subarrays minimizing the largest subarray sum.

title.en: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock with Cooldown

summary.zh: 卖出后次日不能买入（冷冻期），求最大利润，可无限次交易。
summary.en: Unlimited trades but a one-day cooldown after selling; maximize profit.

title.zh: 买卖股票 VI（带手续费）
title.en: Best Time Buy/Sell Stock VI (with Fee)

summary.zh: 可无限次交易，但每次卖出需交固定手续费，求最大利润。
summary.en: Unlimited trades, each sell incurs a fixed transaction fee; maximize profit.

title.zh: 买卖股票 VII（含冷冻期）

summary.zh: 无限次交易但卖出后次日不能买入（冷冻期），求最大利润。
summary.en: Unlimited trades with a 1-day cooldown after selling; maximize profit.

title.en: Best Time to Buy/Sell with Fee

summary.zh: 可多次买卖，每次卖出收手续费 fee，求最大利润。
summary.en: Unlimited trades, pay fee per sell; max profit.

title.en: Best Time to Buy/Sell with Cooldown

summary.zh: 多次买卖，卖出后第二天不能买入（冷冻期 1 天），求最大利润。
summary.en: Unlimited trades, 1-day cooldown after sell; max profit.

title.en: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock with Cooldown

summary.zh: 卖出后次日必须冷冻一天，求最大利润。
summary.en: After selling you must cool down one day; maximize profit.

title.en: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock with Transaction Fee

summary.zh: 无限次交易，但每笔交易需付固定手续费，求最大利润。
summary.en: Unlimited trades, each with a fixed transaction fee; maximize profit.

title.en: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock II

summary.zh: 允许多次买卖（同时最多持有一股），求最大利润。
summary.en: Unlimited transactions but hold at most one share; maximize profit.

summary.zh: n 堆石子，每次合并相邻两堆代价为两堆之和，求最小总代价。
summary.en: Merge adjacent piles (cost = sum of two piles); minimize total cost.

title.zh: 石子合并（区间 DP + 前缀和）

summary.zh: 一排石子每次合并相邻两堆代价为二者之和，求最小总代价。
summary.en: Merge adjacent piles; cost is sum of two piles; minimize total cost via interval DP.

summary.zh: 取前若干块石子合并到首位，得分等于新首位，求先手最优分差。
summary.en: Merge a chosen prefix into the first stone; gain the new first value; find optimal score difference.

summary.zh: 两人轮流取平方数个石子，取走最后一个者胜。
summary.en: Two players remove a square number of stones; last mover wins.

summary.zh: 沿一行石子切分，丢弃较大半，得分取较小半，递归求最大总分。
summary.en: Split a row of stones; discard the heavier half, score the lighter, recurse for max total.

summary.zh: 把字符串切成若干回文子串的最少切割次数。
summary.en: Minimum cuts to partition a string into palindromic substrings.

summary.zh: K 个鸡蛋 N 层楼，二分优化 DP 求最少试探次数。
summary.en: K eggs, N floors: binary-search optimized DP for minimum trials.

summary.zh: 每次每台机器可向相邻移动一件衣服，求让所有机器衣服数相同的最少操作轮数。
summary.en: Move one dress per machine per step to an adjacent machine; minimize steps to equalize.

summary.zh: 每台洗衣机可向相邻机器移动一件衣服，求使所有机器衣服数相等的最少操作轮数。
summary.en: Each move shifts one dress to an adjacent machine; min rounds to equalize all machines.

summary.zh: n 台洗衣机，每台可向相邻移动 1 件衣服，求使所有台数相等的最少步数。
summary.en: Each move shifts 1 dress to neighbor; min moves to equalize all machines.

summary.zh: 每根钢管放左、右或不放，使两支撑等高，求该最大高度。
summary.en: Place each rod on the left support, right support, or skip; maximize the equal support height.

summary.zh: 用 1×2 砖铺满 2×N 通道的方案数（斐波那契）。
summary.en: Number of ways to tile a 2×N corridor with 1×2 dominoes (Fibonacci).

summary.zh: 用 1×2 多米诺铺满 2×N 网格的方案数（斐波那契）。
summary.en: Number of ways to tile a 2×N grid with 1×2 dominoes (Fibonacci).

summary.zh: 用 2×1 多米诺和 L 型三联骨牌铺满 2×n 板，求方案数。
summary.en: Tile a 2xn board with dominos and L-trominoes; count ways modulo 1e9+7.

summary.zh: 用 1×2 多米诺骨牌铺满 2×N 网格的方案数（斐波那契）。
summary.en: Number of ways to tile a 2×N board with 1×2 dominoes (Fibonacci).

summary.zh: 用 2×1 多米诺与 L 型三多米诺铺满 3×N 的方案数。
summary.en: Number of ways to tile a 3×N grid with 2×1 dominoes and L-trominoes.

summary.zh: 每天三选一，相邻天不重复，求最大总幸福度。
summary.en: Pick one of three activities each day, no repeats on consecutive days; maximize happiness.

title.en: Count Vowel Strings of Length n

summary.zh: 长度 n、仅由 a/e/i/o/u 组成且按元音字典序非递减的字符串数。
summary.en: Count length-n strings over a/e/i/o/u, non-decreasing in vowel order.

summary.zh: 每个元音字母后只能跟某些元音，求长度为 n 的合法元音序列数。
summary.en: Each vowel permits only certain following vowels; count length-n vowel strings.

summary.zh: N 天销售商品，每日可进货或卖货但只能选其一，求最大利润。
summary.en: Sell goods over N days; each day either buy or sell exactly one unit; maximize profit.

summary.en: Chunk List is a ds algorithm.

summary.zh: 基于动态数组 + 双指针（head/tail）的双端队列，两端均 O(1)。
summary.en: A dynamic-array deque with head/tail pointers giving O(1) at both ends.

summary.zh: 稀疏表 Sparse Table属于ds类别。
summary.en: Sparse Table is a ds algorithm.

summary.zh: 双向链表属于ds类别。
