complexity.time: O(1) 端点增删 / O(n) 查找

summary.zh: 迭代方式插入并维护平衡的自平衡二叉搜索树。
summary.en: Iteratively insert into a self-balancing BST maintaining AVL property.

summary.zh: 插入与查找的 AVL 平衡二叉搜索树（节点带高度）。
summary.en: AVL self-balancing BST with insert and search (height-tracked nodes).

title.zh: 数组分块（块状数组，区间和 + 点修改）
title.en: Block Decomposition (Sqrt Decomposition, Range Sum + Point Update)

summary.zh: 把数组按 √n 分块，预处理块和，支持 O(√n) 点修改与区间求和。
summary.en: Split the array into √n blocks with per-block sums; O(√n) point update and range sum.

summary.zh: 把数组分成 √n 大小的块，支持区间加 / 区间查询。
summary.en: Splits the array into √n-size blocks; supports range-add and range queries.

summary.zh: 阶为 4 的 B 树（即 2-3-4 树），插入时自顶向下分裂。
summary.en: Order-4 B-tree (a.k.a. 2-3-4 tree) with top-down splitting on insert.

summary.zh: 最小度数 t 的 B 树（插入 + 查找）。
summary.en: B-Tree of minimum degree t (insert and search).

title.zh: 并查集（路径压缩，无按秩）

summary.zh: 仅用路径压缩优化的并查集；find/union 近似 O(α(n))。
summary.en: DSU with path compression only; find/union nearly O(α(n)).

summary.zh: 离线处理三维偏序，用分治替代数据结构，常数更优。
summary.en: Offline 3D partial-order via divide-and-conquer, replacing heavy data structures.

summary.zh: 前缀和 + 单点更新，O(log n)，常数极小。
summary.en: Prefix sum + point update, O(log n) with a tiny constant.

summary.zh: 单点加 + 区间求和的经典 BIT。
summary.en: Classic BIT: point add + range sum.

summary.zh: 差分树状数组支持区间加 + 单点查询。
summary.en: Difference Fenwick supporting range add + point query.

title.zh: 开放寻址哈希表（线性探测）

summary.zh: 用数组 + 线性探测解决冲突的哈希表，支持 put/get/delete。
summary.en: Array-based hash table using linear probing for collisions; supports put/get/delete.

summary.zh: 把树按「重儿子」剖分成若干重链，使任意路径 O(log n) 条链组成。
summary.en: Splits a tree into heavy chains via the heavy child; any path is O(log n) chains.

complexity.time: O(n) build, O(log n) per query

summary.zh: 二维 K-D 树 + 剪枝搜索最近邻，平均 O(log n)。
summary.en: 2D k-d tree with pruned nearest-neighbor search; average O(log n).

summary.zh: 维护一组直线在 x 上取最大值的线段树。
summary.en: Segment tree maintaining max over lines at each x.

summary.zh: 维护若干线性函数，支持区间插入与查询 x 处最大值。
summary.en: Maintains a set of linear functions; supports segment insertion and max-at-x query.

summary.zh: 用 Splay 辅助森林维护动态树，支持 link/cut/连通查询 O(log n) 摊还。
summary.en: Splay-based auxiliary forest maintaining a dynamic tree; link/cut/connected in O(log n) amortized.

summary.zh: 支持区间内“小于等于某值的元素个数”查询。
summary.en: Supports "count of elements ≤ k in subarray" queries.

summary.zh: 每个区间维护排序后的数组，支持区间第 k 小 / 区间内 <= x 计数。
summary.en: Each segment stores a sorted subarray; supports range k-th smallest / range <= x count.

title.zh: Mo 算法（离线区间查询）

summary.zh: 把区间查询排序后用双指针滑动维护答案，O((n+q)√n) 解静态区间众数类问题。
summary.en: Sort queries then slide a two-pointer window maintaining the answer; O((n+q)√n) for static range-mode queries.

summary.zh: 维护单调性的双端队列，O(n) 求所有定长滑动窗口的最值。
summary.en: Deque preserving monotonicity; O(n) min/max over all fixed-length sliding windows.

summary.zh: 维护单调性的栈，求每个元素左/右首个更大/更小元素。
summary.en: Stack preserving monotonicity; finds the nearest greater/smaller element for each item.

title.zh: 单调双端队列（滑动窗口最值）

summary.zh: 基于双端队列维护单调性，O(n) 求每个定长滑动窗口的最小/最大值。
summary.en: Maintain monotonicity with a deque; O(n) compute min/max of each fixed-length sliding window.

summary.zh: 每次更新新建一条根到叶的路径，保留所有历史版本。
summary.en: Each update creates a new root-to-leaf path, preserving all historical versions.

summary.zh: 支持历史版本查询的主席树（k 小值）。
summary.en: Persistent seg tree supporting version queries (k-th smallest).

title.zh: 可降键优先队列（索引最小堆）

summary.zh: 带 decrease-key 的索引二叉最小堆，支持按 id O(log n) 修改优先级。
summary.en: Indexed binary min-heap with decrease-key; O(log n) priority change by id.

title.zh: 四叉树（二维矩形区域查询）

summary.zh: 把二维平面递归四等分，支持矩形范围内点查询 O(√n) 量级。
summary.en: Recursively quarter the 2D plane; rectangular range query over points in ~O(√n).

title.zh: R 树（最小外接矩形，范围查询）

summary.zh: 用最小外接矩形（MBR）聚合子节点，支持二维矩形范围查询。
summary.en: Aggregates children by minimum bounding rectangles (MBR); 2D rectangular range query.

summary.zh: 左倾红黑树（LLRB），插入与删除保持近似平衡，操作 O(log n)。
summary.en: Left-leaning red-black tree (LLRB); insertions keep near-balance, O(log n) ops.

summary.zh: 左倾红黑树（LLRB）插入与查找。
summary.en: Left-Leaning Red-Black Tree (LLRB) insert and search.

summary.zh: 支持区间加、区间和查询，O(log n) 单次操作。
summary.en: Range-add updates and range-sum queries, both O(log n).

summary.zh: 单点更新 + 区间求和的线段树。
summary.en: Point update + range sum segment tree.

summary.zh: 支持区间赋值/查询最大值的线段树（带 lazy 标记）。
summary.en: Segment tree supporting range assign + range max with lazy propagation.

summary.zh: 用多级索引链表实现 O(log n) 查找/插入/删除。
summary.en: Multi-level indexed linked list giving O(log n) search/insert/delete.

summary.zh: 期望 O(log n) 查找/插入的概率平衡跳表。
summary.en: Probabilistically balanced skip list with expected O(log n) ops.

summary.zh: 多层链表实现有序集合，期望 O(log n) 插入/删除/查找。
summary.en: Multi-level linked list implementing an ordered set; expected O(log n) insert/delete/search.

summary.zh: 自调整 BST，每次访问将被访问节点旋转到根。
summary.en: Self-adjusting BST; rotates the accessed node to the root each time.

summary.zh: 自适应 BST：每次访问把节点旋转到根，摊还 O(log n)。
summary.en: Self-adjusting BST: each access splays the node to the root; amortized O(log n).

summary.zh: O(n log n) 预处理后 O(1) 查询静态区间最值（满足可重复贡献）。
summary.en: O(n log n) preprocessing then O(1) static range-min/max (idempotent queries).

summary.zh: BST + 堆，随机优先级维持平衡，期望深度 O(log n)。
summary.en: BST + heap; random priorities keep the tree balanced, expected depth O(log n).

summary.zh: 笛卡尔搜索树（键 = BST，优先级 = 堆）。
summary.en: Cartesian BST+Heap: key as BST, priority as heap.

title.zh: Treap（随机化平衡 BST 集合）

summary.zh: 按 key 排 BST + 按 priority 排堆，旋转维持平衡，期望 O(log n)。
summary.en: BST by key + heap by random priority; rotations keep balance; expected O(log n).

summary.zh: 在 O(log σ) 内查询区间第 k 小、区间排名、区间频率。
summary.en: Range k-th smallest, rank, frequency queries in O(log σ).

summary.zh: 支持区间第 k 小、排名、频率查询的静态结构。
summary.en: Static structure supporting range k-th smallest, rank, frequency.

summary.zh: 后缀树属于ds类别。
summary.en: Suffix Tree is a ds algorithm.

summary.zh: 树堆属于ds类别。
summary.en: Treap is a ds algorithm.

summary.zh: 旋转式 Treap：BST 按键、堆按随机优先级，插入删除用旋转维护。
summary.en: A rotation-based Treap: BST by key, heap by random priority, maintained via rotations.

summary.zh: 字典树属于ds类别。
summary.en: Trie is a ds algorithm.

complexity.time: O(L) 插入/查找，L = 键长

summary.zh: 压缩字典树 Radix Tree属于ds类别。

summary.zh: 并查集属于ds类别。
summary.en: Union-Find (DSU) is a ds algorithm.

title.zh: 马尔可夫奖励过程最优

summary.zh: 在 MRP 上贝尔曼方程求状态价值函数 V = R + γPV。
summary.en: Bellman equation on an MRP: state values V = R + γPV via linear solve.

summary.zh: A 加速、R 反向，求到达目标位置的最短指令数（BFS/DP）。
summary.en: A to accelerate, R to reverse; shortest instructions to reach target (BFS/DP).

summary.zh: 分治凸包的合并步：找到两个凸包的公切线（上/下桥），裁掉被「夹住」的内部弧后拼接。
summary.en: The merge step of divide-and-conquer hulls: find the common tangents (upper/lower bridge), clip the inner arcs, and stitch.

summary.zh: A* 寻路属于graph类别。
summary.en: A* Search is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: Floyd-Warshall 三重循环 + next 表，重建任意两点最短路径。
summary.en: Floyd-Warshall triple loop plus a next table to rebuild shortest paths.

summary.zh: 标准 DFS 模板求无向连通图的割点（关节点）。
summary.en: Standard DFS template to find articulation points in an undirected connected graph.

summary.zh: Bellman-Ford 最短路属于graph类别。
summary.en: Bellman-Ford is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 广度优先搜索属于graph类别。
summary.en: Breadth-First Search is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: BFS 交替染 0/1 两色判定二分图。
summary.en: BFS alternating 0/1 coloring to test bipartiteness.

summary.zh: 广度优先按层扩散，记录每一层顶点与距离。
summary.en: Breadth-first expansion layer by layer, recording members and distance.

summary.zh: DFS 维护 dfn/low 与边栈，求无向图的块与割点。
summary.en: DFS with dfn/low and an edge stack to find blocks and cut vertices.

summary.zh: 二分图判定（染色法）属于graph类别。
summary.en: Bipartite Check (Coloring) is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 二分图点覆盖属于graph类别。
summary.en: Bipartite Vertex Cover is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 桥属于graph类别。
summary.en: Bridge is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 桥与割点属于graph类别。
summary.en: Bridges & Articulation Points is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 迭代版 DFS 求无向图的桥（割边）。
summary.en: Iterative DFS to find bridges (cut edges) in an undirected graph.

summary.zh: 仙人掌DP属于graph类别。
summary.en: Cactus DP is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 笛卡尔树属于graph类别。
summary.en: Cartesian Tree is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 圆方树属于graph类别。
summary.en: Circle Double Tree is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 点分治属于graph类别。
summary.en: Centroid Decomposition is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 最大基数搜索求消元序，再验证是否为完美消除序列。
summary.en: MCS for an elimination order, then verify it is a perfect elimination order.

summary.zh: Welsh-Powell：按度数降序，每点取最小可用颜色。
summary.en: Welsh-Powell: order by degree desc, assign the smallest free color.

summary.zh: 割点属于graph类别。
summary.en: Cut Vertex is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 深度优先搜索属于graph类别。
summary.en: Depth-First Search is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: Dijkstra 最短路径属于graph类别。
summary.en: Dijkstra is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 二叉堆优化的 Dijkstra 单源最短路（非负权）。
summary.en: Binary-heap optimized Dijkstra single-source shortest path (non-negative weights).

summary.zh: Dinic 最大流属于graph类别。
summary.en: Dinic Max Flow is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: Dinic加权属于graph类别。
summary.en: Dinic Weighted is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 支配树属于graph类别。
summary.en: Dominator Tree is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 树上启发式合并属于graph类别。
summary.en: DSU on Tree is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: DFS 找桥，删桥后的连通块即边双连通分量。
summary.en: Find bridges via DFS; components after removing bridges are edge-biconnected.

summary.zh: 有向MST属于graph类别。
summary.en: Edmonds MST is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: Hierholzer 算法求经过每条边恰好一次的闭合回路。
summary.en: Hierholzer finds a closed trail using every edge exactly once.

summary.zh: 欧拉路径（Hierholzer）属于graph类别。
summary.en: Euler Path (Hierholzer) is a graph algorithm.

title.zh: 欧拉序（树上 DFS 序）

summary.zh: 对树做 DFS，进入与离开每个节点时都记录，得到欧拉序。
summary.en: DFS a tree recording entry and exit of each node to form the Euler tour array.

summary.zh: Floyd-Warshall 全源最短路属于graph类别。
summary.en: Floyd-Warshall is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 同一邮箱视为同人，合并所有同邮箱账户。
summary.en: Treat accounts sharing an email as one person; merge them.

summary.zh: 由词典中词的相对顺序推出字母的拓扑序。
summary.en: Infer the topological order of alien letters from a sorted word list.

summary.zh: 网格寻路用 A* 配合曼哈顿距离启发，求最短步数路径。
summary.en: Grid pathfinding via A* with Manhattan-distance heuristic for shortest step path.

summary.zh: 支持负权边的单源最短路，并能检测从源可达的负权环。
summary.en: Single-source shortest path with negative edges; detects reachable negative cycles.

summary.zh: 广度优先搜索同时记录每个节点所在的层数，逐层展示扩展过程。
summary.en: BFS recording the depth of each node, expanding one layer at a time.

summary.zh: 在二维网格上广度优先搜索，求最短步数或连通区域。
summary.en: Breadth-first search on a 2D grid for shortest steps or connected regions.

summary.zh: 从源和目标同时 BFS，相遇即得无权图最短路。
summary.en: BFS from both source and target; meet-in-the-middle yields the shortest path.

summary.zh: BFS 给每个节点染色，相邻必须异色，遇冲突即非二分图。
summary.en: BFS-assign colors such that adjacent vertices differ; conflict means not bipartite.

summary.zh: 最小化生成树中最大边权（MBST），等价于 MST 的瓶颈。
summary.en: Minimize the maximum edge weight in a spanning tree (MBST); equals the MST bottleneck.

summary.zh: 展开形如 {a,b}c{d,e} 的表达式为所有组合的字典序。
summary.en: Expand an expression like {a,b}c{d,e} into all sorted combinations.

summary.zh: 找出无向图中删除后会使图不连通的边（桥）。
summary.en: Find edges whose removal disconnects the graph (bridges).

summary.zh: 在最多 k 次中转内从 src 到 dst 的最便宜机票。
summary.en: Cheapest flight from src to dst using at most k stops (Bellman-Ford).

summary.zh: 按节点顺序贪心染最小可用色，相邻不同色。
summary.en: Color each vertex with the smallest color not used by its neighbors.

summary.zh: 按节点重要性依次收缩并加捷径，查询时双向 Dijkstra 只上行。
summary.en: Contract nodes by importance adding shortcuts; bidirectional Dijkstra goes upward only.

summary.zh: 输出一种合法的修课顺序（拓扑序），不可行返回空。
summary.en: Return a valid course order (topological order); empty if infeasible.

summary.zh: 判断给定的先修依赖能否全部修完（无环 DAG）。
summary.en: Determine if all courses can be finished given prerequisites (acyclic check).

summary.zh: 找出无向图中删除后会增加连通分量数的节点（割点 / 关节点）。
summary.en: Find vertices whose removal increases the number of connected components.

summary.zh: 用白/灰/黑三色标记节点状态，便于检测回边（环）。
summary.en: Color nodes white→gray→black to detect back edges and cycles during DFS.

summary.zh: 深度优先遍历网格，对连通的 1 染色，求岛屿数。
summary.en: Depth-first traversal colors connected 1-cells; count distinct islands.

title.zh: Dijkstra（优先队列 + 前驱记录）

summary.zh: 二叉堆优化的单源最短路，并记录前驱以重构最短路径。
summary.en: Binary-heap Dijkstra single-source shortest path, tracking predecessors for path reconstruction.

summary.zh: 从源与汇同时 Dijkstra，相遇即停，加速单源单汇最短路。
summary.en: Run Dijkstra from both source and target; stop on meeting to speed up single-pair shortest path.

summary.zh: 动态选「邻居已用色最多」的节点着色，启发式接近最优。
summary.en: Repeatedly color the vertex whose neighbors use the most distinct colors (saturation).

summary.zh: 为每条边分配颜色使相邻边不同色，贪心用 Δ 或 Δ+1 种色。
summary.en: Assign colors to edges so adjacent edges differ; greedy uses Δ or Δ+1 colors.

summary.zh: BFS 求迷宫从起点到出口的最短步数路径。
summary.en: BFS for the shortest step path from entrance to exit in a maze.

summary.zh: Hierholzer 算法求无向图欧拉回路：当所有顶点度数均为偶数时存在。
summary.en: Hierholzer: find an Euler circuit when every vertex has even degree.

summary.zh: 动态规划求出所有节点对之间的最短路，支持负权（无负环）。
summary.en: DP-based all-pairs shortest paths; tolerates negative edges (no negative cycles).

summary.zh: 回溯搜索经过每个顶点恰好一次并回到起点的回路。
summary.en: Backtracking search for a cycle visiting every vertex exactly once and returning.

summary.zh: 以启发式 f 为阈值迭代加深深度优先搜索，空间极省。
summary.en: Iteratively deepen DFS bounded by heuristic f-threshold; minimal memory.

summary.zh: 染色法判断无向图能否二分（相邻异色）。
summary.en: Two-color each component to test if the graph is bipartite.

summary.zh: VF2 风格回溯：建双射并验证邻域一致性。
summary.en: VF2-style backtracking: build a bijection and verify neighborhood consistency.

title.zh: Kruskal 最小生成树（并查集）

summary.zh: 将边按权升序排序，逐条尝试加入，用并查集判环。
summary.en: Sort edges ascending; add each if its endpoints are in different components (union-find).

summary.zh: 预选若干地标求最短距离下界，加速 A*。
summary.en: Precompute distances to landmark vertices to derive lower bounds that speed up A*.

summary.zh: 预处理 fa[k][v] 后 O(log n) 回答树上任意两点的 LCA。
summary.en: Preprocess binary-lifting table; answer LCA queries in O(log n) each.

summary.zh: 回溯枚举所有团，求节点数最多的完全子图。
summary.en: Backtrack over vertices to find the largest complete subgraph.

summary.zh: BFS 反复在残量图上找增广路径，求源点到汇点的最大流。
summary.en: Repeatedly BFS for augmenting paths in the residual graph to maximize s-t flow.

summary.zh: 贪心选「覆盖最多未支配节点」的节点，构造支配集。
summary.en: Greedily pick vertices covering the most undominated vertices to build a dominating set.

summary.zh: Prim 算法从一个起点不断加入最短横切边构造 MST。
summary.en: Prim grows an MST from a start by repeatedly adding the shortest crossing edge.

summary.zh: 在无向树中选根使树高最小（拓扑剥叶法）。
summary.en: Pick tree roots that minimize the tree height (peeling leaves).

summary.zh: 贪心 2-近似：不断取一条边加入匹配，两端都进覆盖。
summary.en: Greedy 2-approximation: repeatedly pick an edge and add both endpoints to the cover.

summary.zh: 删除一个感染节点使最终被感染节点数最少。
summary.en: Remove one infected node to minimize the final number of infected nodes.

summary.zh: 每轮每个连通块各自选最短出边合并，直到只剩一个连通块。
summary.en: Each round, every component selects its cheapest outgoing edge; merge until one component remains.

summary.zh: 树形 DP 求权值和最大的独立集（相邻不取）。
summary.en: Tree DP for the independent set of maximum total weight (no two adjacent).

summary.zh: 信号从源点发出，求所有节点收到信号的时间（最大单源最短路）。
summary.en: A signal spreads from a source; find the time until all nodes receive it (max SSSP).

summary.zh: 从 0000 转 K 把避开死锁达到目标，求最少步数。
summary.en: Turn a 4-wheel lock from 0000 to target avoiding deadends; find min turns.

summary.zh: 从一个起点出发逐步扩张，每次选最小权边把新节点加入生成树。
summary.en: Grow a tree from a source by repeatedly adding the lightest crossing edge.

summary.zh: 从源点出发遍历，列出所有可达节点。
summary.en: Traverse from a source and list all nodes reachable from it.

summary.zh: 每条边细分为若干子节点，给定步数限制求可达节点数。
summary.en: Edges are subdivided into intermediate nodes; count nodes reachable within a budget.

summary.zh: 无向图多了一条边成环，找出最后一条构成环的边。
summary.en: In an undirected graph with one extra edge forming a cycle, find that redundant edge.

summary.zh: 把每格放大成 3×3 像素，用并查集统计被斜杠切出的区域数。
summary.en: Upscale each cell to 3×3 pixels and count regions via union-find.

summary.zh: 贪心试探给变量赋值，最大化被满足的 3-CNF 子句数。
summary.en: Greedy assignment maximizing the number of satisfied 3-CNF clauses.

summary.zh: 两遍 DFS 求有向图 SCC：先正图求后序，再反图按倒序访问。
summary.en: Two-pass DFS: first on the graph to get finish order, then on the reverse graph in reverse finish order.

summary.zh: 严格次小生成树：在所有生成树中权值第二小的。
summary.en: Strict second-best spanning tree: the second-smallest total weight among all spanning trees.

summary.zh: 判断 org 是否为给定子序列唯一可重建的超序列。
summary.en: Check if org is the unique reconstruction from given subsequences.

summary.zh: 两串最多差 2 个字符算相似，求相似连通分量数。
summary.en: Strings differing in at most 2 positions are similar; count connected components.
2×3 sliding puzzle; reach [[1,2,3],[4,5,0]] with minimum moves.

summary.zh: BFS 求 n×n 蛇梯棋盘从 1 到 n² 的最少掷骰次数。
summary.en: BFS for fewest dice rolls from 1 to n² on an n×n snakes-and-ladders board.

summary.zh: 对有向无环图先拓扑排序，再按拓扑序一次松弛得到单源最短路。
summary.en: Topologically sort a DAG, then relax edges once in topo order for single-source shortest path.

summary.zh: 多个石源同时蔓延，求每个空格到最近石源的距离。
summary.en: Multiple stone sources spread at once; find each empty cell distance to nearest source.

summary.zh: 每次改一个字符把起点串变终点串，中途必须在词典中，求最短步数。
summary.en: Change one char per step to morph start into end through dictionary words; min steps.

summary.zh: 把被 X 完全包围的 O 区域翻转为 X，边界相连的 O 保留。
summary.en: Flip O-regions fully surrounded by X to X; keep O-regions connected to the border.

summary.zh: 单次 DFS 求有向图所有强连通分量（SCC）。
summary.en: Single DFS to find all strongly connected components of a directed graph.

summary.zh: 反复选入度为 0 的节点并删除其出边，得到有向图的拓扑序。
summary.en: Repeatedly remove zero-indegree vertices to produce a topological order.

summary.zh: 用并查集统计无向图的连通分量数。
summary.en: Count connected components of an undirected graph via union-find.

summary.zh: 多源 BFS：每个空房到最近门的距离。
summary.en: Multi-source BFS: distance from each empty room to its nearest gate.

summary.zh: 按度数降序贪心着色，给出上界 Δ+1 以内的着色。
summary.en: Greedy coloring by descending degree; yields a coloring within Δ+1.

summary.zh: 单源 BFS：每次改一个字母在词典中前进，求最短步数。
summary.en: Single-source BFS changing one letter per step through the dictionary; min steps.

title.zh: 单词接龙 II（所有最短）

summary.zh: BFS + 回溯，求从 beginWord 到 endWord 的所有最短转换序列。
summary.en: BFS plus backtracking to list all shortest transformation sequences.

summary.zh: 回溯搜索经过每个顶点恰好一次并回到起点的回路。
summary.en: Backtracking for a cycle visiting each vertex exactly once.

summary.zh: 树链剖分属于graph类别。
summary.en: Heavy-Light Decomposition is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 完整重链剖分：两遍 DFS 求 size/depth/parent/top，支持路径查询/更新。
summary.en: Full heavy-light decomposition: two DFS passes for size/depth/parent/top, supporting path queries.

title.zh: 匈牙利算法（二分图最大匹配）

summary.zh: 匈牙利算法（二分图最大匹配）属于graph类别。
summary.en: Hungarian Algorithm (Bipartite Matching) is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: Johnson 全源最短路属于graph类别。
summary.en: Johnson is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 第K短路属于graph类别。
summary.en: Kth Shortest is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: Kosaraju优化属于graph类别。
summary.en: Kosaraju Refine is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: Kruskal 最小生成树属于graph类别。
summary.en: Kruskal MST is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 可撤销并查集 + Kruskal，支持回退合并操作。
summary.en: Undoable union-find Kruskal supporting rollback of merges.

summary.zh: LCA并查集属于graph类别。
summary.en: LCA Tarjan is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: Hopcroft-Karp 匹配属于graph类别。
summary.en: Hopcroft-Karp is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: Bron-Kerbosch 带 pivot 与退化序，枚举极大团并取最大者。
summary.en: Bron-Kerbosch with pivoting and degeneracy order finds the largest clique.

summary.zh: 分支定界：按顶点「取/不取」二分递归，上界剪枝。
summary.en: Branch and bound: split on include/exclude of a vertex, prune by upper bound.

summary.zh: 最小费用最大流属于graph类别。
summary.en: Min Cost Max Flow is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: Eades 启发式构造线性序，反向边即反馈弧集。
summary.en: Eades heuristic builds a linear order; backward edges form the feedback arc set.

summary.zh: 次小生成树属于graph类别。
summary.en: Second MST is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 倍增LCA属于graph类别。
summary.en: Multiplication LCA is a graph algorithm.

complexity.time: O(n log n) build, O(log n) query

summary.zh: Prim 最小生成树属于graph类别。
summary.en: Prim MST is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: Fibonacci 堆实现的 Prim 最小生成树。
summary.en: Prim MST implemented with a Fibonacci heap.

summary.zh: Prufer编码属于graph类别。
summary.en: Prufer Code is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: RMQ求LCA属于graph类别。
summary.en: RMQ-LCA is a graph algorithm.

complexity.time: O(n log n) build, O(1) query

summary.zh: SAP最大流属于graph类别。
summary.en: SAP Max Flow is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 单遍 DFS 配双栈（path 与 boundary）求强连通分量。
summary.en: Single-pass DFS with two stacks (path + boundary) for SCC.

summary.zh: 两遍 DFS 求有向图强连通分量：原图求完成序，反图按序摘树。
summary.en: Two-pass DFS for SCC: finish order on G, then DFS on reversed G.

summary.zh: 强连通迭代属于graph类别。
summary.en: SCC Iterative is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 递归版 Tarjan 算法求有向图的强连通分量。
summary.en: Recursive Tarjan algorithm for strongly connected components.

summary.zh: DAG最短路属于graph类别。
summary.en: DAG Shortest is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 最短路径 SPFA属于graph类别。
summary.en: SPFA is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: SPFA 队列优化 Bellman-Ford，检测负权环。
summary.en: SPFA (queue-based Bellman-Ford) to detect negative-weight cycles.

summary.zh: Dreyfus-Wagner DP：连接给定终点集的最小权子树。
summary.en: Dreyfus-Wagner DP for the min-weight subtree spanning given terminals.

summary.zh: 强连通分量（Kosaraju）属于graph类别。
summary.en: Strongly Connected (Kosaraju) is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: Tarjan 强连通分量属于graph类别。
summary.en: Tarjan SCC is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 拓扑排序属于graph类别。
summary.en: Topological Sort is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 树重心属于graph类别。
summary.en: Tree Centroid is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 树的直径属于graph类别。
summary.en: Tree Diameter is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 树哈希属于graph类别。
summary.en: Tree Hash is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 2-SAT属于graph类别。
summary.en: 2-SAT is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 点双连通属于graph类别。
summary.en: Vertex Biconnected is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 虚树属于graph类别。
summary.en: Virtual Tree is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 0-1 BFS属于graph类别。
summary.en: 0-1 BFS is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 活动选择属于greedy类别。
summary.en: Activity Selection is a greedy algorithm.

summary.zh: 分发饼干属于greedy类别。
summary.en: Assign Cookies is a greedy algorithm.

summary.zh: 相邻孩子得分高者糖果更多，求最少糖果总数（左右两遍扫描）。
summary.en: Higher-scoring neighbors get more candies; minimize total (two-pass scan).

summary.zh: 从两个数组各取若干位保持相对顺序，拼成最大的 k 位数。
summary.en: Pick digits from two arrays (keeping order) to form the largest k-digit number.

summary.zh: Dijkstra 最短路属于greedy类别。
summary.en: Dijkstra Shortest Path is a greedy algorithm.

summary.zh: R 派与 D 派轮流禁止对方投票，求最终胜方（贪心 + 双队列）。
summary.en: R and D factions alternate banning each other; find the winner (greedy, two queues).

summary.zh: 分数背包属于greedy类别。
summary.en: Fractional Knapsack is a greedy algorithm.

summary.zh: 分数背包属于greedy类别。
summary.en: Fractional Knapsack is a greedy algorithm.

summary.zh: 加油站属于greedy类别。
summary.en: Gas Station is a greedy algorithm.

summary.zh: 经典活动选择：n 个活动带起止时间，选最多可执行的活动。
summary.en: Classic activity selection: n activities with start/end times; pick the maximum feasible subset.

summary.zh: 每块饼干满足一个胃口不大于它的孩子；最大化满足数。
summary.en: Each cookie satisfies a child whose greed is no larger; maximize satisfied children.

complexity.time: O(n log n + m log m)

summary.zh: 从起点反复访问最近未访问城市，贪心构造 TSP 近似回路。
summary.en: From a start city repeatedly visit the nearest unvisited city for a TSP approximation.

summary.zh: 每个物品放入剩余空间最小但能容纳的箱子，减少碎片。
summary.en: Place each item in the bin with the least leftover room that still fits; reduces fragmentation.

summary.zh: 物品降序排列，每个放入第一个能容纳的箱子，近似比 11/9。
summary.en: Sort items descending, place each in the first bin that fits; ratio 11/9.

summary.zh: 按边顺序贪心选不相交边，得到近似最大匹配。
summary.en: Greedily pick non-conflicting edges in order for an approximate maximum matching.

summary.zh: 每船最多两人且总重不超限，求救所有人所需最少船数。
summary.en: Each boat carries at most two with total weight under a limit; find the minimum boats to save all.

title.zh: 破界贪心（0-1 背包 LP 上界）

summary.zh: 用线性松弛贪心求 0-1 背包的上界，供分支限界剪枝使用。
summary.en: Use linear-relaxation greedy to bound the 0-1 knapsack optimum, for branch-and-bound pruning.

summary.zh: 每个孩子至少 1 颗糖，相邻评分高的得更多；两遍扫描求最少糖。
summary.en: Each child gets ≥1 candy, more than neighbors with lower ratings; two sweeps find the minimum.

summary.zh: 检查硬币系统能否贪心求解，刻画 canonical 货币系统。
summary.en: Verify whether a coin system admits greedy-optimal change; characterize canonical systems.

summary.zh: 按面额降序每次尽量取最大硬币；仅对规范币系保证最优。
summary.en: Take as many of the largest denomination as possible; optimal only for canonical systems.

summary.zh: 非负权图单源最短路径：每次扩展距离最小的未确定顶点。
summary.en: Single-source shortest path with non-negative weights: relax via the closest unsettled vertex.

summary.zh: 给定若干商品价格与"满 threshold 减 deduction"规则，求购买总成本最低。
summary.en: Given item prices and a "spend threshold, get deduction" coupon, minimize total cost.

summary.zh: 两阵营轮流投票禁对方；用队列贪心先禁下一个对方。
summary.en: Two factions vote to ban each other in turn; greedily ban the next opponent using queues.

summary.zh: 在两枢轴快速排序中贪心选取使分区最均衡的枢轴对。
summary.en: In dual-pivot quicksort greedily pick the pivot pair giving the most balanced partition.

title.zh: 区间调度（最早结束优先）

summary.zh: 在若干区间中选出最多的互不重叠子集。
summary.en: Select the largest subset of mutually non-overlapping intervals.

summary.zh: 为每条边分配不同于邻接边的颜色，使用 Δ+1 色。
summary.en: Assign each edge a color distinct from adjacent edges; uses at most Δ+1 colors.

summary.zh: 物品可分割：按单位价值降序贪心装包直到容量满。
summary.en: Items are divisible: pack by descending value-per-unit until capacity is exhausted.

summary.zh: 环形路 gas[i] − cost[i]；若总油 ≥ 总耗则存在唯一起点。
summary.en: On a circuit, gas[i] − cost[i]; if total gas ≥ total cost, a unique start exists.

summary.zh: 环形路 N 个加油站，求能跑完一圈的起始站下标。
summary.en: N gas stations on a ring; find a starting index from which a full circuit is possible.

summary.zh: 二分图存在完美匹配当且仅当每个左侧子集的邻居数不少于自身大小。
summary.en: A bipartite graph has a perfect matching iff every left subset has at least as many neighbors.

summary.zh: 按频率贪心合并最小的两个节点，构造最优前缀码。
summary.en: Greedily merge the two least-frequent nodes to build an optimal prefix code.

summary.zh: 动态构建哈夫曼树，无需预先知道频率，适合流式压缩。
summary.en: Build Huffman tree dynamically without prior frequencies; suited for streaming compression.

summary.zh: 由码长生成规范编码，码表紧凑，解码高效。
summary.en: Generate canonical codes from code lengths; compact tables, fast decoding.

summary.zh: 把一个新区间插入已排序的不重叠区间列表，合并重叠部分。
summary.en: Insert a new interval into a sorted non-overlapping list and merge overlaps.

summary.zh: 按结束时间升序选不重叠区间，得到最大数量。
summary.en: Sort intervals by end time and greedily pick non-overlapping ones for maximum count.

summary.zh: 给重叠区间分配最少颜色，等价于会议室安排，扫描线贪心。
summary.en: Assign minimum colors to overlapping intervals; sweep-line greedy equals meeting-room allocation.

summary.zh: 每个作业有利润和截止期，每个时间槽只能做一个；最大化总利润。
summary.en: Each job has profit and deadline, one job per slot; maximize total profit.

summary.zh: 维护当前能到达的最远位置 maxReach，逐位扫描。
summary.en: Maintain the furthest reachable index maxReach; scan left to right.

summary.zh: 0/1 背包按价值密度贪心取整，作为 DP 最优解的上界与近似。
summary.en: 0/1 knapsack greedy by value density serves as upper bound and approximation to DP optimum.

summary.zh: 按边权升序加入不形成环的边，直到生成树完成。
summary.en: Sort edges by weight ascending; add edges that do not create a cycle until the spanning tree is complete.

summary.zh: 用最少定长线段覆盖所有点，按右端点贪心放置。
summary.en: Cover all points with the fewest fixed-length segments; place greedily by right endpoint.

summary.zh: 按优先级列表把就绪任务贪心分配到空闲机器，经典并行调度。
summary.en: Assign ready tasks to idle machines by a priority list; classic parallel scheduling.

summary.zh: 按作业时长降序，每次把作业分给最闲机器，近似比 4/3-1/(3m)。
summary.en: Sort jobs descending, assign each to the least-loaded machine; ratio 4/3-1/(3m).

summary.zh: 求两个拟阵公共独立集的最大基数，贪心增广。
summary.en: Find the largest set independent in two matroids simultaneously via augmenting paths.

summary.zh: 把顶点分到两侧使跨越边数最大，贪心按当前贡献放置。
summary.en: Split vertices into two sides maximizing crossing edges; place each by current contribution.

summary.zh: 求某一时刻同时被多少个区间覆盖的最大值。
summary.en: Find the maximum number of intervals overlapping at any point.

summary.zh: 把一组数拼成最大字符串：按 xy vs yx 字典序降序排。
summary.en: Concatenate numbers into the largest string; sort by xy-vs-yx lexicographic order.

summary.zh: 选最多 k 名工程师，最大化 min(效率) × sum(速度)，用堆维护。
summary.en: Choose at most k engineers to maximize min(efficiency) × sum(speed), maintained with a heap.

summary.zh: 在时间不重叠约束下，选择工作使总利润最大（带权区间调度）。
summary.en: Choose non-overlapping jobs to maximize total profit (weighted interval scheduling).

summary.zh: 卡车容量有限，每类箱子含不同单元数，贪心选单元数最大的箱子。
summary.en: Limited truck slots; box types carry different units; greedily pick highest-unit boxes.

summary.zh: 判断一组会议时间是否互不重叠（能否用一间会议室安排）。
summary.en: Check whether a set of meeting intervals are non-overlapping (fit in one room).

summary.zh: 求安排所有会议所需的最少会议室数（最大并发重叠数）。
summary.en: Find the minimum number of meeting rooms needed (maximum concurrent overlap).

summary.zh: 把所有重叠的区间合并，返回不重叠区间列表。
summary.en: Merge all overlapping intervals and return the non-overlapping list.

summary.zh: 数轴上若干气球区间，一支箭可射爆重叠的一组，求最少箭数。
summary.en: Balloons as intervals on a line; one arrow bursts an overlapping group; find the minimum arrows.

summary.zh: 从最左点开始，每次选使所有点同侧的下一顶点，贪心包出凸包。
summary.en: Start at the leftmost point; each step pick the next vertex keeping all points on one side.

summary.zh: 一维花园长 n，每个水龙头浇灌范围 [i−r, i+r]，求浇满整段的最少水龙头数。
summary.en: A length-n garden; tap i covers [i−r, i+r]; find the minimum taps to water the whole strip.

summary.zh: 反复选最大度数顶点加入覆盖，近似最大匹配上界。
summary.en: Repeatedly add the highest-degree vertex to the cover; approximates the matching upper bound.

summary.zh: 求 ≤ n 的最大单调（不降）数字；从右向左修复下降点。
summary.en: Largest number ≤ n whose digits are non-decreasing; fix descent points right to left.

summary.zh: 每轮每个连通块选最短出边并行合并，O(log V) 轮完成。
summary.en: Each round every component picks its cheapest outgoing edge in parallel; O(log V) rounds.

summary.zh: 把数分到 k 组使各组之和尽量均衡，贪心降序分配。
summary.en: Partition numbers into k groups with balanced sums; greedy descending assignment.

summary.zh: 删除最少数量区间使剩余互不重叠。
summary.en: Remove the minimum intervals so the rest are non-overlapping.

summary.zh: 缓存满时按 LRU/FIFO 贪心淘汰，分析竞争比。
summary.en: When cache is full evict by LRU/FIFO greedily; analyze competitive ratio.

summary.zh: 把字符串分成尽量多段，使每个字母只出现在一段里。
summary.en: Split a string into as many parts as possible so each letter appears in only one part.

summary.zh: 贪心排序把一组字符串拼成字典序最小的结果。
summary.en: Greedily sort a set of strings to concatenate into the lexicographically smallest result.

summary.zh: 从一个起点出发，每次加入到已选集距离最小的边。
summary.en: From a start vertex, repeatedly add the cheapest edge connecting the tree to a new vertex.

summary.zh: 低优先级任务持锁时临时继承最高等待者优先级，避免反转。
summary.en: A low-priority task holding a lock inherits the highest waiter priority, avoiding inversion.

summary.zh: 每个人 [h,k]：k 是前面 ≥ h 的人数；按 h 降序、k 升序插入。
summary.en: Each [h,k]: k is the count of people ahead with height ≥ h; insert by h desc, k asc.

summary.zh: 汽车油箱有限，沿途有加油站，求到达终点最少加油次数。
summary.en: Car with limited tank and stations along the way; find the minimum refuels to reach the target.

summary.zh: 按分数降序给运动员排名，前三名冠/亚/季军。
summary.en: Rank athletes by score descending; top three get medals.

summary.zh: 从数字字符串中删 k 位使剩余数最小；用单调栈。
summary.en: Remove k digits from the string to minimize the remaining number; use a monotonic stack.

summary.zh: 重排使相邻字符不同；按频率贪心填偶数位再奇数位。
summary.en: Rearrange so no two neighbors match; greedily fill even then odd slots by frequency.

summary.zh: 每次选能覆盖最多未覆盖元素的集合，得到 ln(n) 近似。
summary.en: Pick the set covering the most uncovered elements each step; ln(n) approximation.

title.zh: 集合覆盖 LP 舍入

summary.zh: 先解 LP 松弛再用贪心阈值舍入，得到 O(ln n) 近似。
summary.en: Solve the LP relaxation then round by threshold for an O(ln n) approximation.

summary.zh: 每天租或买断，未知总天数，最优确定性策略租到价格等于买价。
summary.en: Rent daily or buy once; unknown horizon; optimal deterministic strategy rents until cost equals buy price.

summary.zh: 理想跳表用概率分层达到 O(log n) 查找，分析期望层数。
summary.en: Ideal skip list uses probabilistic leveling for O(log n) search; analyze expected levels.

summary.zh: 用分段线性凸函数斜率变化堆维护贪心决策，求解序列型凸优化。
summary.en: Maintain piecewise-linear convex slope changes via a heap for greedy sequence convex optimization.

title.en: Split a String in Descending Order

summary.zh: 把字符串拆成最多段，每段数值严格递减。
summary.en: Split the string into the maximum number of pieces with strictly decreasing values.

summary.zh: 用固定印章把空白字符串盖成目标；反向贪心找可盖窗口。
summary.en: Stamp a blank string into target with a fixed stamp; greedily find stampable windows in reverse.

summary.zh: 在图中连接指定终端集，贪心扩展距离最近终端，近似比 2(1-1/l)。
summary.en: Connect a terminal set; greedily attach nearest terminal for 2(1-1/l) ratio.

summary.zh: 2n 人各去 A/B 两城，每城正好 n 人，最小化总费用。
summary.en: Send 2n people to cities A/B (n each) minimizing total cost.

summary.zh: 用若干片段拼接覆盖 [0,T]，求最少片段数。
summary.en: Stitch clips to cover [0,T]; find the minimum number of clips.

summary.zh: 把有限水分配到不同容量容器使最小水位最大，贪心按容量递增。
summary.en: Allocate limited water to containers to maximize the minimum water level; fill smallest first.

summary.zh: 按权重降序选不相交边，近似最大权匹配。
summary.en: Pick non-conflicting edges by descending weight for an approximate max-weight matching.

summary.zh: 求最长摆动子序列（相邻差严格正负交替）；贪心数拐点。
summary.en: Find the longest wiggle subsequence (strict alternating differences); greedily count turning points.

summary.zh: 合并果子属于greedy类别。
summary.en: Huffman Task is a greedy algorithm.

summary.zh: 区间覆盖属于greedy类别。
summary.en: Interval Cover is a greedy algorithm.

summary.zh: 作业调度属于greedy类别。
summary.en: Job Sequencing is a greedy algorithm.

summary.zh: 每格可跳 1..nums[i] 步，求到达终点的最少跳跃次数（贪心 BFS）。
summary.en: Each cell allows 1..nums[i] jumps; minimum jumps to reach the end (greedy BFS).

summary.zh: 每格可跳 1..nums[i] 步，判断能否到达终点（贪心维护最远可达）。
summary.en: Each cell allows 1..nums[i] jumps; can you reach the end? (greedy max-reach)

summary.zh: 单调递增数字属于greedy类别。
summary.en: Monotone Increasing Digits is a greedy algorithm.

summary.zh: 队列重建属于greedy类别。
summary.en: Queue Reconstruction is a greedy algorithm.

summary.zh: 按 [h,k] 重建队列，用空位计数法（区别于 splice 插入法）。
summary.en: Reconstruct queue from [h,k] via empty-slot counting (vs splice insertion).

summary.zh: 去重使每个字母出现一次且字典序最小（单调栈）。
summary.en: Remove duplicates so each letter appears once with minimal lex order (monotone stack).

summary.zh: 删除K个数字属于greedy类别。
summary.en: Remove K Digits is a greedy algorithm.

summary.zh: 重排字符串使相邻字符都不相同（贪心 + 计数）。
summary.en: Rearrange a string so no two neighbors are equal (greedy + count).

summary.zh: 集合覆盖属于greedy类别。
summary.en: Set Cover is a greedy algorithm.

summary.zh: 把数字串拆成斐波那契式序列（每段 = 前两项之和），回溯求解。
summary.en: Split a digit string into a Fibonacci-like sequence (each part = sum of two before), via backtracking.

summary.zh: 任务调度器属于greedy类别。
summary.en: Task Scheduler is a greedy algorithm.

summary.zh: 同类任务需 n 单位冷却，求完成所有任务的最短时间（公式法）。
summary.en: Same-type tasks need n cooldown; minimize total time (formula approach).

summary.zh: 摆动序列属于greedy类别。
summary.en: Wiggle Subsequence is a greedy algorithm.

summary.zh: Floyd 环检测属于list类别。
summary.en: Floyd is a list algorithm.

summary.zh: 链表插入排序属于list类别。
summary.en: Insertion Sort List is a list algorithm.

summary.zh: 逆序链表表示的两数逐位相加，进位向前。
summary.en: Add two numbers in reversed-list form digit by digit with carry forward.

summary.zh: 快慢指针定位并删除链表正中节点（LeetCode 2095）。
summary.en: Fast/slow pointers locate and remove the middle node (LeetCode 2095).

summary.zh: 双指针求 A − B 的差集。
summary.en: Two-pointer set difference A − B.

summary.zh: 双指针走完自身再走对方，相遇即交点。
summary.en: Two pointers swap heads after reaching the end; meet at the intersection.

summary.zh: 双指针求两条升序链表的交集。
summary.en: Two-pointer intersection of two ascending lists.

title.zh: 回文链表（快慢+反转后半）

summary.zh: 快慢指针找中点，反转后半段后与上半段逐一比较。
summary.en: Find midpoint with fast/slow pointers, reverse the second half and compare.

summary.zh: 一次遍历返回倒数第 k 个节点值。
summary.en: Return the kth node from the end in one pass.

summary.zh: 迭代合并两个升序链表为一个新的升序链表。
summary.en: Iteratively merge two ascending lists into one.

title.zh: 合并有序链表（哑节点变种）

summary.zh: 用哑节点逐节点拼接两条升序链表。
summary.en: Merge two ascending lists node-by-node with a dummy head.

summary.zh: 快慢指针一次遍历找链表中点。
summary.en: One-pass middle via fast/slow pointers.

summary.zh: 快慢指针一次找到链表中间节点。
summary.en: Fast and slow pointers find the middle node in one pass.

summary.zh: 快慢指针找中点后反转后半段比较判断回文。
summary.en: Check palindrome by reversing the second half and comparing.

summary.zh: 按基准值把链表拆成小于/大于等于两段再拼接。
summary.en: Split a list into less-than and greater-than-or-equal sublists, then concatenate.

summary.zh: 一次遍历删除倒数第 n 个节点。
summary.en: Remove the nth node from end in one pass.

summary.zh: 反转链表中从位置 left 到 right 的一段。
summary.en: Reverse the sublist between positions left and right (1-based).

summary.zh: 将链表向左旋转 k 位。
summary.en: Rotate the list left by k positions.

summary.zh: 将链表首尾相连成环，在断点处切开实现右旋。
summary.en: Close the list into a ring and cut at the break point to rotate right.

summary.zh: 以头节点为基准三路划分后递归排序。
summary.en: Three-way partition around the head pivot then recursively sort.

summary.zh: 哑节点法两两交换链表中相邻节点。
summary.en: Swap every two adjacent nodes using a dummy head.

summary.zh: 双指针归并两条升序链表为去重并集。
summary.en: Two-pointer merge into a deduplicated ascending union.

summary.zh: 奇偶链表属于list类别。
summary.en: Odd Even Linked List is a list algorithm.

summary.zh: 回文链表属于list类别。
summary.en: Palindrome List is a list algorithm.

summary.zh: 分隔链表属于list类别。
summary.en: Partition List is a list algorithm.

summary.zh: 反转链表属于list类别。
summary.en: Reverse Linked List is a list algorithm.

summary.zh: 链表排序属于list类别。
summary.en: Sort List is a list algorithm.

summary.zh: 分割链表属于list类别。
summary.en: Split Linked List in Parts is a list algorithm.

summary.zh: 反复把 n 替换为各位平方和，最终为 1 是快乐数，否则进入循环。
summary.en: Replace n with the sum of squared digits repeatedly; reaches 1 = happy, else loops.

summary.zh: 只考虑字母数字、忽略大小写，判断短语是否回文。
summary.en: Consider only alphanumeric, ignore case; check if the phrase is a palindrome.

summary.zh: 逐行用上一行相邻两数之和生成二项式系数表。
summary.en: Build the binomial-coefficient table row by row from sums of adjacent entries.

title.zh: 隐马尔可夫模型（前向/后向算法）

summary.zh: 用动态规划的前向 α、后向 β 变量求观测序列概率 P(O|λ)。
summary.en: Dynamic-programming forward α and backward β variables yield observation probability P(O|λ).

title.zh: Viterbi 算法（最可能状态路径）

summary.zh: 用动态规划在 HMM 中求最可能的隐藏状态序列 q* = argmax P(q,O|λ)。
summary.en: Dynamic programming to find the most probable hidden state sequence q* = argmax P(q,O|λ) in an HMM.

summary.zh: 在最大流基础上求总费用最小：SPFA 找费用最短增广路逐次增广。
summary.en: Among maximum flows pick the one with minimum total cost; SPFA-based augmenting paths.

summary.zh: 允许负权边的单源最短路，可检测负环。
summary.en: Single-source shortest path allowing negative edges; detects negative cycles.

summary.zh: 非负权重图单源最短路。
summary.en: Single-source shortest path on a non-negative weighted graph.

summary.zh: 信号从某节点发出，求所有节点收到的最短时间（Dijkstra 后取最大）。
summary.en: Max distance from source after Dijkstra = time to reach all.

summary.zh: 基-2 快速傅里叶变换，O(n log n) 计算 DFT（要求长度为 2 的幂）。
summary.en: Radix-2 Fast Fourier Transform computing the DFT in O(n log n) (length must be a power of 2).

summary.zh: CNF 文法下自底向上二维 DP，判断输入串是否可推导。
summary.en: Bottom-up 2-D dynamic programming under a CNF grammar to decide if a string is derivable.

summary.zh: 广义 LR（GLR）解析器维护一组并行的 LR 栈头，可在移进-归约冲突处分裂，从而解析歧义或有歧义文法并生成解析森林。
summary.en: A Generalized LR (GLR) parser maintains a set of parallel LR stack heads that split on shift/reduce conflicts, allowing it to parse ambiguous grammars and yield a shared packed parse forest.

summary.zh: 解析器组合子把「小解析器」用高阶函数（seq / choice / many / map）组合成「大解析器」，每个组合子是返回 (结果,新位置) 或失败的纯函数。
summary.en: Parser combinators build large parsers from small ones via higher-order functions (seq / choice / many / map); each combinator is a pure function returning (result, newPos) or failure.

complexity.time: O(n) 线性 / 回溯指数

title.zh: Las Vegas 快速选择（随机化快速选择）

summary.zh: 随机化选第 k 小：每次随机选 pivot 划分。结果始终正确（Las Vegas），期望时间 O(n)。
summary.en: Randomized selection of the k-th smallest: partition around a random pivot. Result is always correct (Las Vegas), expected O(n) time.

summary.zh: 随机选 pivot 的快排：期望 O(n log n)，规避最坏输入。
summary.en: Quicksort with a uniformly random pivot; expected O(n log n), avoids worst-case inputs.

summary.zh: 经典「选/不选」回溯：对每个元素选或不选，生成所有 k 元子集。
summary.en: Classic take/skip backtracking: choose or skip each element to enumerate k-subsets.

summary.zh: 回溯经典：在「右括号数 ≤ 左括号数」约束下枚举所有 n 对合法括号组合。
summary.en: Backtracking classic: enumerate all well-formed combinations of n pairs of parentheses under "close ≤ open" constraint.

summary.zh: 排列生成属于recursion类别。
summary.en: Permutation Gen is a recursion algorithm.

summary.zh: 分治地算 a^n：偶数次平方、奇数次乘一次，O(log n) 次乘法。
summary.en: Divide-and-conquer a^n: square on even, multiply once on odd; O(log n) multiplications.

summary.zh: 用分治递归求和：sum(a) = a[0] + sum(a[1..])，演示最朴素的递归思维。
summary.en: Sum via divide-and-conquer recursion: sum(a) = a[0] + sum(a[1..]).

summary.zh: 递归枚举 C(n,k)：维护已选个数与起始下标，选满 k 个即记录一个组合。
summary.en: Recursively enumerate C(n,k): track chosen count and a start index; record a combination once k are chosen.

summary.zh: 递归枚举每个元素的「选/不选」位掩码，生成所有 2^n 个子集。
summary.en: Recursively enumerate a choose/skip bitmask per element to generate all 2^n subsets.

summary.zh: 递归扩展法：从当前位置 start 向后选元素，每层产生一个子集，避免重复。
summary.en: Recursive extension: pick elements forward from a start index; each recursion level yields one subset without duplicates.

summary.zh: 回溯 DFS：逐个空格尝试 1-9，检查行/列/宫约束，失败则回溯。
summary.en: Backtracking DFS: try 1-9 in each empty cell checking row/column/box constraints, backtracking on failure.

summary.zh: 在字符网格中 DFS 回溯搜索单词：四向扩展，已用格子临时标记防重。
summary.en: Search for a word in a character grid via DFS backtracking: expand in 4 directions, marking used cells to avoid reuse.

summary.zh: 在有序数组中递归折半查找目标，每步把区间减半。
summary.en: Recursively halve the search interval to locate a target in a sorted array.

summary.zh: 对每个元素「含/不含」二选一回溯，生成 2^n 个子集。
summary.en: Take/skip backtrack over each element to enumerate all 2^n subsets.

summary.zh: 递归+记忆化经典：到第 n 阶方法数 = ways(n-1)+ways(n-2)，即平移斐波那契。
summary.en: A recursion + memoization classic: ways to reach step n equals ways(n-1)+ways(n-2), a shifted Fibonacci.

summary.zh: 最短作业优先属于scheduling类别。
summary.en: Shortest Job First is a scheduling algorithm.

summary.zh: 二分查找属于searching类别。
summary.en: Binary Search is a searching algorithm.

summary.zh: 在含重复的有序数组中二分找等于 target 的最左下标。
summary.en: Binary search the leftmost index equal to target in a sorted array with duplicates.

summary.zh: 统计出现次数属于searching类别。
summary.en: Count Occurrence is a searching algorithm.

summary.zh: 指数搜索属于searching类别。
summary.en: Exponential Search is a searching algorithm.

title.zh: 指数搜索变体（Galloping / 下界）

summary.zh: 指数搜索变体（Galloping / 下界）属于searching类别。
summary.en: Galloping Search (Lower Bound) is a searching algorithm.

summary.zh: 步长按 2 的幂倍增定位上界，再在 [i/2, i] 内做二分。
summary.en: Doubles the bound by powers of two, then binary-searches the [i/2, i] window.

summary.zh: 分块二分：先在块摘要上二分定位块，再在块内二分。
summary.en: Block binary search: binary search block summaries, then binary search within the block.

summary.zh: 斐波那契搜索属于searching类别。
summary.en: Fibonacci Search is a searching algorithm.

summary.zh: 用斐波那契数划分区间，仅靠加减法逼近目标，无乘除。
summary.en: Splits the range with Fibonacci numbers, approaching the target using only add/subtract.

title.en: Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array

summary.zh: 旋转数组最小值属于searching类别。
summary.en: Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array is a searching algorithm.

summary.zh: 寻找峰值属于searching类别。
summary.en: Find Peak Element is a searching algorithm.

summary.zh: 跳跃查找属于searching类别。
summary.en: Gallop / Exponential Search is a searching algorithm.

summary.zh: 以 2 的幂指数倍增步长飞驰定位候选区间，再在区间内二分。
summary.en: Doubles the step exponentially to gallop into a candidate window, then binary-searches it.

summary.zh: H 指数属于searching类别。
summary.en: H-Index is a searching algorithm.

summary.zh: 插值搜索属于searching类别。
summary.en: Interpolation Search is a searching algorithm.

summary.zh: 按值域线性插值估计位置，迭代逼近目标的有序表搜索。
summary.en: Probe by linear value interpolation, iterate to the target in a sorted table.

summary.zh: 跳跃搜索属于searching类别。
summary.en: Jump Search is a searching algorithm.

summary.zh: 用 ⌊√n⌋ 步长跳跃后线性回扫，最优块大小 √n。
summary.en: Jump by ⌊√n⌋ then linear-scan back; the optimal block size is √n.

title.zh: 第 k 个斐波那契数

summary.zh: 第 k 个斐波那契数属于searching类别。
summary.en: K-th Fibonacci is a searching algorithm.

summary.zh: 线性查找属于searching类别。
summary.en: Linear Search is a searching algorithm.

summary.zh: 元二分查找属于searching类别。
summary.en: Meta Binary Search is a searching algorithm.

summary.zh: 递归地逐位构建答案下标的元二分查找。
summary.en: Recursively build the answer index bit-by-bit.

summary.zh: 用位运算逐位构造目标下标，无需显式中点比较。
summary.en: Builds the target index bit by bit with shift operations, no explicit midpoint.

summary.zh: 峰值下标（山脉数组）属于searching类别。
summary.en: Peak Index in Mountain Array is a searching algorithm.

summary.zh: 二维矩阵搜索属于searching类别。
summary.en: Search a 2D Matrix is a searching algorithm.

summary.zh: 从右上角起，每次比较后向左或向下走，O(m+n)。
summary.en: Start at the top-right; on each comparison move left or down; O(m+n).

summary.zh: 在降序排列的数组上做二分查找，比较方向与升序相反。
summary.en: Binary search on a descending-sorted array, with reversed comparison directions.

summary.zh: 在有重复元素的有序数组中找目标首次出现的位置（lower bound）。
summary.en: Find the first (leftmost) occurrence of the target in a sorted array with duplicates (lower bound).

summary.zh: 在有重复元素的有序数组中找目标最后出现的位置（upper bound - 1）。
summary.en: Find the last (rightmost) occurrence of the target in a sorted array with duplicates.

summary.zh: 标准迭代二分：命中即返回，时间 O(log n)。
summary.en: Standard iterative binary search; return on hit, O(log n).

summary.zh: 在有序数组中用 while 循环折半查找目标值。
summary.en: Iteratively halve a sorted array with a while loop to locate a target value.

summary.zh: 在有序数组中递归地折半查找目标值。
summary.en: Recursively halve a sorted array to locate a target value.

summary.zh: 在升序数组中找目标值最右一次出现的下标，不存在返回 -1。
summary.en: Find the rightmost index of a target in a sorted array; -1 if absent.

summary.zh: 在先增后减的双调数组中 O(log n) 查找目标：先找峰值再两段二分。
summary.en: Search a bitonic (first-increasing then-decreasing) array in O(log n): find the peak then binary-search each side.

summary.zh: 先找双峰数组峰值，再在升序左半与降序右半各二分。
summary.en: Find the bitonic peak, then binary-search the ascending left and descending right halves.

summary.zh: 在升序数组中找最小的 >= target 的元素下标，不存在返回 -1。
summary.en: Find the smallest index with arr[i] >= target in a sorted array; -1 if none.

summary.zh: 用下界与上界二分查找统计有序数组中目标值的出现次数。
summary.en: Count occurrences of a target in a sorted array via lower-bound and upper-bound.

summary.zh: 用上界/下界二分统计升序数组中值落在 [lo,hi] 的元素数。
summary.en: Count elements of a sorted array whose values fall in [lo,hi] via upper/lower bounds.

summary.zh: 在含重复的有序数组中用两次二分定位 target 的出现区间与次数。
summary.en: Locate a target's range and count via two binary searches in a sorted array with duplicates.

summary.zh: 把值当下标成链，用快慢指针找环入口即重复数。
summary.en: Treat values as next-index to form a linked cycle; slow/fast pointers find the entry = duplicate.

summary.zh: 先倍增区间定位边界，再在小区间内二分查找。
summary.en: Find the bounding range by doubling, then binary search within the small range.

summary.zh: 先以 2 的幂扩大搜索范围定位候选段，再在段内二分。
summary.en: Gallop by powers of two to bound a candidate range, then binary-search within it.

summary.zh: 结合跳步定位与二分：先大步粗定位再细二分。
summary.en: Combine stepping and binary search: coarse-locate with big steps, then refine with binary.

summary.zh: 用斐波那契数列划分区间，类似二分但用加法代替除法。
summary.en: Partition the interval using Fibonacci numbers; like binary search but uses addition instead of division.

summary.zh: 用斐波那契数划分区间代替二分，避免除法，适合某些硬件。
summary.en: Partition the range with Fibonacci numbers instead of halving; division-free, suits some hardware.

summary.zh: 查找第一个等于属于searching类别。
summary.en: Find First Occurrence is a searching algorithm.

summary.zh: 二分查找单调布尔数组中第一个 true（坏版本）的位置。
summary.en: Binary search for the first true (bad version) in a monotone boolean array.

summary.zh: 在「前好后坏」的版本序列上二分找第一个坏版本（LeetCode 278）。
summary.en: Binary search the first bad version in a good-then-bad sequence (LeetCode 278).

summary.zh: 升序互异数组中找 i 使 arr[i] == i，二分 O(log n)。
summary.en: Find i with arr[i] == i in a sorted distinct array via binary search, O(log n).

summary.zh: 在升序数组中找最大的 <= target 的元素下标，不存在返回 -1。
summary.en: Find the largest index with arr[i] <= target in a sorted array; -1 if none.

summary.zh: 指数倍增跳跃至越过目标，再二分精确定位，适合大数组前段定位。
summary.en: Exponentially gallop past the target then binary-search the bracket; great for large arrays when the target is near the front.

summary.zh: 指数扩大下标定位块，块内线性回扫；适合目标靠前的有序数据。
summary.en: Exponentially grow the index to bound a block, then linear-scan back; good when the target is near the front.

summary.zh: 排序后线性找最大的 h 使至少 h 篇论文引用 >= h。
summary.en: Sort then linearly find the largest h with at least h papers having >= h citations.

summary.zh: 查找插入位置属于searching类别。
summary.en: Search Insert Position is a searching algorithm.

summary.zh: 找 target 应插入升序数组的位置（保持有序），等价 lower_bound。
summary.en: Find where to insert target to keep a sorted array ordered; equivalent to lower_bound.

summary.zh: 在有序数组中二分找 target 的插入下标并判定是否已存在。
summary.en: Binary search the insertion index for target and report whether it exists.

summary.zh: 根据目标值在区间值的比例估计位置，对均匀分布数据期望 O(log log n)。
summary.en: Estimate probe position from the value ratio; expected O(log log n) for uniformly distributed data.

summary.zh: 按值分布估计位置：pos = lo + (target-a[lo])/(a[hi]-a[hi])*(hi-lo)。
summary.en: Estimate position by value distribution: pos = lo + (target-a[lo])/(a[hi]-a[lo])*(hi-lo).

summary.zh: 双指针扫描两个升序数组找共同元素。
summary.en: Two-pointer scan of two sorted arrays for common elements.

summary.zh: 以步长 √n 跳过元素，定位目标所在块后线性回扫。
summary.en: Jump by step size √n to bracket the target block, then linear-scan backward.

summary.zh: 经典跳跃查找：步长 sqrt(n)，定位块后线性扫描。
summary.en: Classic jump search: step sqrt(n), locate a block then linear-scan.

summary.zh: 用黄金比例 0.618 作为步长因子的跳跃查找。
summary.en: Jump search using the golden ratio 0.618 as the step factor.

title.zh: 查找第 k 个斐波那契数

summary.zh: 迭代计算第 k 个斐波那契数（F(0)=0, F(1)=1）。
summary.en: Iteratively compute the k-th Fibonacci number (F(0)=0, F(1)=1).

title.zh: 第 k 小元素（排序）

summary.zh: 排序后直接取第 k 小（下标 k-1）。
summary.en: Sort then take the k-th smallest (index k-1).

summary.zh: 查找最后一个等于属于searching类别。
summary.en: Find Last Occurrence is a searching algorithm.

summary.zh: 递归实现：找目标值最左一次出现的下标。
summary.en: Recursive implementation: find the leftmost index of the target.

summary.zh: 从头到尾逐个比较找目标值，无序数组也可用。
summary.en: Compare one by one from start to end; works on unsorted arrays.

summary.zh: 把目标值放到数组末尾做哨兵，省去每次循环的越界判断。
summary.en: Place the target at the array end as a sentinel, removing the bound check inside the loop.

summary.zh: 在有序数组上线性扫描，遇到大于目标的元素即提前结束。
summary.en: Linear scan over a sorted array; bail out as soon as an element exceeds the target.

summary.zh: 二分找比相邻元素都小的局部最小（互异数组），O(log n)。
summary.en: Binary search for a local minimum (smaller than neighbors) in a distinct array, O(log n).

summary.zh: 找第一个 >= target 的下标（标准 C++ lower_bound 语义）。
summary.en: Find the first index with arr[i] >= target (C++ lower_bound semantics).

summary.zh: Boyer-Moore 投票：维护候选与计数，O(n) O(1) 找出现超过 n/2 次的元素。
summary.en: Boyer-Moore voting: maintain a candidate and counter; O(n) O(1) for the element appearing more than n/2 times.

summary.zh: 对较短数组二分切分点，使左右两半元素数相等且边界有序，O(log(min))。
summary.en: Binary search the partition on the shorter array so both halves are equal-sized and ordered; O(log(min)).

summary.zh: 用位构造法（不显式维护 lo/hi）直接构造目标索引。
summary.en: Construct the target index by bit-by-bit decisions without explicit lo/hi maintenance.

summary.zh: 从最高位起逐位构造候选下标，比较后决定该位置 0 或 1。
summary.en: Build the candidate index bit by bit from the MSB, comparing to decide each bit.

summary.zh: 二分找旋转升序数组中的最小元素下标。
summary.en: Binary search for the minimum element's index in a rotated sorted array.

summary.zh: 0..n 中缺失一个数，用求和公式减去实际和得到缺失值。
summary.en: Of 0..n one number is missing; subtract the actual sum from the expected sum.

summary.zh: 在 0..n 中找出唯一缺失的数字，三种方法（异或、求和、二分）。
summary.en: Find the single missing number in 0..n via xor, sum, or binary search.

summary.zh: 在「每个元素偏离原位置不超过 k」的数组中用带偏移的二分查找。
summary.en: Binary search with offsets in an array where each element is at most k away from its sorted position.

summary.zh: 升序数组双指针找差为 d 的一对。
summary.en: Two-pointer on a sorted array to find a pair with a given difference.

summary.zh: 升序数组用左右双指针找和等于 target 的一对。
summary.en: Two-pointer scan on a sorted array to find a pair summing to target.

summary.zh: 二分找任意一个峰值：比相邻元素大的元素，O(log n)。
summary.en: Binary search for any peak (greater than its neighbors) in O(log n).

summary.zh: 在矩阵中用列二分 + 行最大找二维峰值，O(n log m)。
summary.en: Find a 2D peak via column binary search + row-max, in O(n log m).

summary.zh: 用二分在无序数组中 O(log n) 找到一个峰值（比相邻元素大）。
summary.en: Use binary search to find a peak element (greater than neighbors) in an unsorted array in O(log n).

title.zh: 快速选择（第 k 小）

summary.zh: 类快排的分区法，平均 O(n) 找第 k 小元素。
summary.en: Quicksort-style partitioning to find the k-th smallest in average O(n).

summary.zh: 查找区间属于searching类别。
summary.en: Search For a Range is a searching algorithm.

summary.zh: 返回 target 在升序数组中首次与末次出现的下标区间 [-1,-1] 表示无。
summary.en: Return the [first, last] indices of target in a sorted array; [-1,-1] if absent.

summary.zh: 旋转数组搜索属于searching类别。
summary.en: Search in Rotated Sorted Array is a searching algorithm.

summary.zh: 在旋转过的升序数组（无重复）中二分查找 target。
summary.en: Binary search for target in a rotated sorted array with no duplicates.

summary.zh: 把目标放到数组末尾作为哨兵，省去每次循环的越界判断。
summary.en: Place the target as a sentinel at the end of the array to eliminate the bounds check from the inner loop.

summary.zh: 二分找有序数组中唯一只出现一次的元素（其余成对）。
summary.en: Binary search for the only once-occurring element in a sorted array (others in pairs).

summary.zh: 二分查找最大的整数 r 使 r*r <= x。
summary.en: Binary search for the largest integer r with r*r <= x.

summary.zh: 每次取两个中点把区间三等分，比较两次再缩到三分之一段。
summary.en: Pick two midpoints to trisect the range; two comparisons then shrink to one third.

summary.zh: 把搜索区间三等分，在有序数组中递归定位目标。
summary.en: Split the search interval into thirds and recursively locate the target in a sorted array.

summary.zh: 找第一个 > target 的下标（C++ upper_bound 语义）。
summary.en: Find the first index with arr[i] > target (C++ upper_bound semantics).

summary.zh: 把目标当作哨兵放末尾，循环省去越界判断，加快线性查找。
summary.en: Places the target as a sentinel at the tail so the scan loop skips the bounds check.

summary.zh: 哨兵查找属于searching类别。
summary.en: Sentinel Search is a searching algorithm.

summary.zh: 有序数组单一元素属于searching类别。
summary.en: Single Element in Sorted Array is a searching algorithm.

summary.zh: 整数平方根属于searching类别。
summary.en: Integer Square Root is a searching algorithm.

summary.zh: 三分查找属于searching类别。
summary.en: Ternary Search is a searching algorithm.

summary.zh: 在均匀分布假设下，把元素分桶后在目标桶内递归选第 k 小。
summary.en: Under uniform-distribution assumption, scatter into buckets and recurse into the target bucket.

summary.zh: 用两个动态收缩的基准 i、j 围出第 k 小，平均比较次数最少。
summary.en: Select k-th using two dynamic pivots i, j that bracket k; fewest average comparisons.

summary.zh: 快选为主、递归深度超限时退化到 median-of-medians 保 O(n) 最坏。
summary.en: Quickselect with depth-limit fallback to median-of-medians for worst-case O(n).

title.zh: 两有序数组并集第 k 小
title.en: K-th in Union of Two Sorted Arrays

summary.zh: 在两个升序数组的并集中用二分找第 k 小，O(log(m+n))。
summary.en: Binary-search the k-th element across two sorted arrays in O(log(m+n)).

summary.zh: 用一大一小两个堆维护窗口内有序结构，O(log k) 取中位数。
summary.en: Two heaps (lower max-heap + upper min-heap) maintain window order; median in O(log k).

title.zh: 两个有序数组的中位数

summary.zh: 在两个有序数组上二分划分，O(log(min(m,n))) 求合并后中位数。
summary.en: Binary-search a partition across two sorted arrays to find the median in O(log(min(m,n))).

summary.zh: 双轴三分区：把数组分为 <p1 / [p1,p2] / >p2 后只递归目标段。
summary.en: Dual-pivot 3-way partition into <p1, [p1,p2], >p2 and recurse into the target segment.

summary.zh: 用 Hoare 原始双指针对撞划分在期望 O(n) 内找第 k 小。
summary.en: Find the k-th smallest in expected O(n) via Hoare two-pointer partitioning.

summary.zh: 用 Lomuto 分区在 O(n) 期望时间内找数组第 k 小元素。
summary.en: Find the k-th smallest element in expected O(n) via Lomuto partitioning.

summary.zh: 取首/中/尾的中位数作基准，避免已序输入退化。
summary.en: Median-of-three pivot avoids degradation on sorted inputs.

summary.zh: 随机选基准避免最坏情况，期望 O(n) 找第 k 小。
summary.en: Randomize the pivot to avoid worst case; find k-th smallest in expected O(n).

title.zh: 滑动窗口中位数（双索引堆）

summary.zh: 窗口右滑时维护两个索引堆（小顶+大顶）求中位数。
summary.en: Maintain two indexed heaps (min+max) as the window slides to report medians.

summary.zh: 珠排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Bead Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 双调排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Bitonic Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 猴子排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Bogo Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 交替执行奇数位和偶数位相邻比较交换，适合并行处理器。
summary.en: Alternately compare-swap odd-indexed and even-indexed adjacent pairs; parallel-friendly.

summary.zh: 冒泡排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Bubble Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 提前终止 + 记录最后交换位置，跳过已有序尾部。
summary.en: Early exit plus last-swap tracking to skip the already-ordered tail.

summary.zh: 桶排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Bucket Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 鸡尾酒排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Cocktail Shaker Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 记录最后一次交换位置，跳跃式收缩未排序区间的双向冒泡。
summary.en: Shaker sort that jumps the unsorted boundary to the last-swap position.

summary.zh: 梳排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Comb Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 使用最终阶段冒泡短路 + 1.3 收缩因子的梳排序。
summary.en: Comb sort with a bubble-shortcut final pass and the 1.3 shrink factor.

summary.zh: 计数排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Counting Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 圈排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Cycle Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 用 (值, 原下标) 配对作为键，使圈排序保持相等元素的相对顺序。
summary.en: Pair each value with its original index so cycle sort becomes stable.

summary.zh: 按值域分桶后用置换循环就地归位，无需桶数组的分布排序。
summary.en: Distribution sort that bins by value range then permutes in place.

summary.zh: 侏儒排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Gnome Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 用模拟「珠子受重力下落」的位矩阵对非负整数排序。
summary.en: Sort non-negative integers by simulating beads falling under gravity in a bit matrix.

summary.zh: 堆排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Heap Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 插入排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Insertion Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 用二分查找定位插入点，减少比较次数到 O(log n) 每元素。
summary.en: Locates each insertion point with binary search, cutting compares to O(log n) per element.

summary.zh: 内省排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: IntroSort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 图书馆排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Library Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 归并排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Merge Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 利用输入中已有的有序段（run），逐轮两两归并直至整体有序。
summary.en: Exploits existing ordered runs in the input, merging them pairwise until sorted.

summary.zh: 奇偶排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Odd-Even Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 煎饼排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Pancake Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 煎饼排序加「已就位跳过」与「顶部免翻」短路，翻转次数 ≤ 2n−3。
summary.en: Pancake sort with in-place and at-top short-circuits, ≤ 2n−3 flips.

summary.zh: 耐心排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Patience Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 穷举所有排列，找到第一个有序者（Bogo 的确定性变种）。
summary.en: Enumerate all permutations until the first sorted one is found.

summary.zh: 鸽巢排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Pigeonhole Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 快速排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Quick Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 基数排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Radix Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 从最高位（Most Significant Digit）开始，递归按位分桶。
summary.en: Partitions by the most significant digit first, then recurses on each bucket.

summary.zh: 采样排序：采样若干主元做 (k+1) 路划分，递归收尾。
summary.en: Samplesort: sample pivots, partition into (k+1) buckets, recurse.

summary.zh: 选择排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Selection Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 用「插入式」搬移代替交换，保证相等元素的相对顺序不变。
summary.en: Shifts elements instead of swapping to keep equal keys in original order.

summary.zh: 希尔排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Shell Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 睡眠排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Sleep Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 慢排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Slow Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 用「珠子层数」模拟重力下落：每列珠数即为该值的排序后位置计数。
summary.en: Simulate beads falling under gravity; the per-column bead count gives the sorted order.

summary.zh: 用二分查找定位插入点，再整体后移；减少比较次数到 O(n log n)。
summary.en: Binary-search the insertion point then shift; cuts comparisons to O(n log n).

title.zh: 二分插入排序变种（带重复计数）

summary.zh: 在有序前缀中用二分查找定位插入点，并保证相等元素的相对顺序（稳定）。
summary.en: Locate the insertion point by binary search over the sorted prefix, preserving the order of equal keys (stable).

summary.zh: 迭代版双调排序网络：对每级 k 做 bitonic 归并，并行友好。
summary.en: Iterative bitonic sorting network: for each level k do a bitonic merge; parallel-friendly.

summary.zh: 把数组分成大小为 √n 的块，逐块排序后再用块级归并，空间 O(1)。
summary.en: Split the array into blocks of size √n, sort each block, then merge blocks with O(1) extra space.

title.zh: 冒泡排序（末次交换优化）

summary.zh: 记录每趟最后一次交换的位置作为下趟的右边界，跳过已排好尾部。
summary.en: Record the last swap index each pass as the next pass's right bound, skipping the sorted tail.

summary.zh: 经典朴素冒泡：每趟相邻比较交换，无任何优化。
summary.en: Classic naive bubble: compare-swap adjacent pairs each pass, no optimizations.

summary.zh: 均匀分数组分到 sqrt(n) 个桶，各桶内插入排序后拼接。
summary.en: Scatter values into sqrt(n) buckets, insertion-sort each, then concatenate.

summary.zh: 用环形缓冲区实现双缓冲归并，原地完成两段有序子序列的合并。
summary.en: Merge two sorted runs using a circular buffer as a rotating swap area, in-place.

summary.zh: 双向鸡尾酒排序记录左右最后一次交换位置，跳过已排好区间。
summary.en: Bidirectional cocktail sort records the last swap on each side to skip sorted ranges.

summary.zh: 单一收缩因子 1.25 的梳排序，间隔序列略密。
summary.en: Comb sort with a single shrink factor of 1.25; a denser gap sequence.

summary.zh: 用收缩因子 1.33 的梳排序，间隔序列更陡。
summary.en: Comb sort with shrink factor 1.33; a steeper gap sequence.

summary.zh: 梳排序用两个交替收缩的间隔因子，加速消除小乌龟值。
summary.en: Comb sort alternating between two shrinking gaps to kill turtles faster.

summary.zh: 通过值偏移把负数也纳入计数排序的非负桶范围。
summary.en: Counting sort that supports negative values by offsetting them into a non-negative bucket range.

summary.zh: 循环节长为 2 的循环排序变体，每轮至多两次写入，减少写次数。
summary.en: Cycle-sort variant that processes cycles two at a time, minimizing writes per round.

summary.zh: 按值线性映射到 m 个桶，桶内插入排序后收集，近似线性。
summary.en: Linearly map values to m buckets, insertion-sort each, then collect; near-linear on uniform input.

summary.zh: 经典侏儒排序：逐位前进，遇逆序则交换并后退一位。
summary.en: Classic gnome sort: step forward; on an inversion swap and step back one.

summary.zh: 经典侏儒排序加跳跃回退：交换后跳回上次位置而非逐位回退。
summary.en: Optimized gnome sort jumps back to the previous position after a swap instead of stepping one by one.

summary.zh: 用每列珠子数等于该值的高度，让珠子受「重力」下落，再按每行珠子数读出排序结果。
summary.en: Represent numbers as columns of beads; let gravity pull beads down, then read row counts to obtain sorted order.

summary.zh: 用 4-叉完全堆做堆排序，每节点 4 个孩子，深度更浅。
summary.en: Heap sort over a 4-ary complete heap (four children per node), shallower depth.

summary.zh: 显式构建三叉大顶堆，再反复取堆顶到末尾。
summary.en: Explicitly build a ternary max-heap, then repeatedly extract the root to the tail.

summary.zh: 通过手摇算法（三段反转）在不申请额外数组的情况下原地合并两段有序序列。
summary.en: Merge two sorted runs in-place using a three-block rotation (reverse-based) technique.

summary.zh: 用一个「已排序链」+「剩余」两段，逐个把剩余首插入已排序链正确位置。
summary.en: Maintain a sorted prefix and a remainder; insert each remainder head into its sorted position.

summary.zh: 先把最小值移到首位作哨兵，内层循环省去边界判断。
summary.en: Move the minimum to the front as a sentinel so the inner loop skips boundary checks.

summary.zh: 插入排序的带空位版：预留空槽让插入只需少量后移。
summary.en: Insertion sort with gaps: pre-reserve empty slots so insertions shift few elements.

title.zh: 归并排序（自底向上迭代）

summary.zh: 迭代地归并长度 1,2,4,8... 的子段，无需递归。
summary.en: Iteratively merge runs of length 1,2,4,8... without recursion.

summary.zh: 原地归并的简化版：归并时用旋转把元素移到正确位置，避免辅助数组。
summary.en: Simplified in-place merge using rotation to move elements during merge, avoiding an auxiliary array.

summary.zh: 递归到小段（<=16）时改用插入排序，减少递归与归并开销。
summary.en: Switch to insertion sort for runs <= 16 to cut recursion/merge overhead.

summary.zh: 经典分治：递归拆半排序再归并，稳定 O(n log n)。
summary.en: Classic divide-and-conquer: recursively split in half, sort, and merge; stable O(n log n).

summary.zh: 每轮同时选最小和最大，分别压入结果两端。
summary.en: Each round select both min and max, pushing them to the two ends of the result.

summary.zh: Batcher 奇偶归并网络：递归归并奇/偶子序列，适合并行/硬件。
summary.en: Batcher odd-even merge network: recursively merge odd/even subsequences; parallel/hardware-friendly.

summary.zh: 每轮用翻转把当前未排序段的最大值送到段尾，n-1 轮完成排序。
summary.en: Each round use flips to send the current max of the unsorted segment to its tail; n-1 rounds.

title.zh: 耐心排序变种（栈式合并）

summary.zh: 把元素逐个放到「牌堆顶」上，再对各牌堆做 k 路归并得到有序序列。
summary.en: Deal elements onto card piles, then k-way merge the piles to produce the sorted output.

summary.zh: 把元素按 patience 规则放入牌堆，再用最小堆合并各堆顶。
summary.en: Deal elements into piles by patience rules, then merge pile tops via a min-heap.

summary.zh: 把值域内每个可能值映射到一个鸽巢，按值域顺序收集。
summary.en: Map each possible value in the range to a pigeonhole; collect in value order.

summary.zh: 按值线性映射到「近邻桶」，桶内插入排序后即得全局有序。
summary.en: Map values linearly to proxmap buckets, insertion-sort within, then collect globally sorted.

summary.zh: Dijkstra 三路划分：按小于/等于/大于 pivot 三段递归，高效处理大量重复键。
summary.en: Dijkstra 3-way partition splits into <,=,> pivot segments; fast on many duplicate keys.

summary.zh: 用首/中/尾三数中位数做 pivot，避免最坏情况，递归改迭代栈。
summary.en: Use the median of first/middle/last as pivot to avoid worst case; iterative stack.

title.zh: 基数排序（LSD 十六进制）

summary.zh: 以 16 为基数按位 LSD 基数排序，每趟 16 个桶，趟数为 hex 位数。
summary.en: LSD radix sort with base 16; 16 buckets per pass, passes = number of hex digits.

summary.zh: 从最高位起递归地按十进制位分桶，桶内递归直到个位。
summary.en: Recursively bucket by the most significant decimal digit first, recursing down to the units.

summary.zh: 每轮同时选出最小和最大，分别放到两端，趟数减半。
summary.en: Each round pick both min and max, placing them at the two ends; halves the rounds.

summary.zh: 每轮在未排序段线性找最小，与段首交换。朴素版无任何优化。
summary.en: Each round linearly find the min in the unsorted segment and swap it to the segment head; no optimizations.

summary.zh: 朴素双向冒泡：奇数趟向右、偶数趟向左，无边界优化。
summary.en: Naive bidirectional bubble: odd passes go right, even passes go left, no bound optimization.

summary.zh: 使用 Marcin Ciura 实验得出的最优间隔序列的希尔排序。
summary.en: Shell sort using Marcin Ciura's experimentally-optimal gap sequence.

summary.zh: 使用 Knuth 经典间隔序列 (...,109,41,15,5,1) 的希尔排序。
summary.en: Shell sort with the classic Knuth gap sequence (...,109,41,15,5,1).

summary.zh: 排序前先随机打乱数组，避免在已有序/特殊构造的输入上触发最坏情况。
summary.en: Randomly shuffle the array before sorting to avoid worst-case behavior on sorted or adversarial inputs.

summary.zh: 用 Leonardo 数列大小的堆组成森林，已有序时接近 O(n)。
summary.en: A forest of heaps sized by Leonardo numbers; near O(n) when already sorted.

summary.zh: 模拟 V8/标准库的混合排序：小段用插入排序，大段用快速排序，深度过深时退化为堆排序。
summary.en: Mimics the V8/standard-library hybrid sort: insertion for small runs, quicksort otherwise, with introsort-style heap fallback.

summary.zh: 经典 Stooge：递归排序前 2/3、后 2/3、再前 2/3，教学用极慢排序。
summary.en: Classic stooge: recursively sort the first 2/3, then last 2/3, then first 2/3 again; a pedagogically slow sort.

summary.zh: 反复从剩余元素抽出递增子链，归并到结果中。
summary.en: Repeatedly pull an increasing subsequence (strand) from the remainder and merge it into the result.

summary.zh: 归并时用二分/加速模式跳过连续取自同一侧的长段，减少比较。
summary.en: Merge using galloping/binary search to skip long runs taken from one side, cutting comparisons.

summary.zh: 依次插入 BST，中序遍历得有序序列；本版先排序去重再平衡建树。
summary.en: Insert into a BST, in-order traverse for sorted output; this version builds a balanced tree from sorted unique values.

summary.zh: 用 3-叉完全堆（每个父节点有 3 个孩子）做堆排序，相比二叉堆深度更浅。
summary.en: Heap sort over a 3-ary complete heap (three children per node), shallower than a binary heap.

summary.zh: 意大利面排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Spaghetti Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 基于位/分布的桶划分 + 小桶比较排序的混合排序。
summary.en: Hybrid sort: distribution-based bucketing plus comparison-based cleanup.

summary.zh: Stooge 排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Stooge Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: Strand 排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Strand Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 自适应归并：自然 run 检测 + 小段插入 + 自底向上归并。
summary.en: Adaptive merge: detect natural runs, insertion-sort small runs, merge bottom-up.

summary.zh: Tim排序v2（galloping 归并）属于sorting类别。
summary.en: TimSort v2 (galloping merge) is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: Tim排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: TimSort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: 树排序属于sorting类别。
summary.en: Tree Sort is a sorting algorithm.

summary.zh: AC 自动机属于string类别。
summary.en: Aho-Corasick is a string algorithm.

summary.zh: AC自动机增强属于string类别。
summary.en: AC Automaton Enhanced is a string algorithm.

title.zh: AC 自动机 fail 指针构建（BFS）

summary.zh: 在 trie 上 BFS 构建 fail 指针，得到 AC 自动机的转移结构。
summary.en: Build fail links over a trie via BFS to obtain the AC automaton transition structure.

summary.zh: Aho搜索属于string类别。
summary.en: Aho Search is a string algorithm.

summary.zh: AC自动机v2属于string类别。
summary.en: Aho-Corasick v2 is a string algorithm.

summary.zh: Boyer-Moore-Horspool属于string类别。
summary.en: Boyer-Moore-Horspool is a string algorithm.

summary.zh: BNDM匹配属于string类别。
summary.en: BNDM Match is a string algorithm.

summary.zh: Border数组属于string类别。
summary.en: Border Array is a string algorithm.

summary.zh: Boyer-Moore 匹配属于string类别。
summary.en: Boyer-Moore is a string algorithm.

summary.zh: 用坏字符规则（bad-character shift table）做子串匹配，平均亚线性。
summary.en: Substring matching using the bad-character shift table; average sublinear.

summary.zh: Damerau 距离属于string类别。
summary.en: Damerau-Levenshtein is a string algorithm.

summary.zh: 双哈希属于string类别。
summary.en: Double Hash is a string algorithm.

summary.zh: Duval 分解属于string类别。
summary.en: Duval (Lyndon) Factorization is a string algorithm.

summary.zh: 编辑距离（操作回溯）属于string类别。
summary.en: Edit Distance (Backtrack) is a string algorithm.

summary.zh: 扩展 KMP（Z 函数）属于string类别。
summary.en: Extended KMP (Z-function) is a string algorithm.

summary.zh: 失配函数属于string类别。
summary.en: Failure Function is a string algorithm.

summary.zh: Galil匹配属于string类别。
summary.en: Galil Match is a string algorithm.

summary.zh: 汉明距离属于string类别。
summary.en: Hamming Distance is a string algorithm.

summary.zh: 字符串哈希属于string类别。
summary.en: String Hashing is a string algorithm.

summary.zh: Horspool增强属于string类别。
summary.en: Horspool Enhanced is a string algorithm.

summary.zh: Jaro 相似度属于string类别。
summary.en: Jaro Similarity is a string algorithm.

summary.zh: Jaro-Winkler 相似度属于string类别。
summary.en: Jaro-Winkler Similarity is a string algorithm.

summary.zh: KMP 模式匹配属于string类别。
summary.en: KMP Pattern Match is a string algorithm.

summary.zh: KMP（next 变体）属于string类别。
summary.en: KMP (next-array variant) is a string algorithm.

title.zh: KMP 失败指针（LPS / next 数组）构建

summary.zh: Knuth-Morris-Pratt 的预处理：求模式串每个前缀的最长真前后缀长度。
summary.en: Knuth-Morris-Pratt preprocessing: longest proper prefix-suffix length for every prefix of the pattern.

summary.zh: 构造前缀函数后扫描文本，O(n+m) 内报告所有匹配位置。
summary.en: Builds the prefix function then scans the text, reporting all matches in O(n+m).

summary.zh: 莱文斯坦距离属于string类别。
summary.en: Levenshtein Distance is a string algorithm.

summary.zh: 莱文斯坦距离（全矩阵）属于string类别。
summary.en: Levenshtein (Full Matrix) is a string algorithm.

summary.zh: 纵向扫描多个字符串同一列字符，遇分歧即止，返回公共前缀。
summary.en: Scans the same column across all strings; stops at the first diverging character.

summary.zh: 最长公共子串属于string类别。
summary.en: Longest Common Substring is a string algorithm.

summary.zh: 求既是真前缀又是真后缀的最长子串（即 KMP 的 lps[n-1]）。
summary.en: Find the longest substring that is both a proper prefix and a proper suffix (i.e., KMP lps[n-1]).

summary.zh: Lyndon 词属于string类别。
summary.en: Lyndon Word is a string algorithm.

summary.zh: Manacher 最长回文属于string类别。
summary.en: Manacher Palindrome is a string algorithm.

summary.zh: 最小循环移位属于string类别。
summary.en: Minimal Rotation (Booth) is a string algorithm.

summary.zh: 最小覆盖子串属于string类别。
summary.en: Minimum Window Substring is a string algorithm.

summary.zh: 朴素匹配属于string类别。
summary.en: Naive String Match is a string algorithm.

summary.zh: 用中心扩展法统计所有回文子串个数，O(n²) 时间 O(1) 空间。
summary.en: Counts all palindromic substrings via center expansion in O(n²) time, O(1) space.

summary.zh: 回文树属于string类别。
summary.en: Palindrome Tree (Eertree) is a string algorithm.

title.zh: Manacher 回文半径（最长回文子串）

summary.zh: Manacher 算法 O(n) 求每个中心的回文半径，得最长回文子串。
summary.en: Manacher algorithm computes each center palindrome radius in O(n) to get the longest palindromic substring.

summary.zh: Rabin-Karp 匹配属于string类别。
summary.en: Rabin-Karp is a string algorithm.

summary.zh: RK二维属于string类别。
summary.en: Rabin-Karp 2D is a string algorithm.

summary.zh: 用滚动哈希 O(n+m) 找子串，O(1) 滑动窗口更新哈希。
summary.en: Use rolling hash to find substrings in O(n+m); O(1) sliding-window hash update.

summary.zh: 字符串基数排序（MSD）属于string类别。
summary.en: MSD Radix String Sort is a string algorithm.

summary.zh: 游程编码属于string类别。
summary.en: Run-Length Encoding is a string algorithm.

summary.zh: Runs（周期性极大区间）属于string类别。
summary.en: String Runs is a string algorithm.

summary.zh: Shift-And匹配属于string类别。
summary.en: Shift-And Match is a string algorithm.

summary.zh: Shift-Or匹配属于string类别。
summary.en: Shift-Or Match is a string algorithm.

summary.zh: 最短公共超序列属于string类别。
summary.en: Shortest Common Supersequence is a string algorithm.

summary.zh: Trie + KMP 失败指针，在文本中同时匹配多模式。
summary.en: Trie + KMP failure links; matches multiple patterns in a text simultaneously.

title.zh: Aho-Corasick（字典图 / 自动机完整转移）

summary.zh: 在 fail 链基础上预构完整转移图，O(n) 扫描文本多模式匹配。
summary.en: Pre-builds a complete transition graph on top of fail links; O(n) text scan for multi-pattern.

summary.zh: 从右向左比较，用坏字符规则大步跳跃。
summary.en: Compares right-to-left, using the bad-character rule for large jumps.

summary.zh: 用两个不同模数同时哈希，碰撞概率趋近于零。
summary.en: Two independent mod-pair hashes make collisions negligibly rare.

summary.zh: 预处理前缀哈希，O(1) 查询任意子串哈希。
summary.en: Precomputes prefix hashes; O(1) arbitrary substring hash queries.

summary.zh: 通过前缀函数在 O(n+m) 内完成模式匹配，无文本指针回退。
summary.en: Prefix function achieves O(n+m) matching with no text-pointer backtracking.

summary.zh: O(n) 计算以每个位置为中心的最长回文半径。
summary.en: O(n) computes the longest palindromic radius centered at each position.

summary.zh: O(n^2) DP 统计所有回文子串数量。
summary.en: O(n^2) DP counting all palindromic substrings.

summary.zh: 用滚动哈希在 O(n+m) 平均时间内匹配，可推广到多模式。
summary.en: Rolling hash achieves O(n+m) average matching; generalizes to multiple patterns.

summary.zh: 维护定长滑动窗口的哈希，O(1) 更新，用于指纹去重。
summary.en: Maintains a fixed-length sliding-window hash updated in O(1); used for fingerprinting.

summary.zh: 所有后缀共享前缀的压缩 Trie，O(n^2) 朴素构造。
summary.en: Compressed trie of all suffixes with shared prefixes; O(n^2) naive construction.

title.zh: 后缀数组（SA · 倍增构造）

summary.zh: O(n log n) 倍增构造 SA 与 height 数组，是许多字符串题的基础。
summary.en: O(n log n) doubling construction of SA and height arrays; foundation for many string problems.

summary.zh: 识别所有后缀的最小 DFA，O(n) 在线构造。
summary.en: Minimal DFA accepting all suffixes; constructed online in O(n).

summary.zh: 多分支树，公共前缀共享路径，支持插入/查询/前缀统计。
summary.en: Multi-branch tree sharing common prefixes; supports insert / lookup / prefix-count.

summary.zh: O(n) 计算 z[i]：从 i 起的最长公共前缀（与整串）。
summary.en: O(n) computes z[i]: longest common prefix between s and s[i..].

title.zh: 字符串异位词判定与分组

summary.zh: 判定两串是否互为字母异位词，并支持把一批串按异位词分组。
summary.en: Check whether two strings are anagrams and group a list of strings by anagram class.

complexity.time: O(n) check / O(N·k log k) group

summary.zh: 字符串压缩属于string类别。
summary.en: String Compression is a string algorithm.

summary.zh: 把连续相同字符原地压缩为「字符 + 次数」形式，返回新长度。
summary.en: Compress consecutive equal chars in place as "char + count" and return the new length.

title.zh: 移位字符串分组（统一移位）

summary.zh: 把可经「统一字母移位」相互得到的字符串分到一组。
summary.en: Group strings that can be transformed into each other by a uniform letter shift.

title.zh: 双哈希（类封装前缀哈希）

summary.zh: 用两对独立基数与模数构造前缀哈希，O(1) 查询任意子串哈希。
summary.en: Build prefix hashes with two independent base/mod pairs; query any substring hash in O(1).

complexity.time: O(n) 预处理 / O(1) 查询

summary.zh: 字符串匹配自动机属于string类别。
summary.en: String Match Automaton is a string algorithm.

title.zh: 字符串最小字典序旋转（Booth 算法）

summary.zh: Booth 算法 O(n) 求使 rotate(s,k) 字典序最小的旋转量 k。
summary.en: Booth algorithm finds in O(n) the rotation offset k minimizing rotate(s,k) lexicographically.

title.zh: 字符串旋转判定（s2 是否 s1 旋转）

summary.zh: 判定 s2 是否为 s1 的循环旋转：s1+s1 中是否包含 s2。
summary.en: Check whether s2 is a cyclic rotation of s1: whether s1+s1 contains s2.

summary.zh: 字符串排序（归并）属于string类别。
summary.en: String Sort (Merge) is a string algorithm.

summary.zh: Z[i] = s 与 s[i..] 的最长公共前缀长度，O(n) 求解。
summary.en: Z[i] = length of longest common prefix of s and s[i..], computed in O(n).

summary.zh: 后缀数组属于string类别。
summary.en: Suffix Array is a string algorithm.

summary.zh: DC3 后缀数组属于string类别。
summary.en: Suffix Array (DC3) is a string algorithm.

summary.zh: 构造后缀数组并用 Kasai 算法 O(n) 求相邻 LCP（高度数组）。
summary.en: Build the suffix array and compute the LCP (height) array in O(n) via Kasai.

complexity.time: O(n² log n) 构 SA / O(n) LCP

summary.zh: SA-IS 后缀数组属于string类别。
summary.en: Suffix Array (SA-IS) is a string algorithm.

summary.zh: 后缀自动机属于string类别。
summary.en: Suffix Automaton is a string algorithm.

summary.zh: 把多个串建到同一 SAM，支持判定子串是否出现在任一串中。
summary.en: Build multiple strings into one SAM to test substring presence across any of them.

summary.zh: Sunday匹配属于string类别。
summary.en: Sunday Match is a string algorithm.

title.zh: Trie 插入与查找（精简版）

summary.zh: 只支持插入与整串/前缀查找的精简前缀树实现。
summary.en: A minimal prefix tree supporting insert and exact/prefix search only.

summary.zh: 字符串Trie属于string类别。
summary.en: String Trie is a string algorithm.

summary.zh: 双向匹配属于string类别。
summary.en: Two Way Match is a string algorithm.

summary.zh: 线性时间构造 Z 数组：z[i] = s 与 s[i..] 的最长公共前缀长度。
summary.en: Builds the Z array in linear time: z[i] = longest common prefix of s and s[i..].

summary.zh: Z 函数属于string类别。
summary.en: Z-Function is a string algorithm.

title.zh: 有序数组构造平衡 BST

summary.zh: 把升序数组转成高度平衡的 BST（取中点为根递归构造）。
summary.en: Convert a sorted ascending array into a height-balanced BST (recurse with the middle element as root).

summary.zh: 可回溯的束搜索变体。
summary.en: Backtrackable beam search.

summary.zh: 回溯 + AC-3 弧一致性传播：每步赋值后剪除不可能取值。
