summary.en: Backtracking + AC-3 arc consistency: prune impossible values after each assignment.

summary.zh: 在已知 MDP 上交替进行策略评估与策略改进直至策略稳定，求得最优策略。
summary.en: Alternate policy evaluation and policy improvement on a known MDP until the policy stabilizes, yielding an optimal policy.

summary.zh: 在已知 MDP 上反复对贝尔曼最优方程做同步更新，直接逼近最优状态价值。
summary.en: Repeatedly apply synchronous Bellman-optimality backups on a known MDP to converge directly to the optimal state value.

summary.zh: 统计 1..n 的优美排列数量（第 i 位能被 i 整除或反之）。
summary.en: Count beautiful arrangements of 1..n (i divides value or value divides i).

summary.zh: 回溯判断数字字符串能否拆成前两数之和等于后续的累加序列。
summary.en: Backtracking to decide whether a digit string can split into an additive sequence (a+b=c).

summary.zh: 枚举图中从源到汇的所有简单路径。
summary.en: All simple paths from source to sink in a graph.

summary.zh: 回溯枚举给定长度的所有合法 Android 九宫格解锁序列。
summary.en: Backtracking to enumerate all valid Android grid unlock patterns of a given length.

summary.zh: 1..n 排列满足 perm[i] 整除 i 或 i 整除 perm[i] 的方案数。
summary.en: Count permutations where perm[i] divides i or vice versa.

summary.zh: 枚举长度 n 的所有二进制字符串。
summary.en: Enumerate all binary strings of length n.

summary.zh: 展开 {a,b}c{d,e} 形式的表达式为所有单词。
summary.en: Expand {a,b}c{d,e} into all words.

summary.zh: 回溯展开含并集与连接的花括号表达式，生成所有可能字符串。
summary.en: Backtracking to expand brace expressions with union and concatenation into all possible strings.

paths.label: 图论 / DP
paths.description: 聚焦图搜索、最短路、连通性、博弈搜索和动态规划，适合作为进阶专题课。

summary.zh: 蚂蚁依信息素与启发式选边，迭代更新信息素（小 TSP）。
summary.en: Ants pick edges by pheromone + heuristic; pheromones update iteratively (small TSP).

summary.zh: 在时限内先给可行解再逐步优化。
summary.en: Produces a feasible solution then improves under a time budget.

summary.zh: 在 AND-OR 图上求最优解图。
summary.en: Optimal solution graph over AND-OR graphs.

summary.zh: CSP 回溯时跳到真正的冲突变量。
summary.en: Backtracks CSP to the true conflict variable.

summary.zh: MCTS 第四阶段：把 rollout 奖励沿父链回填到路径上每个节点的 visits/wins。
summary.en: MCTS fourth phase: propagate the rollout reward up the parent chain, updating visits/wins on every node on the path.

summary.zh: 模拟蝙蝠回声定位：频率、响度、脉冲率协同搜索。
summary.en: Mimics bat echolocation via frequency, loudness, and pulse rate.

summary.zh: 可回溯的束搜索变体。
summary.en: Backtrackable beam search.

summary.zh: 采蜜蜂、观察蜂、侦查蜂协同搜索解空间（Sphere 目标）。
summary.en: Employed, onlooker, and scout bees collaboratively search (Sphere target).

summary.zh: 从源和汇同时 BFS 在中间相会。
summary.en: BFS from both ends, meet in the middle.

summary.zh: 用上/下界剪掉不可能更优的子树。
summary.en: Prunes subtrees that cannot beat the bound.

summary.zh: 先粗粒度搜索再逐层细化。
summary.en: Search coarse first, refine progressively.

summary.zh: 回溯 + AC-3 弧一致性传播：每步赋值后剪除不可能取值。
summary.en: Backtracking + AC-3 arc consistency: prune impossible values after each assignment.

summary.zh: 基于 Lévy 飞行的巢寄生行为，全局探索强。
summary.en: Nest parasitism with Lévy flights for strong global exploration.

title.zh: 带移动排序的迭代加深

summary.zh: IDDFS + 上一轮最佳移动优先排序，大幅提升 alpha-beta 剪枝效率。
summary.en: IDDFS with best-move-first ordering from the previous iteration, greatly boosting alpha-beta pruning.

summary.zh: MCTS 模拟阶段：从节点出发随机走子到终局，返回奖励值。
summary.en: MCTS simulation phase: random walk from a node to a terminal state, returning a reward.

summary.zh: DFS 配合上界剪枝求最优。
summary.en: DFS with bound pruning for optimum.

summary.zh: DE/rand/1/bin：差分变异 + 二项交叉 + 贪心选择。
summary.en: DE/rand/1/bin: difference-vector mutation + binomial crossover + greedy selection.

summary.zh: 增量式启发式搜索，环境变化时高效重规划。
summary.en: Incremental heuristic replanning under dynamic costs.

summary.zh: 亮度低者被亮度高者吸引，吸引力随距离指数衰减。
summary.en: Less bright fireflies are attracted to brighter ones; attractiveness decays with distance.

summary.zh: 异花授粉（全局 Lévy 飞行）与自花授粉（局部扰动）切换。
summary.en: Switch between cross-pollination (global Lévy flight) and self-pollination (local).

summary.zh: CSP 中提前删除未来变量的非法值。
summary.en: Prunes future variables illegal values early.

summary.zh: IDA* 的改进版，维护待展开叶节点链表。
summary.en: IDA* variant keeping a fringe list of leaves.

summary.zh: 选择+交叉+变异，逐代演化近似最优解（OneMax 目标）。
summary.en: Selection + crossover + mutation evolving near-optimal solutions (OneMax target).

summary.zh: 粒子按质量与距离互相吸引（万有引力模型）。
summary.en: Particles attract by mass and distance (gravity model).

summary.zh: α、β、δ 三阶首领引导狼群包围猎物（Sphere 目标）。
summary.en: α, β, δ leaders guide wolves to encircle prey (Sphere target).

summary.zh: 记忆库取值 + 音调微调 + 随机选择，新和声优于最差即替换。
summary.en: Memory-take + pitch-adjust + random choice; replace worst if new harmony is better.

title.zh: 启发式评估函数 (静态评估)

summary.zh: 为非终局局面打分：加权特征（如棋子数、机动性、控制）线性组合。
summary.en: Score non-terminal positions by a weighted linear combination of features (material, mobility, control).

summary.zh: 贪心移向更优邻居，可能陷入局部最优。
summary.en: Greedily move to a better neighbor; may get stuck in local optima.

summary.zh: 带启发式阈值的迭代加深搜索。
summary.en: Iterative deepening with heuristic threshold.

summary.zh: 逐步放宽每节点展开的子节点上限。
summary.en: Progressively widens the branching factor cap.

summary.zh: 磷虾群：诱导、觅食、扩散三种运动协同搜索。
summary.en: Krill herd: induction, foraging, and diffusion motions cooperate.

summary.zh: 限制偏离启发式选择的次数。
summary.en: Bounded deviations from heuristic choice.

summary.zh: 实时启发式搜索，边走边更新 h 表。
summary.en: Real-time heuristic search updating h as it moves.

title.zh: 纯蒙特卡洛树搜索 (Pure MCTS)

summary.zh: MCTS 四阶段一体：选择(UCB1)+扩展+随机 rollout+回传，迭代收敛到最优动作。
summary.en: Unified MCTS four phases: selection(UCB1) + expansion + random rollout + backup, iterating toward the best action.

title.zh: MCTS 求解器 (证明数搜索)

summary.zh: PN-MCTS：rollout 终局为确定胜负时，把节点标记为已证胜/负，剪枝加速。
summary.en: PN-MCTS: when a rollout reaches a definite win/loss, mark nodes proven, pruning to speed up solving.

summary.zh: GPS 经典：比较当前与目标选算子。
summary.en: GPS classic: choose operators to reduce difference.

summary.zh: Memory-1 博弈：玩家只知道上一回合双方动作，用不动点方程求稳态策略值。
summary.en: Memory-1 games: players recall only the last round of joint actions; solve fixed-point equations for steady-state values.

summary.zh: CSP 局部搜索：选冲突最少的值。
summary.en: Local search picking min-conflict value.

summary.zh: 用完整回合回报平均估计 V。
summary.en: Averages full-episode returns to estimate V.

summary.zh: 飞蛾横向绕火焰螺旋飞行，火焰数随代递减。
summary.en: Moths spiral transversely around flames; flame count decreases over generations.

summary.zh: MTD(bi)：交替使用上下界驱动零窗口测试。
summary.en: MTD(bi): alternate upper/lower bounds to drive zero-window tests.

summary.zh: MTD(f)：反复用零窗口 alpha-beta + 转置换表，以初始猜测 f 逼近博弈值。
summary.en: MTD(f): repeatedly call zero-window alpha-beta with a transposition table, driving an initial guess f toward the game value.

summary.zh: 并行 alpha-beta：多线程并行搜索子树（PV-split 模拟）。
summary.en: Parallel alpha-beta: search subtrees concurrently (PV-split simulation).

summary.zh: 粒子按个体最优与全局最优更新速度位置（Sphere 目标）。
summary.en: Particles update velocity and position via personal and global bests (Sphere target).

summary.zh: 预先 BFS 求一组关键子到目标的距离，搜索时查表作为更紧的启发式。
summary.en: Precompute via BFS the distances of a subset of key tiles to the goal, then query the table as a tighter heuristic during search.

summary.zh: 在已知 MDP 上交替进行策略评估与策略改进直至策略稳定，求得最优策略。
summary.en: Alternate policy evaluation and policy improvement on a known MDP until the policy stabilizes, yielding an optimal policy.

summary.zh: 交替改进策略与策略评估。
summary.en: Alternates policy evaluation and improvement.

summary.zh: 随机采样构造运动规划路线图。
summary.en: Random-sampling roadmap for motion planning.

summary.zh: 无模型离策略 TD 控制：用 ε-贪心采样学习最优动作价值 Q*。
summary.en: Model-free off-policy TD control: learn optimal action values Q* using ε-greedy sampling.

summary.zh: 无模型 RL，用 Q 表离线更新。
summary.en: Model-free RL updating Q-table off-policy.

summary.zh: 陷入局部最优即随机重启。
summary.en: Restarts from random state on local optimum.

summary.zh: 每步随机选邻居前进。
summary.en: Randomly moves to a neighbor each step.

title.zh: RAVE 快速动作价值估计

summary.zh: 用「全局动作统计」为早期 MCTS 节点提供低方差的价值估计，加速收敛。
summary.en: Use global action statistics to give low-variance value estimates for early MCTS nodes, speeding convergence.

summary.zh: 线性空间最佳优先，f 上界随递归回传。
summary.en: Linear-space best-first with f-limit backtracking.

summary.zh: 用时序差分 TD(0) 在马尔可夫奖励过程中估计给定时不变策略的状态价值。
summary.en: Estimate state values of a fixed policy in a Markov Reward Process using temporal-difference TD(0) updates.

summary.zh: 随机增量式扩展运动规划树。
summary.en: Incrementally grows a random tree for planning.

summary.zh: 每步选最优邻居并把 h 设为次优。
summary.en: Each step picks best neighbor, h set to 2nd best.

summary.zh: 无模型在策略 TD 控制：用 ε-贪心下一动作直接自举，学习当前策略的动作价值。
summary.en: Model-free on-policy TD control: bootstrap using the ε-greedy next action directly, learning the action value of the current policy.

summary.zh: 用条件概率对博弈树叶子估值，序贯更新信念，逼近期望效用。
summary.en: Estimate game-tree leaves via conditional probabilities, updating beliefs sequentially to approximate expected utility.

summary.zh: 以概率 exp(Δ/T) 接受劣解，温度按计划衰减。
summary.en: Accept worse moves with probability exp(Δ/T); temperature cools on a schedule.

title.zh: SMA* 简化记忆受限 A*

summary.zh: 内存受限的 A*，超出预算时丢弃最差节点。
summary.en: Memory-bounded A* that forgets worst node on overflow.

summary.zh: 软剪枝：容忍少量越界继续搜索，适合带噪声的评估函数。
summary.en: Soft pruning: tolerate small out-of-window values, suited to noisy evaluation.

summary.zh: SSS*：用最佳优先遍历博弈树叶子的状态集，理论上比 alpha-beta 展开更少节点。
summary.en: SSS*: best-first traversal of a state set over game-tree leaves, theoretically expanding no more nodes than alpha-beta.

summary.zh: 按概率接受更好邻居。
summary.en: Probabilistically accepts uphill neighbors.

summary.zh: 把 TD(λ) 应用到 alpha-beta 主路径的叶子估值，自学评估函数权重。
summary.en: Apply TD(λ) to the leaf evaluations along the alpha-beta principal variation to self-learn evaluation weights.

summary.zh: 无模型策略评估 V 值。
summary.en: Model-free V evaluation bootstrapping 1 step.

summary.zh: 教师阶段向最优靠拢，学习阶段两两交互（Sphere 目标）。
summary.en: Teacher phase moves toward best; learner phase pairs interact (Sphere target).

summary.zh: 将单步 TD 与蒙特卡洛在 λ 几何加权下统一，对状态价值做 λ-回报估计。
summary.en: Unify one-step TD with Monte Carlo via λ-geometric weighting, estimating state values with the λ-return.

summary.zh: MCTS 选择+扩展阶段：从根沿 UCB1 向下走到未 fully-expanded 或终局节点。
summary.en: MCTS selection + expansion phase: descend from the root via UCB1 until reaching a not-fully-expanded or terminal node.

summary.zh: 在已知 MDP 上反复对贝尔曼最优方程做同步更新，直接逼近最优状态价值。
summary.en: Repeatedly apply synchronous Bellman-optimality backups on a known MDP to converge directly to the optimal state value.

summary.zh: f=g+W·h 的贪心增强版 A*。
summary.en: A* with f=g+W·h, more greedy.

summary.zh: 模拟座头鲸气泡网捕食：收缩包围与螺旋更新切换。
summary.en: Mimics humpback bubble-net feeding: shrink-encircling and spiral update switch.

summary.zh: 窄窗口 alpha-beta：失败时回退到全窗口，命中时大幅剪枝。
summary.en: Narrow-window alpha-beta: fall back to full window on failure; prune hard on hit.

summary.zh: 探狼侦察、猛狼围捕、首领更新（Rastrigin 目标）。
summary.en: Scout wolves reconnoiter, fierce wolves attack, leader updates (Rastrigin target).

summary.zh: 零窗口 alpha-beta：α=β−1，必返回上界或下界。
summary.en: Zero-window alpha-beta: α=β−1 always returns an upper or lower bound.

summary.zh: 用上一轮最佳值 ± 窗口做窄窗口搜索，失败则扩大，减少节点数。
summary.en: Search a narrow window around the previous best value; widen on failure to reduce nodes.

summary.zh: Berliner 的 B*：用乐观/悲观双估值，按最佳优先扩展博弈树直到根的决策证明成立。
summary.en: Berliner's B*: use optimistic/pessimistic bound pairs, best-first expand until a root decision is proven.

summary.zh: 带随机节点的 minimax：MAX 取最大，机会节点取期望（加权平均）。
summary.en: Minimax with chance nodes: MAX maximizes, chance nodes take the expected value.

summary.zh: 在前沿节点（深度 1）若静态评估 + 边际 ≤ α，则该走法不大可能改善 α，直接剪。
summary.en: At frontier nodes (depth 1), if static eval + margin <= alpha the move is unlikely to raise alpha, so prune it.

summary.zh: 记录每个走法引发剪枝的次数，优先搜索「历史得分高」的走法以加速 α-β。
summary.en: Track how often each move causes a cutoff, searching high-scoring moves first to speed up alpha-beta.

summary.zh: 逐步加深深度上限的 DFS，兼顾 BFS 的最优性与 DFS 的低内存。
summary.en: Repeatedly deeper DFS that combines BFS optimality with DFS low memory.

summary.zh: 记录同层引起剪枝的走法，在兄弟节点优先尝试，加速 alpha-beta。
summary.en: Record moves that caused cutoffs at a ply and try them first in siblings to speed up alpha-beta.

summary.zh: 基于威胁数 λ 的搜索：第 λ 层只搜索「恰好 λ 步威胁」的攻击线，逐层放大。
summary.en: Threat-number based search: level λ searches only attack lines that constitute a λ-move threat, escalating level by level.

summary.zh: 排序靠后的走法在足够深处时以缩减深度搜索，若超过 α 再重搜完整深度。
summary.en: Search late-ordered moves at reduced depth when deep enough; re-search full depth if it beats alpha.

summary.zh: 蒙特卡洛树搜索属于ai-search类别。
summary.en: Monte Carlo Tree Search is a ai-search algorithm.

summary.zh: 零和博弈中双方都最优应对时，递归求出根节点的博弈值。
summary.en: Recursively computes the game value of a node under optimal play by both sides.

summary.zh: 从某局面用固定种子随机模拟到终局，统计胜负，估计局面强度。
summary.en: From a position, randomly simulate to terminal with a fixed seed and tally outcomes to estimate strength.

complexity.time: O(N × 平均 rollout 长度)

summary.zh: 统一视角的 minimax：每个节点都取 max(−child)，依赖零和性质。
summary.en: A unified form of minimax: every node takes max(−child), relying on the zero-sum property.

summary.zh: 用零窗口搜索加速 alpha-beta：先探主线，其余用窄窗口快速剪枝。
summary.en: Accelerates alpha-beta with null-window searches: probe PV first, then scout the rest with a narrow window.

summary.zh: 让对手先走一步（不做任何走法），若仍能剪枝则当前局面足够好，直接返回。
summary.en: Pass a move to the opponent; if the resulting position still cuts off, the current node is good enough to return.

summary.zh: 多线程并行执行 MCTS 的选择/模拟：树并行（锁节点）+ 根并行（独立树投票）。
summary.en: Run MCTS selection/simulation in parallel: tree parallelism (locked nodes) + root parallelism (independent trees vote).

summary.zh: 假设第一个走法在主线上用全窗搜索，其余用零窗口探测，失败才重搜。
summary.en: Assume the first move is on the PV with full window; scout the rest with a null window, re-search only on failure.

summary.zh: MCTS 初期用领域启发式给节点加偏置项，访问次数增加后让位给 UCB。
summary.en: Inject a domain-heuristic bias into MCTS early on; cede to UCB as visits accumulate.

summary.zh: 在 AND-OR 树上求证/反证，用证明数与反证数指导最关键节点展开。
summary.en: Prove/disprove on an AND-OR tree, guided by proof and disproof numbers of the most critical node.

summary.zh: 到达深度限制后，继续搜索"活跃"走法（如吃子）直到局面静止，克服地平线效应。
summary.en: Past the depth limit, keep searching "noisy" moves (captures) until the position is quiet, mitigating the horizon effect.

title.zh: RAVE 快速动作价值估计

summary.zh: MCTS 的 AMAF 启发：用「此后出现的所有动作」共同估计某动作的价值，加速早期收敛。
summary.en: AMAF-style heuristic in MCTS: estimate a move's value using all moves that appear later, accelerating early convergence.

summary.zh: 在期望搜索（expectimax 的 chance 节点）中用上下界快速剪掉不可能的子节点。
summary.en: Prune unlikely children at chance nodes of expectimax using upper/lower value bounds.

summary.zh: 用 Zobrist 哈希记录已搜局面，避免在博弈树中重复计算同一状态。
summary.en: Hash already-searched positions via Zobrist hashing to avoid recomputation across transpositions.

summary.zh: 把 UCB1 用于树节点选择：在利用（胜率）与探索（少见）间做最优权衡。
summary.en: Applies UCB1 to tree-node selection, optimally balancing exploitation (win rate) and exploration (rarity).

summary.zh: wqs二分DP属于dp类别。
summary.en: Alien Trick is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 状压 DP（TSP 旅行商）属于dp类别。
summary.en: Bitmask DP (Traveling Salesman) is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 有界背包属于dp类别。
summary.en: Bounded Knapsack is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 戳气球属于dp类别。
summary.en: Burst Balloons is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 分糖果属于dp类别。
summary.en: Candy is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 零钱兑换属于dp类别。
summary.en: Coin Change is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 凸优化DP属于dp类别。
summary.en: Convex Hull Trick is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 计数 DP属于dp类别。
summary.en: Counting DP is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 解码方法属于dp类别。
summary.en: Decode Ways is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 依赖背包属于dp类别。
summary.en: Dependent Knapsack is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 数位 DP属于dp类别。
summary.en: Digit DP is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 分治DP属于dp类别。
summary.en: Divide DP is a dp algorithm.

title.zh: 参加最多活动（按结束时间 dp）

summary.zh: 给定若干区间 [start,end)，求不重叠地参加最多活动数。
summary.en: Given intervals, attend max number of non-overlapping meetings.

summary.zh: 长度为 n 的串，A<2 且无连续 3 个 L，统计合法出勤记录方案数。
summary.en: Count attendance strings of length n with <2 A and no "LLL", modulo 1e9+7.

summary.zh: scores[i]+scores[j]+i-j，求最大值（i<j）。
summary.en: Maximize scores[i]+scores[j]+i-j with i<j.

title.zh: 买卖股票最佳时机（单次）
title.en: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock (Once)

summary.zh: 只允许一次买入一次卖出，求最大利润。
summary.en: At most one buy and one sell; maximize profit.

summary.zh: m×n 棋盘从左上到右下，只能向右或向下，求不同路径数。
summary.en: Count distinct paths from top-left to bottom-right on an m×n grid, moving only right or down.

title.zh: 爬楼梯（最多 k 步）

summary.zh: 每次可爬 1..k 阶，求到达顶部的方案数。
summary.en: Climb 1..k steps each move; count distinct ways to top.

summary.zh: 每次可走 steps 中任一阶，求到达第 n 阶的方案数。
summary.en: Each time you may climb any step count in a set; count ways to reach stair n.

summary.zh: 每次可爬 1 或 2 阶，但某些台阶是障碍不能踩，求到达顶部的方案数。
summary.en: Climb 1 or 2 steps, but avoid obstacle steps; count distinct ways to the top.

summary.zh: 可爬 1 或 2 阶，每阶有代价，求到顶最小累计（O(1) 空间滚动数组版本）。
summary.en: Climb 1 or 2 steps each with a cost; reach the top with min total (O(1) space rolling DP).

title.zh: 零钱兑换（求最少硬币数）

summary.zh: 给定硬币面额，凑出金额 amount 所需的最少硬币数。
summary.en: Minimum number of coins to make up amount.

summary.zh: 求凑成总金额的最少硬币数，并输出字典序最小的方案。
summary.en: Fewest coins to make amount, returning the lexicographically smallest combination.

title.zh: 零钱兑换（贪心失败判定）

summary.zh: 对比贪心与 DP：贪心在某些面值下会失败，DP 永远给出最优解。
summary.en: Contrast greedy with DP: greedy can fail on certain denominations, DP always returns the optimum.

summary.zh: 用若干面额凑成总金额的组合数（不计顺序）。
summary.en: Count combinations of coins that sum to a target amount.

summary.zh: 从左上走到右下，每格有金币，只能向右或向下，求最大收益。
summary.en: Walk top-left to bottom-right collecting coins; only right/down moves; maximize total.

summary.zh: 用 nums 凑成 target 的排列数（顺序不同算不同）。
summary.en: Count permutations of nums that sum to target.

summary.zh: 统计字符串中不同回文子序列的个数。
summary.en: Count the number of distinct palindromic subsequences in a string.

summary.zh: 统计字符串中所有回文子序列的个数。
summary.en: Count the total number of palindromic subsequences of a string.

summary.zh: 网格只能向右或向下，求从左上到右下的路径总数。
summary.en: Count grid paths from top-left to bottom-right moving only right or down.

summary.zh: 从两个数组各取若干位保持相对顺序，拼成长 k 的最大数。
summary.en: Pick digits from two arrays (order preserved) to form the max number of length k.

summary.zh: 顺序运送最多 maxBoxes 个同色段不超过 maxPorts 的盒子，求最少行程。
summary.en: Deliver up to maxBoxes with limited port-segments per trip; minimize trips.

summary.zh: 快递员在数轴上送完所有点的最小路程（区间 DP）。
summary.en: Min travel distance for a courier to deliver to all points on a line (interval DP).

summary.zh: 用 m 面骰子掷出总和为 n 的方法数。
summary.en: Number of ways to roll sum n with an m-faced die.

summary.zh: 从右下到左上逆向 DP，求救出公主所需的最小初始血量。
summary.en: Reverse DP from bottom-right to top-left; find minimum initial HP to rescue the princess.

title.zh: 地下城游戏（最小初始血量）

summary.zh: 从左上到右下，每格增/减血，血须始终 >0，求最小初始血量。
summary.en: Top-left to bottom-right, each cell +/- HP, HP must stay >0; find min initial HP.

summary.zh: 骑士从左上到右下救公主，每格加血或扣血，血量须恒 >0，求最少初始血量。
summary.en: Knight rescues princess; each cell adds/removes HP (must stay >0); find min initial HP.

summary.zh: 把字符串 a 变成 b 的最少插入/删除/替换次数。
summary.en: Minimum insert/delete/replace ops to transform a into b.

summary.zh: 带相邻交换的编辑距离：插入、删除、替换、转置四种操作。
summary.en: Edit distance with adjacent transposition (insert/delete/substitute/swap).

summary.zh: 求两串的 Levenshtein 距离并回溯出最少编辑操作序列。
summary.en: Levenshtein distance plus the actual edit operations via backtracking.

summary.zh: 按顺序把书放上书架，每层限宽限高，最小化总高度。
summary.en: Place books in order on shelves; each shelf has a width limit; minimize total height.

summary.zh: 求两个数组的最长公共连续子数组长度。
summary.en: Find the length of the longest common contiguous subarray of two arrays.

summary.zh: 青蛙每次跳 1 或 2 块石头，求到终点的最小累计代价。
summary.en: A frog jumps 1 or 2 stones at a time; minimize total cost to the last stone.

summary.zh: 青蛙每次可跳 1~K 步，代价为高度差绝对值，求到终点的最小代价。
summary.en: A frog may jump 1..K stones; cost is the absolute height difference; minimize total.

summary.zh: 青蛙从一岸跳到对岸，每跳消耗能量，求最小总代价。
summary.en: Frog crosses stones; each jump costs energy; find minimum total cost to the far bank.

summary.zh: 青蛙最多跳 cost 步远，求到达终点的最小代价。
summary.en: Frog can jump up to cost steps at a time; find min cost to reach the end.

summary.zh: 相邻房屋不可同时选，求最大收益（线性 DP）。
summary.en: Maximize loot without choosing two adjacent houses (linear DP).

summary.zh: 环形排列首尾相邻，拆成两段线性子问题取最大。
summary.en: Circular layout: split into two linear ranges and take the max.

summary.zh: 二叉树形村庄，相邻节点不能同时抢，求最大收益。
summary.en: Tree-shaped village; cannot rob adjacent nodes; maximize the loot.

summary.zh: 房屋排成二叉树，相邻父子不能同抢，求能偷到的最大金额。
summary.en: Houses arranged in a binary tree; cannot rob both parent and child. Maximize loot.

summary.zh: 判断 s3 是否由 s1、s2 交错组成。
summary.en: Determine whether s3 is formed by interleaving s1 and s2.

summary.zh: 求 1..n 的排列中恰有 k 个逆序对的数目（取模）。
summary.en: Count permutations of 1..n with exactly k inverse pairs (mod).

summary.zh: n 个物品、容量 W，每物品取或不取，求最大价值。空间 O(W)。
summary.en: 0-1 knapsack with 1D rolling array, space O(W).

summary.zh: 经典 01 背包，用一维 dp 数组倒序滚动节省空间。
summary.en: Classic 0/1 knapsack with a 1D rolling array, iterating capacity backwards.

summary.zh: 同时含 0/1、完全、多重三种物品的背包求最大价值。
summary.en: Knapsack combining 0/1, unbounded, and bounded items to maximize value.

summary.zh: 骑士按 8 个日字方向随机走 k 步，求仍留在棋盘的概率。
summary.en: A knight makes k random L-shaped moves; find the probability it stays on the board.

summary.zh: 任选两块石头相撞粉碎，差值留下，求最后一块石头的最小可能重量。
summary.en: Smash two stones each turn; the difference remains; minimize the last stone weight.

summary.zh: 求同时包含两字符串为子序列的最短字符串长度。
summary.en: Find the length of the shortest string containing both strings as subsequences.

title.zh: LCS 三维（三串最长公共子序列）

summary.zh: 求三个字符串的最长公共子序列长度，三维 DP。
summary.en: Longest common subsequence among three strings via 3D DP.

title.zh: 最长公共子序列（滚动数组优化）

summary.zh: 两序列的最长公共子序列，用滚动数组把空间降到 O(min(n,m))。
summary.en: Longest common subsequence with rolling array, space O(min(n,m)).

summary.zh: 求最长递增子序列的长度并统计达到该长度的子序列个数。
summary.en: Find LIS length and count how many distinct LIS achieve it.

title.en: LIS via Binary Search (O(n log n))

summary.zh: 用「牌堆」二分法求最长递增子序列长度，时间复杂度降为 O(n log n)。
summary.en: Patience sorting: binary search on piles to compute LIS length in O(n log n).

title.zh: 最长递增子序列（贪心+二分）

summary.zh: O(n log n) 贪心二分求最长严格递增子序列长度。
summary.en: O(n log n) greedy + binary search for LIS length.

summary.zh: DP 求（可重排选取的）最长等差子序列长度。
summary.en: DP for the longest arithmetic subsequence length.

summary.zh: 记忆化 DFS：每步走向数值更大的相邻格，求最长路径。
summary.en: Memoized DFS: move to larger-value neighbors; find the longest path.

summary.zh: DP 求括号串中最长有效（正确配对）子串长度。
summary.en: DP for the length of the longest valid (well-formed) parentheses substring.

summary.zh: 同时维护当前最大积与最小积，遇负数翻转，求全局最大乘积。
summary.en: Track current max and min products (swap on negative); return global maximum.

summary.zh: 找出数组中乘积最大的连续子数组，返回该乘积。
summary.en: Find the contiguous subarray with the largest product.

summary.zh: n 城每周可飞，求 W 周内最大休假天数。
summary.en: Fly between n cities each week to maximize vacation days over W weeks.

summary.zh: 数组中连续子数组的最大乘积（含负数）。
summary.en: Maximum product of a contiguous subarray (may include negatives).

summary.zh: 每阶有代价，可爬 1 或 2 阶，求到顶的最小累计代价。
summary.en: Each step has a cost; climb 1 or 2 steps; minimize total cost to reach the top.

summary.zh: 把数组分成两个子集，使两子集和的差的绝对值最小。
summary.en: Partition an array into two subsets to minimize the absolute difference of their sums.

summary.zh: 在带障碍的网格上从左上走到右下，每次只能向右或向下，求最小权和。
summary.en: From top-left to bottom-right on a grid with obstacles; move right/down; minimize cost.

summary.zh: 从三角形顶点到底部相邻结点的最小路径和。
summary.en: Minimum path sum from triangle top to bottom via adjacent numbers.

summary.zh: 3 道青蛙跳跃，避开障碍物，最少侧跳到达终点。
summary.en: A frog on a 3-lane road dodges obstacles; minimize side jumps to finish.

summary.zh: m×n 网格，从左上到右下每次只能右移或下移，求最小路径和。
summary.en: Top-left to bottom-right moving only right/down; minimize path sum.

title.zh: 歌单组合（恰好 K 首 N 分钟）

summary.zh: 从 n 首歌中选若干首拼成总长恰好 target 的歌单，每首最多用一次，求方案数。
summary.en: Pick songs (0/1) to form a playlist of exact target length; count ways.

title.zh: 歌曲列表（不同歌间隔 k）

summary.zh: 从 n 首歌、目标长度 L 的歌单，每首歌与前 k 首不同（歌单可循环），求方案数。
summary.en: Count playlists of length L from n unique songs; same song repeats only after k other songs.

summary.zh: 概率 DP：抽 1..W 累分，停手后分数 ≤ N 的概率。
summary.en: Probability DP: drawing 1..W until threshold, find P(final score <= N).

summary.zh: 求数组最长严格递增子序列的个数。
summary.en: Count the number of longest strictly increasing subsequences.

summary.zh: DP 计数：n 首歌、长 L 的播放列表，每首至少一次、间隔≥k。
summary.en: DP counting: playlists of length L over n songs, each at least once, gap >= k.

summary.zh: n 首歌组播放列表长 goal，两首同歌间隔至少 k，求方案数取模。
summary.en: Build a goal-length playlist from n songs with gap k between repeats; count mod 1e9+7.

summary.zh: 二维 0/1 背包：用 m 个 0、n 个 1 最多拼出多少个字符串。
summary.en: 2D 0/1 knapsack: form as many strings as possible with m zeros and n ones.

summary.zh: 网格四向移动，maxMove 步内走出边界的路径数（取模）。
summary.en: Count paths leaving an m-by-n grid within maxMove moves (mod).

summary.zh: n 个房子，每房只能粉刷红/蓝/绿一种颜色，相邻不能同色，求最小成本。
summary.en: n houses, paint each red/blue/green, no two adjacent same color; min cost.

title.zh: 栅栏涂色（最多 2 同色）

summary.zh: k 种颜色涂 n 根栅栏，任意 3 相邻不能同色，求方案数。
summary.en: Paint n fences with k colors; no three adjacent fences may share a color.

summary.zh: 已有部分上色的 m 栋房，用 n 种色形成 target 个街区，求最小成本。
summary.en: Paint m houses with n colors to form target neighborhoods at minimum cost.

summary.zh: n 栋房子、k 种颜色，相邻不同色，求最小粉刷成本。
summary.en: Paint n houses with k colors, adjacent houses different color; minimize total cost.

summary.zh: 区间 DP 统计字符串中所有回文子串个数。
summary.en: Interval DP counting all palindromic substrings.

summary.zh: n 门课有先修依赖，可并行修读，求修完最少学期数。
summary.en: n courses with prerequisites; take them in parallel; find the minimum semesters.

summary.zh: 首尾相连的环形街，不能同时偷相邻两家，求最大金额。
summary.en: Houses in a circle; cannot rob two adjacent; maximize loot.

summary.zh: 把整数 n 拆成至少两个正整数之和，使乘积最大。
summary.en: Split n into >=2 positive integers to maximize product.

title.zh: 分割数组最大和（二分答案）

summary.zh: 将数组分成 m 个连续段，最小化最大段和。用二分答案求解。
summary.en: Split array into m contiguous subarrays to minimize the largest sum; via binary search on the answer.

summary.zh: 将数组分成 m 段连续子数组，使最大段和最小。
summary.en: Split array into m contiguous subarrays minimizing the largest subarray sum.

title.en: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock with Cooldown

summary.zh: 卖出后次日不能买入（冷冻期），求最大利润，可无限次交易。
summary.en: Unlimited trades but a one-day cooldown after selling; maximize profit.

title.zh: 买卖股票 VI（带手续费）
title.en: Best Time Buy/Sell Stock VI (with Fee)

summary.zh: 可无限次交易，但每次卖出需交固定手续费，求最大利润。
summary.en: Unlimited trades, each sell incurs a fixed transaction fee; maximize profit.

title.zh: 买卖股票 VII（含冷冻期）

summary.zh: 无限次交易但卖出后次日不能买入（冷冻期），求最大利润。
summary.en: Unlimited trades with a 1-day cooldown after selling; maximize profit.

title.en: Best Time to Buy/Sell with Fee

summary.zh: 可多次买卖，每次卖出收手续费 fee，求最大利润。
summary.en: Unlimited trades, pay fee per sell; max profit.

title.en: Best Time to Buy/Sell with Cooldown

summary.zh: 多次买卖，卖出后第二天不能买入（冷冻期 1 天），求最大利润。
summary.en: Unlimited trades, 1-day cooldown after sell; max profit.

title.en: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock with Cooldown

summary.zh: 卖出后次日必须冷冻一天，求最大利润。
summary.en: After selling you must cool down one day; maximize profit.

title.en: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock with Transaction Fee

summary.zh: 无限次交易，但每笔交易需付固定手续费，求最大利润。
summary.en: Unlimited trades, each with a fixed transaction fee; maximize profit.

title.en: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock II

summary.zh: 允许多次买卖（同时最多持有一股），求最大利润。
summary.en: Unlimited transactions but hold at most one share; maximize profit.

summary.zh: n 堆石子，每次合并相邻两堆代价为两堆之和，求最小总代价。
summary.en: Merge adjacent piles (cost = sum of two piles); minimize total cost.

title.zh: 石子合并（区间 DP + 前缀和）

summary.zh: 一排石子每次合并相邻两堆代价为二者之和，求最小总代价。
summary.en: Merge adjacent piles; cost is sum of two piles; minimize total cost via interval DP.

summary.zh: 取前若干块石子合并到首位，得分等于新首位，求先手最优分差。
summary.en: Merge a chosen prefix into the first stone; gain the new first value; find optimal score difference.

summary.zh: 两人轮流取平方数个石子，取走最后一个者胜。
summary.en: Two players remove a square number of stones; last mover wins.

summary.zh: 沿一行石子切分，丢弃较大半，得分取较小半，递归求最大总分。
summary.en: Split a row of stones; discard the heavier half, score the lighter, recurse for max total.

summary.zh: 把字符串切成若干回文子串的最少切割次数。
summary.en: Minimum cuts to partition a string into palindromic substrings.

summary.zh: K 个鸡蛋 N 层楼，二分优化 DP 求最少试探次数。
summary.en: K eggs, N floors: binary-search optimized DP for minimum trials.

summary.zh: 每次每台机器可向相邻移动一件衣服，求让所有机器衣服数相同的最少操作轮数。
summary.en: Move one dress per machine per step to an adjacent machine; minimize steps to equalize.

summary.zh: 每台洗衣机可向相邻机器移动一件衣服，求使所有机器衣服数相等的最少操作轮数。
summary.en: Each move shifts one dress to an adjacent machine; min rounds to equalize all machines.

summary.zh: n 台洗衣机，每台可向相邻移动 1 件衣服，求使所有台数相等的最少步数。
summary.en: Each move shifts 1 dress to neighbor; min moves to equalize all machines.

summary.zh: 每根钢管放左、右或不放，使两支撑等高，求该最大高度。
summary.en: Place each rod on the left support, right support, or skip; maximize the equal support height.

summary.zh: 用 1×2 砖铺满 2×N 通道的方案数（斐波那契）。
summary.en: Number of ways to tile a 2×N corridor with 1×2 dominoes (Fibonacci).

summary.zh: 用 1×2 多米诺铺满 2×N 网格的方案数（斐波那契）。
summary.en: Number of ways to tile a 2×N grid with 1×2 dominoes (Fibonacci).

summary.zh: 用 2×1 多米诺和 L 型三联骨牌铺满 2×n 板，求方案数。
summary.en: Tile a 2xn board with dominos and L-trominoes; count ways modulo 1e9+7.

summary.zh: 用 1×2 多米诺骨牌铺满 2×N 网格的方案数（斐波那契）。
summary.en: Number of ways to tile a 2×N board with 1×2 dominoes (Fibonacci).

summary.zh: 用 2×1 多米诺与 L 型三多米诺铺满 3×N 的方案数。
summary.en: Number of ways to tile a 3×N grid with 2×1 dominoes and L-trominoes.

summary.zh: 每天三选一，相邻天不重复，求最大总幸福度。
summary.en: Pick one of three activities each day, no repeats on consecutive days; maximize happiness.

title.en: Count Vowel Strings of Length n

summary.zh: 长度 n、仅由 a/e/i/o/u 组成且按元音字典序非递减的字符串数。
summary.en: Count length-n strings over a/e/i/o/u, non-decreasing in vowel order.

summary.zh: 每个元音字母后只能跟某些元音，求长度为 n 的合法元音序列数。
summary.en: Each vowel permits only certain following vowels; count length-n vowel strings.

summary.zh: N 天销售商品，每日可进货或卖货但只能选其一，求最大利润。
summary.en: Sell goods over N days; each day either buy or sell exactly one unit; maximize profit.

summary.zh: 编辑距离属于dp类别。
summary.en: Edit Distance is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 扔鸡蛋属于dp类别。
summary.en: Egg Drop is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 加油站属于dp类别。
summary.en: Gas Station is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 分组背包属于dp类别。
summary.en: Group Knapsack is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 区间 DP（石子合并）属于dp类别。
summary.en: Interval DP (Stone Merge) is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 跳跃游戏属于dp类别。
summary.en: Jump Game is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 0/1 背包属于dp类别。
summary.en: 0/1 Knapsack is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 完全背包属于dp类别。
summary.en: Complete Knapsack is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 多重背包属于dp类别。
summary.en: Multiple Knapsack is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 四边形不等式DP属于dp类别。
summary.en: Knuth Optimization is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 最长公共子序列属于dp类别。
summary.en: Longest Common Subsequence is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 最长递增子序列属于dp类别。
summary.en: Longest Increasing Subsequence is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: LIS二分属于dp类别。
summary.en: LIS nlogn is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: LIS线段树属于dp类别。
summary.en: LIS Segment is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 最长公共前缀属于dp类别。
summary.en: LCP Array is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 最长回文子串属于dp类别。
summary.en: Longest Palindromic Substring is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 矩阵连乘属于dp类别。
summary.en: Matrix Chain Multiply is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 矩阵链DP2属于dp类别。
summary.en: Matrix Chain DP2 is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 最大矩形属于dp类别。
summary.en: Max Rectangle is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 最大子段和（Kadane）属于dp类别。
summary.en: Maximum Subarray (Kadane) is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 最大正方形属于dp类别。
summary.en: Maximal Square is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 最小路径和属于dp类别。
summary.en: Min Path Sum is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 骰子求和属于dp类别。
summary.en: Dice Sum is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 粉刷房子属于dp类别。
summary.en: Paint House is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 回文分割属于dp类别。
summary.en: Palindrome Partition is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 划分DP属于dp类别。
summary.en: Partition DP is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 概率 DP属于dp类别。
summary.en: Probability DP is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 正则匹配属于dp类别。
summary.en: Regex Match is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 俄罗斯套娃属于dp类别。
summary.en: Russian Doll is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 斜率优化DP属于dp类别。
summary.en: Slope Trick is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 高维前缀和DP属于dp类别。
summary.en: SOS DP is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 状压进阶（轮廓线 DP）属于dp类别。
summary.en: State Compression (Profile DP) is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 取石子属于dp类别。
summary.en: Stone Game is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 子集和属于dp类别。
summary.en: Subset Sum is a dp algorithm.

title.zh: 树形 DP（树的最大独立集）

summary.zh: 树形 DP（树的最大独立集）属于dp类别。
summary.en: Tree DP (Max Independent Set) is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 三角路径属于dp类别。
summary.en: Triangle Path is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 不同路径属于dp类别。
summary.en: Unique Paths is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: 通配符匹配属于dp类别。
summary.en: Wildcard Match is a dp algorithm.

summary.zh: Alpha-Beta 剪枝属于game类别。
summary.en: Alpha-Beta Pruning is a game algorithm.

summary.zh: 逐步加深搜索深度，每层用 alpha-beta 剪枝，配合置换表/最佳着法排序。
summary.en: Gradually increase search depth, applying alpha-beta at each level with best-move ordering.

summary.zh: 巴什博弈属于game类别。
summary.en: Bash Game is a game algorithm.

summary.zh: 从 1..maxChoose 选数累加，先到 desiredTotal 者胜（状压记忆化）。
summary.en: Pick numbers from 1..maxChoose to reach desiredTotal first (bitmask memo).

summary.zh: 给一个中国象棋局面打分：子力 + 位置（PST）。
summary.en: Score a Chinese chess position: material + piece-square table.

summary.zh: 面对 n 枚硬币每次取 1..m 枚，取最后一枚者胜（SG/Bash 定理）。
summary.en: Take 1..m coins from a pile of n; taker of the last coin wins (SG/Bash).

summary.zh: 四子棋AI属于game类别。
summary.en: Connect Four AI is a game algorithm.

summary.zh: N 上选真因数 x 使 N 减 x，先到 1 者胜（Alice 先手）。
summary.en: Pick a proper divisor x of N, N -= x; first to reach 1 wins (Alice first).

summary.zh: 期望极小极大属于game类别。
summary.en: Expectiminimax is a game algorithm.

summary.zh: 所有竞拍者都付自己的出价，无论是否中标；常用于游说/竞赛建模。
summary.en: All bidders pay their bid regardless of winning; models lobbying and contests.

summary.zh: 所有竞标者都支付自己的报价，最高者得标，模型游说/R&D 竞赛。
summary.en: Every bidder pays their bid; highest bid wins the prize; models lobbying and R&D races.

summary.zh: 密封拍卖：多人出价，最高者得物并支付出价，分析各参与者收益。
summary.en: Sealed-bid auction: each bids, highest wins and pays the bid; analyze each player's payoff.

summary.zh: 对密封投标拍卖模拟：给定估值与出价，决定中标者与支付。
summary.en: Simulate a sealed-bid auction: given valuations and bids, decide the winner and the payment.

summary.zh: 两玩家交替选区间，决定交点是否落入目标集，刻画 Baire 范畴。
summary.en: Two players alternately choose nested intervals; whether the limit point lies in the target set characterizes Baire category.

summary.zh: UCB1：以置信上界选臂，平衡探索与利用，regret 为 O(log n)。
summary.en: UCB1 picks arms by upper confidence bound, balancing explore/exploit with O(log n) regret.

summary.zh: 两人偏好不同活动但都希望在一起，有两个纯纳什与一个混合纳什。
summary.en: Two prefer different activities but both want to be together; two pure Nash and one mixed.

summary.zh: 夫妻想在一起但偏好不同活动；两个帕累托有效纯纳什。
summary.en: Couple wants to be together but prefers different activities; two pareto-efficient pure Nash.

summary.zh: 玩家有不完全信息（私有类型），按类型先验最大化期望收益。
summary.en: Players have incomplete information (private types) and maximize expected payoff given priors.

summary.zh: 不完全信息博弈中，每人按类型依策略最大化期望收益。
summary.en: In games of incomplete info, each type plays the strategy maximizing expected payoff.

summary.zh: 两厂商同时定价，低价者获全部市场，均衡价格等于边际成本。
summary.en: Two firms set prices; the lower price captures all demand; equilibrium price equals marginal cost.

summary.zh: 买方估值 vs 卖方成本，求激励相容且个体理性的交易机制。
summary.en: Buyer valuation vs seller cost; design incentive-compatible, individually rational trade mechanism.

summary.zh: 用极简扑克规则比较两手 5 张牌，返回较大者。
summary.en: Compare two 5-card hands with simplified poker rules and return the winner.

title.zh: 象棋残局（将军最短步数）

summary.zh: 极小极大求在受限局面下先手将杀对方所需的最少步数。
summary.en: Minimax to find the minimum moves to checkmate in a constrained endgame.

summary.zh: 两人开车对冲，都不让则双输，互让次之，一进一退最优在进者。两个纯纳什（一进一退）。
summary.en: Two drivers swerve toward each other; both straight = crash, both swerve = ok, one straight one swerve favors the bold. Two pure Nash (asymmetric).

summary.zh: 两车对冲：直行赢面子、转向保命；双直行同归于尽。
summary.en: Two cars head-on: swerving loses face, going straight wins; both going straight is disaster.

summary.zh: 度量在线算法相对离线最优的性能，比值越小越优。
summary.en: Measures online-algorithm performance vs offline optimum; smaller ratio is better.

summary.zh: 带深度限制的极小极大求解四子棋最优落列。
summary.en: Depth-limited minimax to solve the best column in Connect Four.

summary.zh: 用 Shapley 值把联盟总收益公平分配给各参与者。
summary.en: Distribute coalition payoff fairly among players using Shapley values.

summary.zh: 玩家可签约束协议；关注联盟与核心分配，而非个人策略。
summary.en: Players can sign binding agreements; focuses on coalitions and core allocations rather than individual strategies.

summary.zh: 双方选同一行动都得正收益，有多个纯纳什。分析帕累托占优均衡。
summary.en: Both gain by choosing the same action; multiple pure Nash. Identify the pareto-dominant equilibrium.

summary.zh: 双方做同一选择即得奖励；两个等价纯纳什。
summary.en: Both choosing the same action yields reward; two equivalent pure Nash.

summary.zh: 合作博弈核心：任何联盟都不能通过单干获得更多，保证稳定性。
summary.en: Core of a cooperative game: no coalition can do better alone, ensuring stability.

summary.zh: 调解者发出相关信号，理性玩家不会偏离推荐策略。
summary.en: A mediator sends correlated signals; rational players never deviate from the recommendation.

summary.zh: 两厂商同时选产量，市场价格由总产量决定，求纳什均衡。
summary.en: Two firms choose quantities simultaneously; price falls with total quantity; find Nash equilibrium.

summary.zh: 线上搜索问题：在一条双向线上找目标，使用倍增回溯达到竞争比 9。
summary.en: Online search on a two-way line: doubling-strategy backtracking yields competitive ratio 9.

summary.zh: 一人决定如何分配固定总额给沉默的接收者，衡量纯粹利他。
summary.en: One player allocates a fixed sum to a silent recipient; measures pure altruism.

summary.zh: 决策者偏好已知概率胜过模糊概率，违反主观期望效用公理。
summary.en: Decision makers prefer known-probability bets over ambiguous ones, violating SEU axioms.

summary.zh: 最高出价者中标并付自己的出价；理性出价需低于估值（bid shading）。
summary.en: Highest bidder wins and pays their own bid; rational bidding is below valuation (bid shading).

summary.zh: 两人分一美元，谈判失败则按概率随机分配，求子博弈完美。
summary.en: Two split a dollar; failure triggers probabilistic fallback; find subgame-perfect split.

summary.zh: 公平/有偏随机游走：求到达 N 前先破产 0 的概率。
summary.en: Random walk with absorbing barriers 0 and N; probability of ruin before reaching N.

summary.zh: 把多个独立子游戏视为森林，每棵树求 SG 值再异或合并。
summary.en: Treat multiple independent subgames as a forest; compute each tree SG then XOR-combine.

summary.zh: 动物争资源：鹰斗、鸽退。两个不对称纯纳什，混合策略给出进化稳定比例。
summary.en: Animals contest a resource: hawks fight, doves retreat. Two asymmetric pure Nash; the mixed strategy yields the ESS frequency.

summary.zh: 资源 V、受伤代价 C：鹰斗鸽得资源、双鹰互伤；演化稳定策略经典模型。
summary.en: Resource V, injury cost C: hawks beat doves, two hawks fight; canonical ESS model.

summary.zh: 行玩家希望匹配、列玩家希望错配；零和、无纯策略纳什。
summary.en: Row wants to match, column wants to mismatch; zero-sum, no pure Nash.

summary.zh: 经典 2×2 零和博弈：双方亮硬币，相同行赢、不同列赢，无纯策略纳什均衡。
summary.en: Classic 2x2 zero-sum: both show a coin; row wins if matching, column if not. No pure Nash equilibrium.

summary.zh: 两人在图上推 token，最大化/最小化循环的平均权重，求值函数。
summary.en: Two players push a token on a weighted graph, maximizing/minimizing cycle mean; compute the value.

summary.zh: Vickrey-Clarke-Groves 机制：分配最大化社会福利，收费等于外部性。
summary.en: VCG mechanism: allocate to maximize social welfare, charge each player their externality.

summary.zh: 不借助可信发牌人，用交换式加密实现公平发牌。
summary.en: Fair card dealing without a trusted dealer, via commutative encryption exchanges.

title.zh: 马尔可夫奖励过程最优

summary.zh: 在 MRP 上贝尔曼方程求状态价值函数 V = R + γPV。
summary.en: Bellman equation on an MRP: state values V = R + γPV via linear solve.

summary.zh: 对 2x2 双矩阵博弈求解混合策略纳什：使对手在两纯策略间无差异。
summary.en: Solve the mixed-strategy Nash of a 2x2 bimatrix game: make the opponent indifferent between pure strategies.

summary.zh: 每堆每次最多取 maxTake 颗的 Nim 变种，用取模判定胜负。
summary.en: A Nim variant with a per-turn maxTake limit per heap; decide winner by modulo sum.

summary.zh: 双方收益之和非常数；可存在双赢或多重均衡。
summary.en: Sum of payoffs is non-constant; allows win-win or multiple equilibria.

summary.zh: 识别收益空间中不被任何结果同时改进的帕累托前沿。
summary.en: Identify the Pareto frontier: outcomes not dominated by any other in all coordinates.

summary.zh: 节点带优先级，玩家 Even/Odd 使最终优先级为偶/奇，验证 μ-演算模型检测。
summary.en: Nodes carry priorities; Even/Odd make the final priority even/odd; underpins μ-calculus model checking.

summary.zh: T>R>P>S；唯一纯纳什 (D,D) 帕累托劣于 (C,C)。
summary.en: T>R>P>S; unique pure Nash (D,D) is pareto-dominated by (C,C).

summary.zh: 经典 2×2 博弈：双方都背叛是唯一纳什均衡，却劣于双方合作。
summary.en: Classic 2x2: mutual defection is the unique Nash, yet pareto-dominated by mutual cooperation.

summary.zh: 每人投资到公共池，池乘以系数后平分，揭示搭便车问题。
summary.en: Each invests in a shared pool multiplied then split equally; reveals free-riding.

summary.zh: 2x2 零和博弈求混合纳什：行玩家最小化列玩家最大收益。
summary.en: 2x2 zero-sum mixed Nash: row minimizes columns max payoff via von Neumann minimax.

summary.zh: 把单次囚徒困境重复 T 轮；触发策略（如 Tit-for-Tat）可维持合作。
summary.en: Repeat a stage game (PD) for T rounds; trigger strategies (Tit-for-Tat) can sustain cooperation.

summary.zh: 最高出价中标、付次高价；占优策略是诚实出价。
summary.en: Highest bid wins and pays the second-highest; truthful bidding is dominant.

summary.zh: 安全值 m 下，抛骰子收益为点数，点数>m 则重抛，求最优 m。
summary.en: Roll a die for its face; reroll if face>m. Find the optimal stopping threshold m.

summary.zh: 合作博弈中按边际贡献加权的公平分配，满足对称/无效玩家/加性公理。
summary.en: Cooperative game fair share weighted by marginal contribution; satisfies symmetry/dummy/additivity.

summary.zh: 把硬币左移不可越过其它硬币，用相邻间隔异或和判定先手胜负。
summary.en: Move coins left without crossing others; winner decided by XOR of adjacent gaps.

summary.zh: Wald SPRT：逐步抽样依似然比阈值判定假设，平均样本量最小。
summary.en: Wald SPRT: sample sequentially, decide by likelihood-ratio bounds; minimizes expected sample size.

summary.zh: 抛硬币首次正面回合奖金翻倍，期望无穷但人们只愿付有限金额。
summary.en: Coin flips double the prize each round until first heads; expected value is infinite yet people pay finite.

summary.zh: 合作猎鹿收益高但需双方信任，单干猎兔保底。有两个纯纳什：(猎鹿,猎鹿) 与 (猎兔,猎兔)。
summary.en: Cooperative stag hunt pays high but needs trust; hare is safe. Two pure Nash: (stag,stag) and (hare,hare).

summary.zh: 两人合作猎鹿收益最高（4,4），但单干猎兔保底（2,2）；存在两个纯纳什。
summary.en: Cooperating on a stag yields (4,4); hunting a hare alone guarantees (2,2); two pure Nash equilibria.

summary.zh: 领导先行选产量，跟随者反应，领导者获先发优势。
summary.en: Leader moves first choosing quantity, follower reacts; leader gains first-mover advantage.

summary.zh: 状态间转移依赖双方行动；Shapley 1953 的两人零和随机博弈。
summary.en: State transitions depend on both players' actions; Shapley 1953 two-player zero-sum stochastic game.

summary.zh: 区间 DP 求 Alice 每轮取较小一半能获得的最大分数。
summary.en: Interval DP for the max score Alice earns by taking the smaller half each round.

summary.zh: 两人轮流取石子，各自按自己的价值计分，贪心按价值和排序。
summary.en: Two players take turns picking stones scored by their own values; greedy by sum of both values.

summary.zh: 区间 DP：轮流移除边缘石子，得分等于剩余石子和，两人都最大化分差。
summary.en: Interval DP: alternately remove an edge stone, gain the remaining sum; both maximize the score difference.

summary.zh: 选民非真诚投票以避免最差结果，分析 Gibbard-Satterthwaite 不可防策略。
summary.en: Voters vote non-truthfully to avoid worst outcomes; analyzes Gibbard-Satterthwaite manipulability.

summary.zh: 每堆石子只能取属于给定子集 S 的颗数，求 SG 值与先手胜负。
summary.en: From each heap take only a count in set S; compute SG values and first-player win.

summary.zh: 用 minimax 求井字棋任意局面的最优落子与价值。
summary.en: Minimax to find the optimal move and value of any tic-tac-toe position.

summary.zh: 委托人送钱给受托人，金额翻倍后受托人返还，衡量信任与可信。
summary.en: Sender gives money to trustee, multiplied then partially returned; measures trust and trustworthiness.

summary.zh: 通用 minimax 回合制求值框架，演示取石子到 K 的胜负判定。
summary.en: A generic minimax turn-based evaluation framework, demonstrated on take-stones-to-K.

summary.zh: 提议者分一笔钱，回应者接受则按提案分，拒绝则双方得零。
summary.en: Proposer offers a split; responder accepts to finalize it, or rejects so both get 0.

summary.zh: 密封二价拍卖：最高出价者中标但付次高价，诚实出价是占优策略。
summary.en: Sealed second-price auction: highest bidder wins but pays the second-highest bid; truthful bidding is dominant.

summary.zh: 报告真实估值是占优策略，最大化社会福利，收取 Clarke 外部性。
summary.en: Truthful reporting is dominant, social welfare maximized, charge equals Clarke externality.

summary.zh: 群体偏好可能循环：A>B、B>C、C>A，违反传递性。
summary.en: Aggregate preferences can cycle: A>B, B>C, C>A, violating transitivity.

summary.zh: 两玩家争资源持续到一方退出；坚持成本随时间线性增长。
summary.en: Two players contest a resource until one quits; persistence cost grows with time.

summary.zh: 求两人零和矩阵博弈的纯策略鞍点（最优纯策略与博弈值）。
summary.en: Find the pure-strategy saddle point (optimal pure strategies and value) of a two-player zero-sum matrix game.

summary.zh: 行收益即列损失；纯策略纳什 = 鞍点（maximin=minimax）。
summary.en: Row's gain is column's loss; pure Nash = saddle (maximin=minimax).

summary.zh: 五子棋AI属于game类别。
summary.en: Gomoku AI is a game algorithm.

summary.zh: UCB搜索属于game类别。
summary.en: MCTS UCT is a game algorithm.

summary.zh: 极小极大属于game类别。
summary.en: Minimax is a game algorithm.

summary.zh: 极小极大AB剪枝属于game类别。
summary.en: Minimax AB is a game algorithm.

summary.zh: Nim 博弈属于game类别。
summary.en: Nim Game is a game algorithm.

summary.zh: Nim和进阶属于game类别。
summary.en: Nim Sum Advanced is a game algorithm.

summary.zh: 黑白棋评估属于game类别。
summary.en: Othello Eval is a game algorithm.

summary.zh: 两人轮流从数组两端取数，先手分数能否 >= 后手（区间 DP）。
summary.en: Players take numbers from either end; can player 1 tie or win (interval DP)?

summary.zh: A 加速、R 反向，求到达目标位置的最短指令数（BFS/DP）。
summary.en: A to accelerate, R to reverse; shortest instructions to reach target (BFS/DP).

summary.zh: SG定理属于game类别。
summary.en: Sprague-Grundy is a game algorithm.

summary.zh: 可取 1..2M 堆，M 动态变化，求先手最大石子数（记忆化 DP）。
summary.en: Take 1..2M piles, M changes dynamically; find first player's max stones (memoized DP).

summary.zh: 每次可取 1..3 堆，求先手胜负（DP / 字符串结果）。
summary.en: Take 1..3 piles each turn; determine first player's outcome (DP / string result).

summary.zh: 偶数堆石子，轮流从两端取，求先手最大分差（区间 DP）。
summary.en: Even pile of stones, take from either end; find first player's max score gap.

summary.zh: 井字棋AI属于game类别。
summary.en: Tic-Tac-Toe AI is a game algorithm.

summary.zh: 威佐夫博弈属于game类别。
summary.en: Wythoff Game is a game algorithm.

summary.zh: 策梅洛定理属于game类别。
summary.en: Zermelo Theorem is a game algorithm.

summary.zh: A* 寻路属于graph类别。
summary.en: A* Search is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: Floyd-Warshall 三重循环 + next 表，重建任意两点最短路径。
summary.en: Floyd-Warshall triple loop plus a next table to rebuild shortest paths.

summary.zh: 标准 DFS 模板求无向连通图的割点（关节点）。
summary.en: Standard DFS template to find articulation points in an undirected connected graph.

summary.zh: Bellman-Ford 最短路属于graph类别。
summary.en: Bellman-Ford is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 广度优先搜索属于graph类别。
summary.en: Breadth-First Search is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: BFS 交替染 0/1 两色判定二分图。
summary.en: BFS alternating 0/1 coloring to test bipartiteness.

summary.zh: 广度优先按层扩散，记录每一层顶点与距离。
summary.en: Breadth-first expansion layer by layer, recording members and distance.

summary.zh: DFS 维护 dfn/low 与边栈，求无向图的块与割点。
summary.en: DFS with dfn/low and an edge stack to find blocks and cut vertices.

summary.zh: 二分图判定（染色法）属于graph类别。
summary.en: Bipartite Check (Coloring) is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 二分图点覆盖属于graph类别。
summary.en: Bipartite Vertex Cover is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 桥属于graph类别。
summary.en: Bridge is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 桥与割点属于graph类别。
summary.en: Bridges & Articulation Points is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 迭代版 DFS 求无向图的桥（割边）。
summary.en: Iterative DFS to find bridges (cut edges) in an undirected graph.

summary.zh: 仙人掌DP属于graph类别。
summary.en: Cactus DP is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 笛卡尔树属于graph类别。
summary.en: Cartesian Tree is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 圆方树属于graph类别。
summary.en: Circle Double Tree is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 点分治属于graph类别。
summary.en: Centroid Decomposition is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 最大基数搜索求消元序，再验证是否为完美消除序列。
summary.en: MCS for an elimination order, then verify it is a perfect elimination order.

summary.zh: Welsh-Powell：按度数降序，每点取最小可用颜色。
summary.en: Welsh-Powell: order by degree desc, assign the smallest free color.

summary.zh: 割点属于graph类别。
summary.en: Cut Vertex is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 深度优先搜索属于graph类别。
summary.en: Depth-First Search is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: Dijkstra 最短路径属于graph类别。
summary.en: Dijkstra is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 二叉堆优化的 Dijkstra 单源最短路（非负权）。
summary.en: Binary-heap optimized Dijkstra single-source shortest path (non-negative weights).

summary.zh: Dinic 最大流属于graph类别。
summary.en: Dinic Max Flow is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: Dinic加权属于graph类别。
summary.en: Dinic Weighted is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 支配树属于graph类别。
summary.en: Dominator Tree is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 树上启发式合并属于graph类别。
summary.en: DSU on Tree is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: DFS 找桥，删桥后的连通块即边双连通分量。
summary.en: Find bridges via DFS; components after removing bridges are edge-biconnected.

summary.zh: 有向MST属于graph类别。
summary.en: Edmonds MST is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: Hierholzer 算法求经过每条边恰好一次的闭合回路。
summary.en: Hierholzer finds a closed trail using every edge exactly once.

summary.zh: 欧拉路径（Hierholzer）属于graph类别。
summary.en: Euler Path (Hierholzer) is a graph algorithm.

title.zh: 欧拉序（树上 DFS 序）

summary.zh: 对树做 DFS，进入与离开每个节点时都记录，得到欧拉序。
summary.en: DFS a tree recording entry and exit of each node to form the Euler tour array.

summary.zh: Floyd-Warshall 全源最短路属于graph类别。
summary.en: Floyd-Warshall is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 同一邮箱视为同人，合并所有同邮箱账户。
summary.en: Treat accounts sharing an email as one person; merge them.

summary.zh: 由词典中词的相对顺序推出字母的拓扑序。
summary.en: Infer the topological order of alien letters from a sorted word list.

summary.zh: 网格寻路用 A* 配合曼哈顿距离启发，求最短步数路径。
summary.en: Grid pathfinding via A* with Manhattan-distance heuristic for shortest step path.

summary.zh: 支持负权边的单源最短路，并能检测从源可达的负权环。
summary.en: Single-source shortest path with negative edges; detects reachable negative cycles.

summary.zh: 广度优先搜索同时记录每个节点所在的层数，逐层展示扩展过程。
summary.en: BFS recording the depth of each node, expanding one layer at a time.

summary.zh: 在二维网格上广度优先搜索，求最短步数或连通区域。
summary.en: Breadth-first search on a 2D grid for shortest steps or connected regions.

summary.zh: 从源和目标同时 BFS，相遇即得无权图最短路。
summary.en: BFS from both source and target; meet-in-the-middle yields the shortest path.

summary.zh: BFS 给每个节点染色，相邻必须异色，遇冲突即非二分图。
summary.en: BFS-assign colors such that adjacent vertices differ; conflict means not bipartite.

summary.zh: 最小化生成树中最大边权（MBST），等价于 MST 的瓶颈。
summary.en: Minimize the maximum edge weight in a spanning tree (MBST); equals the MST bottleneck.

summary.zh: 展开形如 {a,b}c{d,e} 的表达式为所有组合的字典序。
summary.en: Expand an expression like {a,b}c{d,e} into all sorted combinations.

summary.zh: 找出无向图中删除后会使图不连通的边（桥）。
summary.en: Find edges whose removal disconnects the graph (bridges).

summary.zh: 在最多 k 次中转内从 src 到 dst 的最便宜机票。
summary.en: Cheapest flight from src to dst using at most k stops (Bellman-Ford).

summary.zh: 按节点顺序贪心染最小可用色，相邻不同色。
summary.en: Color each vertex with the smallest color not used by its neighbors.

summary.zh: 按节点重要性依次收缩并加捷径，查询时双向 Dijkstra 只上行。
summary.en: Contract nodes by importance adding shortcuts; bidirectional Dijkstra goes upward only.

summary.zh: 输出一种合法的修课顺序（拓扑序），不可行返回空。
summary.en: Return a valid course order (topological order); empty if infeasible.

summary.zh: 判断给定的先修依赖能否全部修完（无环 DAG）。
summary.en: Determine if all courses can be finished given prerequisites (acyclic check).

summary.zh: 找出无向图中删除后会增加连通分量数的节点（割点 / 关节点）。
summary.en: Find vertices whose removal increases the number of connected components.

summary.zh: 用白/灰/黑三色标记节点状态，便于检测回边（环）。
summary.en: Color nodes white→gray→black to detect back edges and cycles during DFS.

summary.zh: 深度优先遍历网格，对连通的 1 染色，求岛屿数。
summary.en: Depth-first traversal colors connected 1-cells; count distinct islands.

title.zh: Dijkstra（优先队列 + 前驱记录）

summary.zh: 二叉堆优化的单源最短路，并记录前驱以重构最短路径。
summary.en: Binary-heap Dijkstra single-source shortest path, tracking predecessors for path reconstruction.

summary.zh: 从源与汇同时 Dijkstra，相遇即停，加速单源单汇最短路。
summary.en: Run Dijkstra from both source and target; stop on meeting to speed up single-pair shortest path.

summary.zh: 动态选「邻居已用色最多」的节点着色，启发式接近最优。
summary.en: Repeatedly color the vertex whose neighbors use the most distinct colors (saturation).

summary.zh: 为每条边分配颜色使相邻边不同色，贪心用 Δ 或 Δ+1 种色。
summary.en: Assign colors to edges so adjacent edges differ; greedy uses Δ or Δ+1 colors.

summary.zh: BFS 求迷宫从起点到出口的最短步数路径。
summary.en: BFS for the shortest step path from entrance to exit in a maze.

summary.zh: Hierholzer 算法求无向图欧拉回路：当所有顶点度数均为偶数时存在。
summary.en: Hierholzer: find an Euler circuit when every vertex has even degree.

summary.zh: 动态规划求出所有节点对之间的最短路，支持负权（无负环）。
summary.en: DP-based all-pairs shortest paths; tolerates negative edges (no negative cycles).

summary.zh: 回溯搜索经过每个顶点恰好一次并回到起点的回路。
summary.en: Backtracking search for a cycle visiting every vertex exactly once and returning.

summary.zh: 以启发式 f 为阈值迭代加深深度优先搜索，空间极省。
summary.en: Iteratively deepen DFS bounded by heuristic f-threshold; minimal memory.

summary.zh: 染色法判断无向图能否二分（相邻异色）。
summary.en: Two-color each component to test if the graph is bipartite.

summary.zh: VF2 风格回溯：建双射并验证邻域一致性。
summary.en: VF2-style backtracking: build a bijection and verify neighborhood consistency.

title.zh: Kruskal 最小生成树（并查集）

summary.zh: 将边按权升序排序，逐条尝试加入，用并查集判环。
summary.en: Sort edges ascending; add each if its endpoints are in different components (union-find).

summary.zh: 预选若干地标求最短距离下界，加速 A*。
summary.en: Precompute distances to landmark vertices to derive lower bounds that speed up A*.

summary.zh: 预处理 fa[k][v] 后 O(log n) 回答树上任意两点的 LCA。
summary.en: Preprocess binary-lifting table; answer LCA queries in O(log n) each.

summary.zh: 回溯枚举所有团，求节点数最多的完全子图。
summary.en: Backtrack over vertices to find the largest complete subgraph.

summary.zh: BFS 反复在残量图上找增广路径，求源点到汇点的最大流。
summary.en: Repeatedly BFS for augmenting paths in the residual graph to maximize s-t flow.

summary.zh: 贪心选「覆盖最多未支配节点」的节点，构造支配集。
summary.en: Greedily pick vertices covering the most undominated vertices to build a dominating set.

summary.zh: Prim 算法从一个起点不断加入最短横切边构造 MST。
summary.en: Prim grows an MST from a start by repeatedly adding the shortest crossing edge.

summary.zh: 在无向树中选根使树高最小（拓扑剥叶法）。
summary.en: Pick tree roots that minimize the tree height (peeling leaves).

summary.zh: 贪心 2-近似：不断取一条边加入匹配，两端都进覆盖。
summary.en: Greedy 2-approximation: repeatedly pick an edge and add both endpoints to the cover.

summary.zh: 删除一个感染节点使最终被感染节点数最少。
summary.en: Remove one infected node to minimize the final number of infected nodes.

summary.zh: 每轮每个连通块各自选最短出边合并，直到只剩一个连通块。
summary.en: Each round, every component selects its cheapest outgoing edge; merge until one component remains.

summary.zh: 树形 DP 求权值和最大的独立集（相邻不取）。
summary.en: Tree DP for the independent set of maximum total weight (no two adjacent).

summary.zh: 信号从源点发出，求所有节点收到信号的时间（最大单源最短路）。
summary.en: A signal spreads from a source; find the time until all nodes receive it (max SSSP).

summary.zh: 从 0000 转 K 把避开死锁达到目标，求最少步数。
summary.en: Turn a 4-wheel lock from 0000 to target avoiding deadends; find min turns.

summary.zh: 从一个起点出发逐步扩张，每次选最小权边把新节点加入生成树。
summary.en: Grow a tree from a source by repeatedly adding the lightest crossing edge.

summary.zh: 从源点出发遍历，列出所有可达节点。
summary.en: Traverse from a source and list all nodes reachable from it.

summary.zh: 每条边细分为若干子节点，给定步数限制求可达节点数。
summary.en: Edges are subdivided into intermediate nodes; count nodes reachable within a budget.

summary.zh: 无向图多了一条边成环，找出最后一条构成环的边。
summary.en: In an undirected graph with one extra edge forming a cycle, find that redundant edge.

summary.zh: 把每格放大成 3×3 像素，用并查集统计被斜杠切出的区域数。
summary.en: Upscale each cell to 3×3 pixels and count regions via union-find.

summary.zh: 贪心试探给变量赋值，最大化被满足的 3-CNF 子句数。
summary.en: Greedy assignment maximizing the number of satisfied 3-CNF clauses.

summary.zh: 两遍 DFS 求有向图 SCC：先正图求后序，再反图按倒序访问。
summary.en: Two-pass DFS: first on the graph to get finish order, then on the reverse graph in reverse finish order.

summary.zh: 严格次小生成树：在所有生成树中权值第二小的。
summary.en: Strict second-best spanning tree: the second-smallest total weight among all spanning trees.

summary.zh: 判断 org 是否为给定子序列唯一可重建的超序列。
summary.en: Check if org is the unique reconstruction from given subsequences.

summary.zh: 两串最多差 2 个字符算相似，求相似连通分量数。
summary.en: Strings differing in at most 2 positions are similar; count connected components.
2×3 sliding puzzle; reach [[1,2,3],[4,5,0]] with minimum moves.

summary.zh: BFS 求 n×n 蛇梯棋盘从 1 到 n² 的最少掷骰次数。
summary.en: BFS for fewest dice rolls from 1 to n² on an n×n snakes-and-ladders board.

summary.zh: 对有向无环图先拓扑排序，再按拓扑序一次松弛得到单源最短路。
summary.en: Topologically sort a DAG, then relax edges once in topo order for single-source shortest path.

summary.zh: 多个石源同时蔓延，求每个空格到最近石源的距离。
summary.en: Multiple stone sources spread at once; find each empty cell distance to nearest source.

summary.zh: 每次改一个字符把起点串变终点串，中途必须在词典中，求最短步数。
summary.en: Change one char per step to morph start into end through dictionary words; min steps.

summary.zh: 把被 X 完全包围的 O 区域翻转为 X，边界相连的 O 保留。
summary.en: Flip O-regions fully surrounded by X to X; keep O-regions connected to the border.

summary.zh: 单次 DFS 求有向图所有强连通分量（SCC）。
summary.en: Single DFS to find all strongly connected components of a directed graph.

summary.zh: 反复选入度为 0 的节点并删除其出边，得到有向图的拓扑序。
summary.en: Repeatedly remove zero-indegree vertices to produce a topological order.

summary.zh: 用并查集统计无向图的连通分量数。
summary.en: Count connected components of an undirected graph via union-find.

summary.zh: 多源 BFS：每个空房到最近门的距离。
summary.en: Multi-source BFS: distance from each empty room to its nearest gate.

summary.zh: 按度数降序贪心着色，给出上界 Δ+1 以内的着色。
summary.en: Greedy coloring by descending degree; yields a coloring within Δ+1.

summary.zh: 单源 BFS：每次改一个字母在词典中前进，求最短步数。
summary.en: Single-source BFS changing one letter per step through the dictionary; min steps.

title.zh: 单词接龙 II（所有最短）

summary.zh: BFS + 回溯，求从 beginWord 到 endWord 的所有最短转换序列。
summary.en: BFS plus backtracking to list all shortest transformation sequences.

summary.zh: 回溯搜索经过每个顶点恰好一次并回到起点的回路。
summary.en: Backtracking for a cycle visiting each vertex exactly once.

summary.zh: 树链剖分属于graph类别。
summary.en: Heavy-Light Decomposition is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 完整重链剖分：两遍 DFS 求 size/depth/parent/top，支持路径查询/更新。
summary.en: Full heavy-light decomposition: two DFS passes for size/depth/parent/top, supporting path queries.

title.zh: 匈牙利算法（二分图最大匹配）

summary.zh: 匈牙利算法（二分图最大匹配）属于graph类别。
summary.en: Hungarian Algorithm (Bipartite Matching) is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: Johnson 全源最短路属于graph类别。
summary.en: Johnson is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 第K短路属于graph类别。
summary.en: Kth Shortest is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: Kosaraju优化属于graph类别。
summary.en: Kosaraju Refine is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: Kruskal 最小生成树属于graph类别。
summary.en: Kruskal MST is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 可撤销并查集 + Kruskal，支持回退合并操作。
summary.en: Undoable union-find Kruskal supporting rollback of merges.

summary.zh: LCA并查集属于graph类别。
summary.en: LCA Tarjan is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: Hopcroft-Karp 匹配属于graph类别。
summary.en: Hopcroft-Karp is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: Bron-Kerbosch 带 pivot 与退化序，枚举极大团并取最大者。
summary.en: Bron-Kerbosch with pivoting and degeneracy order finds the largest clique.

summary.zh: 分支定界：按顶点「取/不取」二分递归，上界剪枝。
summary.en: Branch and bound: split on include/exclude of a vertex, prune by upper bound.

summary.zh: 最小费用最大流属于graph类别。
summary.en: Min Cost Max Flow is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: Eades 启发式构造线性序，反向边即反馈弧集。
summary.en: Eades heuristic builds a linear order; backward edges form the feedback arc set.

summary.zh: 次小生成树属于graph类别。
summary.en: Second MST is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 倍增LCA属于graph类别。
summary.en: Multiplication LCA is a graph algorithm.

complexity.time: O(n log n) build, O(log n) query

summary.zh: Prim 最小生成树属于graph类别。
summary.en: Prim MST is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: Fibonacci 堆实现的 Prim 最小生成树。
summary.en: Prim MST implemented with a Fibonacci heap.

summary.zh: Prufer编码属于graph类别。
summary.en: Prufer Code is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: RMQ求LCA属于graph类别。
summary.en: RMQ-LCA is a graph algorithm.

complexity.time: O(n log n) build, O(1) query

summary.zh: SAP最大流属于graph类别。
summary.en: SAP Max Flow is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 单遍 DFS 配双栈（path 与 boundary）求强连通分量。
summary.en: Single-pass DFS with two stacks (path + boundary) for SCC.

summary.zh: 两遍 DFS 求有向图强连通分量：原图求完成序，反图按序摘树。
summary.en: Two-pass DFS for SCC: finish order on G, then DFS on reversed G.

summary.zh: 强连通迭代属于graph类别。
summary.en: SCC Iterative is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 递归版 Tarjan 算法求有向图的强连通分量。
summary.en: Recursive Tarjan algorithm for strongly connected components.

summary.zh: DAG最短路属于graph类别。
summary.en: DAG Shortest is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 最短路径 SPFA属于graph类别。
summary.en: SPFA is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: SPFA 队列优化 Bellman-Ford，检测负权环。
summary.en: SPFA (queue-based Bellman-Ford) to detect negative-weight cycles.

summary.zh: Dreyfus-Wagner DP：连接给定终点集的最小权子树。
summary.en: Dreyfus-Wagner DP for the min-weight subtree spanning given terminals.

summary.zh: 强连通分量（Kosaraju）属于graph类别。
summary.en: Strongly Connected (Kosaraju) is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: Tarjan 强连通分量属于graph类别。
summary.en: Tarjan SCC is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 拓扑排序属于graph类别。
summary.en: Topological Sort is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 树重心属于graph类别。
summary.en: Tree Centroid is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 树的直径属于graph类别。
summary.en: Tree Diameter is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 树哈希属于graph类别。
summary.en: Tree Hash is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 2-SAT属于graph类别。
summary.en: 2-SAT is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 点双连通属于graph类别。
summary.en: Vertex Biconnected is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 虚树属于graph类别。
summary.en: Virtual Tree is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 0-1 BFS属于graph类别。
summary.en: 0-1 BFS is a graph algorithm.

summary.zh: 蚂蚁依信息素与启发式选边，迭代更新信息素（小 TSP）。
summary.en: Ants pick edges by pheromone + heuristic; pheromones update iteratively (small TSP).

summary.zh: 在时限内先给可行解再逐步优化。
summary.en: Produces a feasible solution then improves under a time budget.

summary.zh: 在 AND-OR 图上求最优解图。
summary.en: Optimal solution graph over AND-OR graphs.

summary.zh: CSP 回溯时跳到真正的冲突变量。
summary.en: Backtracks CSP to the true conflict variable.

summary.zh: MCTS 第四阶段：把 rollout 奖励沿父链回填到路径上每个节点的 visits/wins。
summary.en: MCTS fourth phase: propagate the rollout reward up the parent chain, updating visits/wins on every node on the path.

summary.zh: 模拟蝙蝠回声定位：频率、响度、脉冲率协同搜索。
summary.en: Mimics bat echolocation via frequency, loudness, and pulse rate.

summary.zh: 可回溯的束搜索变体。
summary.en: Backtrackable beam search.

summary.zh: 采蜜蜂、观察蜂、侦查蜂协同搜索解空间（Sphere 目标）。
summary.en: Employed, onlooker, and scout bees collaboratively search (Sphere target).

summary.zh: 从源和汇同时 BFS 在中间相会。
summary.en: BFS from both ends, meet in the middle.

summary.zh: 用上/下界剪掉不可能更优的子树。
summary.en: Prunes subtrees that cannot beat the bound.

summary.zh: 先粗粒度搜索再逐层细化。
summary.en: Search coarse first, refine progressively.

summary.zh: 回溯 + AC-3 弧一致性传播：每步赋值后剪除不可能取值。
summary.en: Backtracking + AC-3 arc consistency: prune impossible values after each assignment.

paths.label: 工程系统
paths.description: 把解析、调度、网络、压缩、哈希、密码学和并发整理为工程向算法模块。

summary.zh: 用一个大整数 x 编码整条符号流，单符号概率近似熵。
summary.en: Encodes a whole symbol stream into one large integer x with near-entropy per-symbol rates.

summary.zh: 算术编码属于compression类别。
summary.en: Arithmetic Coding is a compression algorithm.

summary.zh: 借助静态字典把高频子串替换成引用。
summary.en: Replaces frequent substrings with references to a static dictionary.

summary.zh: BWT变换属于compression类别。
summary.en: Burrows-Wheeler Transform is a compression algorithm.

summary.zh: IBM 842 硬件加速格式：固定模板检测 + 短回引，面向高吞吐。
summary.en: IBM 842 hardware-accelerated format: fixed-template detection plus short back-references, tuned for throughput.

summary.zh: ANS 综合：演示 rANS/tANS 的统一状态机模型。
summary.en: ANS overview: demonstrate the unified state-machine model behind rANS/tANS.

title.zh: 上下文自适应算术编码

summary.zh: 依上下文动态调整概率的算术编码。
summary.en: Arithmetic coding with context-driven probability.

summary.zh: 算术编码：用 [low, high) 区间表示整个消息，分数位编码。
summary.en: Arithmetic coding: a [low, high) interval represents the whole message; fractional bits.

summary.zh: 对 0/1 序列做算术编码。
summary.en: Arithmetic coding over bit sequences.

summary.zh: 用整数区间 [lo, hi) 替代浮点，逐符号缩放并按需 renormalize 输出比特。
summary.en: Use integer intervals [lo, hi) instead of floats, scaling per symbol with renormalization to emit bits.

summary.zh: 6-bit 一组的二进制到文本编码。
summary.en: 6-bit binary-to-text encoding.

summary.zh: 5 字节编为 5 个 85 进制字符。
summary.en: 5 bytes to 5 base-85 chars.

summary.zh: 按固定位宽将整数紧凑存入位流。
summary.en: Pack integers into a bit stream at fixed width.

summary.zh: 把每像素各位拆到独立平面。
summary.en: Splits each pixel bit into planes.

summary.zh: 把输入分块，每块做循环旋转排序取末列，使相同字符聚集便于后续压缩。
summary.en: Split input into blocks, sort cyclic rotations per block, and take the last column to cluster similar characters.

summary.zh: Brotli：LZ77 + 上下文建模 + 静态字典，Web 优化。
summary.en: Brotli: LZ77 + context modeling + static dictionary, web-optimized.

summary.zh: 依前两字节选 Huffman 表。
summary.en: Selects Huffman table by prev 2 bytes.

summary.zh: Brotli 第二阶段：按频率构建 Huffman 码本，对字面量做熵编码。
summary.en: Brotli second stage: build a Huffman codebook by frequency and entropy-code literals.

summary.zh: Brotli 用静态预设字典 + LZ77；本实现演示字典匹配加速。
summary.en: Brotli uses a static preset dictionary plus LZ77; this demo shows dictionary-assisted matching.

summary.zh: BWT：对所有循环旋转排序，输出末列 + 原始行号。
summary.en: BWT: sort all cyclic rotations, output last column + original row index.

summary.zh: 贪心合并最高频字节对为新符号。
summary.en: Greedy merge of most frequent byte pair.

summary.zh: 用后缀数组求 BWT。
summary.en: Computes BWT via suffix array.

summary.zh: CTW：上下文树加权，二阶上下文最优混合。
summary.en: CTW: context tree weighting, provably optimal for binary trees.

summary.zh: DEFLATE：LZ77 + Huffman，gzip/zlib 内核。
summary.en: DEFLATE: LZ77 + Huffman, the core of gzip/zlib.

summary.zh: 对差分序列再做一次差分。
summary.en: Differences of differences.

summary.zh: 类似 LZW：边压缩边学习新子串加入字典，单遍自适应无需预传字典。
summary.en: LZW-like: learn new substrings into the dictionary on the fly, single-pass and self-adapting with no preset dictionary.

summary.zh: 用预设的「符号→短码」字典替换常见子串，双方共享同一张表。
summary.en: Replace common substrings with short codes from a preset dictionary shared by both sides.

summary.zh: BWT 输出的高效整数编码。
summary.en: Efficient integer coding for BWT output.

summary.zh: 支持零与负数：先写符号/零标志，再对绝对值做 Elias gamma。
summary.en: Supports zero and negatives: emit a sign/zero flag, then Elias gamma of the absolute value.

summary.zh: 对正整数编码：先写 ⌊log2 n⌋ 的 Elias gamma，再写去掉最高位的二进制。
summary.en: Encode positive integers: Elias gamma of floor(log2 n) followed by the binary without the leading 1.

summary.zh: 递归式前缀码：不断把「当前数的位数」作为新数前缀，直到降到 1。
summary.en: A recursive prefix code: repeatedly prepend the bit-length of the current number until reaching 1.

summary.zh: 状态机驱动的快速熵编码。
summary.en: State-machine-driven fast entropy coder.

summary.zh: 先做游程编码，再对游程长度用 Elias gamma 编码，压缩稀疏重复数据。
summary.en: Apply run-length encoding first, then Elias-gamma encode the run lengths, compressing sparse repetitions.

summary.zh: 几何分布整数的最优前缀码。
summary.en: Optimal prefix code for geometric distribution.

summary.zh: Golomb 当参数 m=2^k 的特例：商用一元码、余数用 k 位二进制。
summary.en: Golomb with m=2^k: quotient in unary, remainder in k binary bits.

summary.zh: 4 个整数共用 1 字节位宽标记。
summary.en: 4 ints share 1-byte width tag.

summary.zh: gzip：DEFLATE + 头部 + CRC32 校验。
summary.en: gzip: DEFLATE + header + CRC32 checksum.

summary.zh: 规范 Huffman：按码长+符号序生成码字，省去树结构。
summary.en: Canonical Huffman: codes from lengths + symbol order, no tree needed.

summary.zh: 自适应 Huffman：单遍扫描，频率随编码更新。
summary.en: Adaptive Huffman: single pass; frequencies update during encoding.

summary.zh: 单遍编码：边读入边更新 Huffman 树，无需预先统计频率，收发双方同步。
summary.en: Single-pass coding: update the Huffman tree as symbols arrive; sender and receiver stay in sync without precomputed frequencies.

summary.zh: 高频符号用 Huffman，低频/残余用算术编码，兼顾速度与压缩率。
summary.en: High-frequency symbols use Huffman; low-frequency residue uses arithmetic coding, balancing speed and ratio.

summary.zh: 只编码码长，再按规范规则重建码字，简化传输与解码。
summary.en: Encode only code lengths, then rebuild codewords by canonical rules, simplifying transport and decoding.

title.zh: Package-Merge 最优长度受限哈夫曼

summary.zh: 在最大码长约束下构造最优前缀码。
summary.en: Optimal length-limited prefix codes.

summary.zh: JPEG 用 DHT 段存放 Huffman 表：BITS(各码长符号数) + HUFFVAL(符号列表)。
summary.en: JPEG stores Huffman tables in the DHT segment: BITS (count per code length) plus HUFFVAL (symbol list).

summary.zh: LZ 通用：滑动窗口 + 前看缓冲，输出 (距离, 长度) 二元组。
summary.en: Generic LZ: sliding window + lookahead, emit (distance, length) pairs.

summary.zh: LZ4 以解压速度优先：字面量长度 + (token, 匹配) 的紧凑编码。
summary.en: LZ4 prioritizes decompression speed with literal-length + (token, match) encoding.

summary.zh: LZ4：块级匹配，匹配长度 4 字节起，吞吐高。
summary.en: LZ4: block matches with min length 4, high throughput.

summary.zh: 极简 LZ4 块：token+literal+match。
summary.en: Minimal LZ4 block: token+literal+match.

summary.zh: LZ5：LZ4 的更大窗口/字典变体，更高压缩比。
summary.en: LZ5: larger-window LZ4 variant with better ratio.

summary.zh: LZO：极快解压的块压缩，匹配用 RLE 前缀优化。
summary.en: LZO: very fast block decompression; matches use RLE-prefix optimization.

summary.zh: 用上次出现上下文预测并编码偏移。
summary.en: Predicts via prior context, encodes mismatches.

summary.zh: LZ77 改进版：用 1 位标志区分字面量与 (距离,长度) 指针，提升压缩率。
summary.en: An LZ77 variant using a 1-bit flag to separate literals from (distance,length) pairs.

summary.zh: LZSS：位标志 + (距离, 长度)，比 LZ77 更紧凑。
summary.en: LZSS: bit flag + (distance, length); more compact than LZ77.

summary.zh: MTF：把符号输出为「在表中的位置」并移到最前。
summary.en: MTF: emit a symbol table position, then move it to front.

summary.zh: 语音对数压扩，提升小信号信噪比。
summary.en: Logarithmic voice companding.

summary.zh: 4-bit 为单位紧凑存储整数。
summary.en: Packs integers in 4-bit nibbles.

summary.zh: 迭代合并最高频相邻字节对为新符号，构建子词词表。
summary.en: Iteratively merge the most frequent adjacent byte pair into a new symbol, building a subword vocabulary.

summary.zh: 数组用固定 b 位存+异常补丁。
summary.en: Fixed b bits per value plus exception patches.

summary.zh: PPM：上下文自适应概率 + 回退机制。
summary.en: PPM: context-adaptive probabilities with backoff.

summary.zh: PPM*d：所有阶上下文加权混合，无显式逃逸。
summary.en: PPM*d: blend all-order contexts, no explicit escape.

summary.zh: rANS：基于状态 x = (x/M)*F(s) + s 的熵编码。
summary.en: rANS: entropy coding via state x = (x/M)*F(s) + s.

summary.zh: 递归替换最频繁相邻对为新符号。
summary.en: Recursively replace most frequent pair.

summary.zh: 块内自适应选最优 k 的 Rice。
summary.en: Per-block adaptive Rice with best k.

summary.zh: RLE v3：游程编码，含字面 run 优化。
summary.en: RLE v3: run-length encoding with literal-run optimization.

summary.zh: 用转义符区分重复与字面字节。
summary.en: Escape byte separates runs and literals.

summary.zh: 一个 32 位字塞多种位宽。
summary.en: One 32-bit word holds varied bit widths.

summary.zh: Google 高速压缩格式：变长整数 + 简单回引，侧重速度而非压缩率。
summary.en: Google high-speed format using varints and simple back-references, favoring speed over ratio.

summary.zh: Snappy：Google 高速压缩，不追求最佳压缩比。
summary.en: Snappy: Google high-speed compression, not aiming for best ratio.

summary.zh: Snappy 标签字面与回引拷贝混合。
summary.en: Snappy tag mixing literals and back-references.

summary.zh: 可调参数族一元类编码。
summary.en: Parameterized family of unary-like codes.

summary.zh: 长度与数据分离的 varint。
summary.en: Length/data-separated varint.

summary.zh: tANS：表驱动 ANS，FSE 的基础。
summary.en: tANS: table-driven ANS, the basis of FSE.

summary.zh: 非 2 的幂范围的最优定长码。
summary.en: Optimal fixed-width for non-power-of-2 range.

summary.zh: 定长码、变长输入：把高频符号扩展成等长前缀串，每串映射为定长码字。
summary.en: Fixed-length code, variable-length input: expand frequent symbols into equal-length prefix strings, each mapped to a fixed-length codeword.

summary.zh: 7 位一组+续接位的变长编码。
summary.en: 7-bit chunks with continuation bit.

summary.zh: 用异或记录相邻值变化。
summary.en: XORs adjacent values to record changes.

summary.zh: zlib：DEFLATE + Adler-32 校验 + 短头部。
summary.en: zlib: DEFLATE + Adler-32 checksum + short header.

summary.zh: Zstd：LZ + FSE 熵编码，平衡速度与压缩比。
summary.en: Zstd: LZ + FSE entropy coding, balancing speed and ratio.

summary.zh: Zstd 用 LZ77 + FSE(有限状态熵) 后处理；本实现演示其前缀匹配核心。
summary.en: Zstd combines LZ77 with FSE (finite-state entropy); this demo shows the prefix-matching core.

summary.zh: Deflate算法属于compression类别。
summary.en: DEFLATE is a compression algorithm.

summary.zh: 增量编码属于compression类别。
summary.en: Delta Encoding is a compression algorithm.

summary.zh: 对时间戳序列做二次差分，常量斜率段归零。
summary.en: Second-order differencing of timestamp series; constant-slope runs collapse to zero.

summary.zh: 正整数 n 编为 ⌊log2 n⌋ 个 0 后跟 n 的二进制。
summary.en: Encodes positive integer n as ⌊log2 n⌋ zeros followed by the binary of n.

summary.zh: 斐波那契编码属于compression类别。
summary.en: Fibonacci Coding is a compression algorithm.

summary.zh: Golomb编码属于compression类别。
summary.en: Golomb Coding is a compression algorithm.

summary.zh: 哈夫曼编码属于compression类别。
summary.en: Huffman Coding is a compression algorithm.

summary.zh: LZ77 滑动窗口属于compression类别。
summary.en: LZ77 Sliding Window is a compression algorithm.

summary.zh: 逐步构建字典，输出 (索引, 字符) 二元组。
summary.en: Builds a dictionary incrementally, emits (index, char) pairs.

summary.zh: LZO 风格的快速 LZ 压缩（简化版）。
summary.en: A simplified LZO-style fast LZ compressor.

summary.zh: LZW 编码属于compression类别。
summary.en: LZW Coding is a compression algorithm.

summary.zh: MTF变换属于compression类别。
summary.en: Move-To-Front is a compression algorithm.

summary.zh: 上下文建模 + 退避（escape）的概率编码。
summary.en: Context modelling with escape (back-off) probability coding.

summary.zh: PPM编码属于compression类别。
summary.en: PPMd is a compression algorithm.

summary.zh: 范围编码属于compression类别。
summary.en: Range Coder is a compression algorithm.

summary.zh: Rice编码属于compression类别。
summary.en: Rice Coding is a compression algorithm.

summary.zh: 游程编码属于compression类别。
summary.en: Run-Length Encoding is a compression algorithm.

summary.zh: Apple PackBits：重复段与不重复段混合编码。
summary.en: Apple PackBits: mixed encoding of runs and literal sequences.

summary.zh: 香农-范诺编码属于compression类别。
summary.en: Shannon-Fano is a compression algorithm.

summary.zh: 小数少字节、大数多字节（LEB128 / protobuf 风格）。
summary.en: Fewer bytes for small numbers, more for large (LEB128 / protobuf style).

summary.zh: 有符号整数 → 无符号整数（小绝对值映射成小正数）。
summary.en: Maps signed integers to unsigned ones (small magnitudes map to small positives).

summary.zh: Lamport 面包店互斥：线程取号排队，号牌最小（号相同则 id 小）者进入临界区。
summary.en: Lamport's bakery mutual exclusion: threads take numbered tickets; the smallest (number, id) wins the critical section.

summary.zh: 理发师无客时睡觉，顾客到则唤醒；等待椅满则顾客离去。
summary.en: Barber sleeps when idle, woken on arrival; customers leave if waiting chairs are full.

summary.zh: 循环屏障：n 个线程到达后统一放行，常用于阶段同步。
summary.en: Cyclic barrier: release all n threads once they all arrive, used for phased synchronization.

summary.zh: n 个将军中 f 个叛变，经多轮交换值取多数，达成一致决策（n ≥ 3f+1）。
summary.en: Among n generals with f traitors, exchange values over rounds and take majority to agree (n ≥ 3f+1).

summary.zh: 代理放两种原料，三个抽烟者各缺一种；缺的那种的抽烟者取走并卷烟。
summary.en: An agent places two of three ingredients; the smoker missing those two takes them and rolls a cigarette.

summary.zh: 基于槽（slot）数组的公平自旋锁：每个线程等自己的槽。
summary.en: Fair array-based spinlock: each thread spins on its own slot.

summary.zh: 限制并发的协程池。
summary.en: Concurrency-limited coroutine pool.

summary.zh: 异步队列：生产者 enqueue，消费者 await dequeue。
summary.en: Async queue: producers enqueue, consumers await dequeue.

summary.zh: TAS + 指数退避：失败后随机延时再试，降低总线竞争。
summary.en: TAS + exponential backoff: wait a random delay before retry to reduce bus contention.

summary.zh: Lamport Bakery：取号排序，号小者优先进入临界区。
summary.en: Lamport Bakery: take a ticket; the smallest ticket enters first.

title.zh: Lamport 面包店算法（n 线程）

summary.zh: 取号 + 排序：每个线程领号，号码最小且索引最小者先入临界区。
summary.en: Take a ticket and line up: smallest (ticket, id) enters the critical section first.

summary.zh: 阶段屏障：所有线程到达后统一放行（事件序列版）。
summary.en: Phase barrier: release all threads once they arrive (event-sequence variant).

summary.zh: 拜占庭容错的可靠广播协议。
summary.en: Byzantine-tolerant reliable broadcast.

summary.zh: 用互斥锁 + 两个计数信号量实现有界缓冲的生产-消费。
summary.en: Bounded-buffer producer-consumer with a mutex and two counting semaphores.

summary.zh: empty/full 信号量同步生产消费。
summary.en: empty/full semaphores sync producer/consumer.

summary.zh: 窄桥单向通行：同向可多车，反向须等待，公平切换方向。
summary.en: A narrow one-way bridge: same-direction traffic may share; opposing traffic waits; direction switches fairly.

summary.zh: BRLOCK：每 CPU 一个读计数器，避免读者缓存行争用。
summary.en: BRLOCK: per-CPU reader counter to avoid reader cache-line contention.

summary.zh: 读-改-写循环直到 CAS 成功。
summary.en: Read-modify-write retrying until CAS succeeds.

summary.zh: 隐式链表队列自旋锁。
summary.en: Implicit linked-list queue spinlock.

summary.zh: 分段锁哈希表减少争用。
summary.en: Striped locks reduce hash-table contention.

summary.zh: 一次性完成锁存器：count 减到 0 后所有等待者释放。
summary.en: One-shot completion latch: waiters released when count reaches 0.

summary.zh: wait/signal：线程在条件变量上挂起，被 signal 唤醒。
summary.en: wait/signal: threads suspend on a condition variable and resume on signal.

summary.zh: wait/signal/all 模型：线程在条件不满足时挂起，被 signal 唤醒。
summary.en: wait/signal/all: a thread blocks when the condition is false, woken by signal.

summary.zh: 厨师填满锅，野蛮人轮流取食；锅空时唤醒厨师并等待。
summary.en: Cook refills the pot; savages take turns eating; an empty pot wakes the cook and waits.

summary.zh: Disruptor：环形数组 + 序号栅栏，多生产者多消费者无锁管道。
summary.en: Disruptor: ring array + sequence barriers for lockless multi-producer multi-consumer pipelines.

summary.zh: 每轮向固定步长伙伴同步。
summary.en: Each round syncs with a fixed-step partner.

summary.zh: EventCount：单调递增事件序号，await(ticket) 等到事件到达。
summary.en: EventCount: monotonically increasing event number; await(ticket) blocks until reached.

summary.zh: 两线程在汇合点交换数据。
summary.en: Two threads swap data at a rendezvous.

summary.zh: Fast Lock：无竞争路径仅 1 条原子指令，回退到慢路径。
summary.en: Fast Lock: uncontended fast path uses 1 atomic op, falls back to slow path.

summary.zh: 无竞争时走快速路径（单次原子操作），有竞争才回退到慢路径。
summary.en: Uncontended fast path with one atomic op; fall back to slow path only under contention.

summary.zh: 禁止前后指令重排序。
summary.en: Forbids reordering across the fence.

summary.zh: 用户态自旋，仅争用时陷入内核。
summary.en: User-space spin, kernel call only on contention.

summary.zh: 推导事件间的可见性偏序。
summary.en: Infers visibility partial order among events.

summary.zh: 多进程互斥，取号排队进入临界区。
summary.en: Multi-process mutual exclusion via ticketing.

summary.zh: map 阶段分片统计局部词频，reduce 阶段按词聚合求和。
summary.en: Map phase counts words per shard; reduce phase aggregates by word.

summary.zh: 每个线程自旋本地锁节点。
summary.en: Each thread spins on a local lock node.

summary.zh: 多工作线程各投点统计，归约（reduce）命中数后估算 Pi。
summary.en: Multiple workers each throw points; a reduce sums hits to estimate Pi.

summary.zh: 多生产者单消费者无锁队列。
