summary.en: Many-producer single-consumer lock-free queue.

summary.zh: 基于原子 TestAndSet 的忙等互斥锁：抢到 0 即进入临界区，释放写回 0。
summary.en: Busy-wait mutex on atomic TestAndSet: seeing 0 grants the critical section; release writes 0.

summary.zh: 先读 flag（test），空闲再 TestAndSet，减少争用的两级自旋锁。
summary.en: Two-level spin: first read flag, only TestAndSet when it looks free; reduces contention.

summary.zh: 读时不锁，提交时校验版本。
summary.en: No read lock; validate version at commit.

summary.zh: 两阶段多数派达成共识。
summary.en: Two-phase majority consensus.

summary.zh: Per-CPU 计数器：本地无锁累加，汇总时求和。
summary.en: Per-CPU counter: lockless local increment, sum on demand.

title.zh: Peterson 算法 n 线程推广

summary.zh: 用 n-1 个二元 Peterson 锁组成锦标赛树，实现 n 线程互斥。
summary.en: A tournament tree of n-1 two-party Peterson locks yields n-thread mutual exclusion.

summary.zh: 可变参与方的多阶段屏障。
summary.en: Variable-party multi-phase barrier.

summary.zh: 叉子为令牌按洁净度流转。
summary.en: Forks as tokens flow by cleanliness.

summary.zh: 所有哲学家先拿编号小的叉再拿编号大的，破坏循环等待。
summary.en: All philosophers acquire the lower-numbered fork first, breaking circular wait.

summary.zh: 状态机版：THINKING/HUNGRY/EATING，邻接非进餐时才转 EATING，避免死锁。
summary.en: State-machine variant: THINKING/HUNGRY/EATING; turn EATING only if neighbors are not eating.

summary.zh: 按线程优先级授予锁。
summary.en: Grants lock by thread priority.

summary.zh: 用 Promise 队列模拟异步生产-消费：生产 resolve、消费 await。
summary.en: Promise-queue model of async producer-consumer: producers resolve, consumers await.

summary.zh: 任期+多数票选出领导者。
summary.en: Term + majority vote elects leader.

summary.zh: RCU：读者无锁；写者复制-更新，宽限期后回收旧版本。
summary.en: RCU: readers are lockless; writers copy-update, reclaim old version after a grace period.

summary.zh: 读端无锁，写端复制后原子换指针。
summary.en: Lock-free reads, writes swap a copied pointer.

summary.zh: 读者登记在册，写者据此等待。
summary.en: Readers register; writers wait accordingly.

summary.zh: 区分读/写：多读并发，写独占。
summary.en: Distinguish read/write: multiple readers concurrent, writers exclusive.

summary.zh: 读者可并发、写者独占；用单锁串行化，避免读者或写者饥饿。
summary.en: Readers share, writers exclude; serialized so neither starves.

summary.zh: 有写者等待时阻塞新读者。
summary.en: New readers block when a writer waits.

summary.zh: 多生产者单消费者环形缓冲：无锁入队，单消费者出队。
summary.en: Multi-producer single-consumer ring buffer: lockless enqueue, single consumer dequeue.

summary.zh: 单生产者单消费者无锁环形缓冲（经典 Damon FIFO）。
summary.en: Single-producer single-consumer lockless ring buffer (classic Damon FIFO).

summary.zh: 3 传教士 3 野人用 2 人船过河，任一岸野人不得多于传教士。
summary.en: 3 missionaries and 3 cannibals cross with a 2-seat boat; neither bank may have more cannibals than missionaries.

summary.zh: 读写信号量：基于信号量的读写锁，写者递归降级。
summary.en: RW semaphore: semaphore-based rwlock; writers can downgrade.

summary.zh: Santa 被 3 只驯鹿或 9 只精灵唤醒：驯鹿优先，组装礼物或派发。
summary.en: Santa is woken by either 9 reindeer or 3 elves; reindeer take priority to deliver toys or help elves.

summary.zh: 二值信号量（0/1）：等价于互斥锁。
summary.en: Binary semaphore (0/1): equivalent to a mutex.

summary.zh: 计数信号量：允许 N 个线程同时进入临界区。
summary.en: Counting semaphore: allow up to N threads into the critical section.

summary.zh: SeqLock：读者无锁读，校验前后序号一致；写者持锁时序号变奇。
summary.en: SeqLock: readers read locklessly, validating sequence parity; writers flip sequence to odd while writing.

summary.zh: 顾客/理发师/椅三信号量。
summary.en: Customer/barber/chair three semaphores.

summary.zh: 总是排队（无快路径）的公平锁，作为 Fast Lock 的对照组。
summary.en: Always-queued fair lock (no fast path); a baseline contrast to Fast Lock.

summary.zh: 慢路径锁：始终走队列与阻塞，确保公平，开销高于 fast path。
summary.en: Slow-path-only lock: always enqueues and blocks, ensuring fairness at higher cost.

summary.zh: 单生产单消费的无锁环形。
summary.en: Lock-free single-producer single-consumer ring.

summary.zh: 读写锁允许多读单写。
summary.en: Read-write lock: many readers, one writer.

summary.zh: TestAndSet 自旋锁：原子地测试并置位，失败则忙等。
summary.en: TestAndSet spinlock: atomically test-and-set; spin on failure.

summary.zh: 按等待时间排序授予锁，等待越久越优先。
summary.en: Grant the lock by waiting time: longer wait = higher priority.

summary.zh: 二叉树两两汇合的屏障。
summary.en: Binary-tree pairwise barrier.

summary.zh: 协调者 prepare + commit。
summary.en: Coordinator prepare then commit.

summary.zh: 同一时刻洗手间只能容纳一种性别，且不超过容量上限。
summary.en: The bathroom holds only one gender at a time and at most a capacity of people.

summary.zh: 每进程维护所有进程时钟数组。
summary.en: Each process keeps a clock array.

summary.zh: 本地 LIFO，窃取 FIFO。
summary.en: Local LIFO, steal FIFO.

summary.zh: 写者优先：有写者等待时阻止新读者，避免写者饥饿。
summary.en: Writer preference: block new readers when a writer waits, preventing writer starvation.

summary.zh: 只要写者在等待，新读者必须排队，保证写者不被读者饿死。
summary.en: New readers queue whenever a writer is waiting, preventing writer starvation.

summary.zh: CLH：线程在隐式队列前驱节点上自旋，FIFO 公平。
summary.en: CLH: each thread spins on its predecessor node in an implicit FIFO queue.

summary.zh: Proposer 提议、Acceptor 投票、Learner 学习：两阶段 Prepare/Promise + Accept/Ack 选定一个值。
summary.en: Proposer proposes, Acceptors vote, Learner learns: two phases Prepare/Promise + Accept/Ack to choose a single value.

summary.zh: 哲学家就餐属于concurrency类别。
summary.en: Dining Philosophers is a concurrency algorithm.

summary.zh: Peterson 的 n 线程推广：经 n-1 层「等待室」逐层过滤，最后进入临界区。
summary.en: Generalizes Peterson to n threads: filters through n-1 waiting levels before the critical section.

summary.zh: 为分布式事件编号：本地自增 + 收消息取 max 后 +1，建立 happens-before 偏序。
summary.en: Numbers distributed events: increment locally, take max on receive then +1, building happens-before order.

summary.zh: 一次性计数门：countDown 减一计数，归零前所有 await 阻塞，归零后全部放行。
summary.en: One-shot count gate: countDown decrements; all await calls block until count hits zero, then release.

summary.zh: 单向环上各进程向右传 id，更大者吞并更小者，最大 id 最终当选领导者。
summary.en: On a unidirectional ring each process forwards its id rightward; larger swallows smaller, and the max id wins.

summary.zh: 用统一接口刻画事件序：规则化本地/发送/接收三类事件，衍生 Lamport、向量时钟等实例。
summary.en: A uniform framework for event ordering: rule-based local/send/receive, deriving Lamport and vector clocks as instances.

summary.zh: 用互斥锁 + 条件变量封装共享状态：wait 释放锁睡眠，signal 唤醒等待者。
summary.en: Encapsulates shared state with a mutex + condition variable: wait releases the lock to sleep, signal wakes waiters.

summary.zh: 基于原子 TestAndSet 指令实现的互斥锁：忙等抢锁、显式释放。
summary.en: Mutual exclusion lock built on the atomic TestAndSet instruction: busy-wait acquire, explicit release.

summary.zh: 两线程互斥经典：flag[2] + turn，进入前谦让，保证互斥且无饥饿。
summary.en: Classic two-thread mutual exclusion: flag[2] + turn, with courteous handoff ensuring mutual exclusion and starvation-freedom.

summary.zh: 生产者-消费者属于concurrency类别。
summary.en: Producer-Consumer is a concurrency algorithm.

summary.zh: 用信号量 empty/full/mutex 模拟有界缓冲区的生产-消费，PV 操作经典模型。
summary.en: Classic PV model: semaphore empty/full/mutex governing a bounded buffer between producers and consumers.

summary.zh: 读者可并发进入，写者独占；读者优先可能导致写者饥饿。
summary.en: Multiple readers enter concurrently, writers are exclusive; reader preference may starve writers.

summary.zh: 读者-写者属于concurrency类别。
summary.en: Readers-Writers is a concurrency algorithm.

summary.zh: 两线程用两把信号量在汇合点对称等待，全部到达后才一起通过。
summary.en: Two threads wait symmetrically at a rendezvous using two semaphores, passing only after both arrive.

summary.zh: 计数信号量：内部计数 + 等待队列，控制有限资源的并发访问。
summary.en: Counting semaphore: internal counter + wait queue to govern access to bounded resources.

summary.zh: 协调者发 marker：收到首个 marker 前的消息即该通道上的快照状态，无需冻结系统。
summary.en: Coordinator sends markers: messages before the first marker on a channel form its snapshot, no global freeze needed.

summary.zh: 先读标志再 TestAndSet：减少总线争用，是经典自旋锁优化。
summary.en: Read the flag before issuing TestAndSet: cuts bus contention, a classic spinlock optimization.

summary.zh: 每个进程维护 n 维向量：本地事件自增本维，收消息逐维取 max，可判定并发关系。
summary.en: Each process keeps an n-dim vector: increment own dim locally, take per-dim max on receive, to detect concurrency.

summary.zh: 每个 worker 拥有双端队列：本地 LIFO，空闲时从别人队列尾偷（FIFO）。
summary.en: Each worker owns a deque: local LIFO push/pop, idle workers steal FIFO from others' tail.

summary.zh: AES玩具版属于crypto类别。
summary.en: AES (Toy) is a crypto algorithm.

summary.zh: AES S盒属于crypto类别。
summary.en: AES S-Box is a crypto algorithm.

summary.zh: 仿射密码属于crypto类别。
summary.en: Affine Cipher is a crypto algorithm.

summary.zh: 字母表首尾对调（A↔Z、B↔Y …），自对合。
summary.en: Reverses the alphabet (A↔Z, B↔Y …); involutive.

summary.zh: 密钥 = 引子 + 明文自身延伸，避免周期性。
summary.en: Key = primer + the plaintext itself extended, avoiding periodicity.

summary.zh: 多表替换：C = (K - P) mod 26，自反（加密=解密）。
summary.en: Polyalphabetic: C = (K - P) mod 26; self-reciprocal (encrypt = decrypt).

summary.zh: Blowfish Feistel 的 P 数组与 S 盒初始化。
summary.en: Initialize the P-array and S-boxes for the Blowfish Feistel network.

summary.zh: 凯撒密码属于crypto类别。
summary.en: Caesar Cipher is a crypto algorithm.

summary.zh: 按密钥字母顺序重排列，再逐列读取。
summary.en: Writes text into rows, reorders columns by the key, then reads column by column.

summary.zh: 96 位分组硬件友好密码。
summary.en: 96-bit hardware-friendly cipher.

summary.zh: 一战德军密码：6×6 方阵（A-Z+0-9）把字符分数化为两个标签，再做列置换。
summary.en: WWI German cipher: a 6×6 grid (A-Z, 0-9) fractionates each char into two labels, then columnar transposition.

summary.zh: zlib 用的快速校验和。
summary.en: Fast checksum used by zlib.

summary.zh: AES-CTR：计数器模式，加密 nonce++ 后与明文异或。
summary.en: AES-CTR: counter mode, encrypt nonce++ then XOR with plaintext.

summary.zh: AES-GCM：认证加密模式，CTR + GHASH 认证。
summary.en: AES-GCM: authenticated encryption, CTR mode + GHASH tag.

summary.zh: AES-OFB：输出反馈模式，前一块密钥流作下一块输入。
summary.en: AES-OFB: output feedback; previous keystream block feeds next.

summary.zh: E(x)=(a·x+b) mod 26；要求 a 与 26 互素。解密用 a 的模逆元。
summary.en: E(x)=(a·x+b) mod 26; a must be coprime with 26. Decryption uses the modular inverse of a.

summary.zh: NESSIE 候选的 128 位分组密码。
summary.en: 128-bit block cipher (NESSIE).

summary.zh: 把字母 A↔Z、B↔Y 镜像映射，并对数字 0↔9 也做反转。
summary.en: Mirror-map letters A↔Z, B↔Y, and also reverse digits 0↔9.

summary.zh: 5×5 Polybius 分数化后，把行坐标与列坐标分成两行再按列读取重组。
summary.en: Fractionate via a 5×5 Polybius square, split row/col coordinates into two lines, then read columns to recombine.

summary.zh: Blowfish：16 轮 Feistel，密钥相关 S 盒。
summary.en: Blowfish: 16-round Feistel with key-dependent S-boxes.

summary.zh: Camellia：NTT/Mitsubishi 的 Feistel 分组密码。
summary.en: Camellia: NTT/Mitsubishi Feistel block cipher.

summary.zh: CAST-5：12/16 轮 Feistel，3 种轮函数。
summary.en: CAST-5: 12/16-round Feistel with three round-function types.

summary.zh: 每块先与前密文异或。
summary.en: XORs each block with previous ciphertext.

summary.zh: 前密文加密后与明文异或。
summary.en: Encrypts prev ciphertext, XORs plaintext.

summary.zh: Salsa20 的改进版，旋转常量改为 16/12/8/7，广泛用于 TLS 与现代加密栈。
summary.en: Improved Salsa20 with rotation constants 16/12/8/7; widely used in TLS and modern crypto stacks.

summary.zh: J.F. Byrne 设计的自密钥流密码：两个字母表随每次加密同步扰动。
summary.en: A self-keyrunning stream cipher by J.F. Byrne: two alphabets are permuted after each encipherment.

summary.zh: 索尼 128 位分组密码。
summary.en: Sony 128-bit block cipher.

summary.zh: 基于分组密码的 MAC。
summary.en: MAC based on a block cipher.

summary.zh: 16 位循环冗余校验。
summary.en: 16-bit cyclic redundancy check.

summary.zh: 32 位循环冗余校验。
summary.en: 32-bit cyclic redundancy check.

summary.zh: 加密计数器生成密钥流。
summary.en: Encrypts a counter as keystream.

summary.zh: DES 16 轮 Feistel；3DES 三次 DES 提升安全。
summary.en: DES 16-round Feistel; 3DES applies DES three times for security.

summary.zh: 逐块独立加密，最简单。
summary.en: Each block encrypted independently.

summary.zh: 乘素数再异或的快速哈希。
summary.en: XOR-then-multiply fast hash.

summary.zh: 四个 5×5 方阵：左上右下为标准字母表，右上左下由关键字生成，成对字母双向加密。
summary.en: Four 5×5 squares: top-left and bottom-right standard, top-right and bottom-left keyed; encrypts digraphs bi-axially.

summary.zh: 把字母转成摩尔斯电码，再把每对点划重新映射为单字符，实现强扩散。
summary.en: Convert letters to Morse, then map each dot/dash pair to a single character for strong diffusion.

summary.zh: GOST：俄罗斯标准 32 轮 Feistel，S 盒可由用户定义。
summary.en: GOST: Russian standard 32-round Feistel with user-supplied S-boxes.

summary.zh: 4×4 网格上开 4 个孔的卡片，依次旋转 90° 三次各填一组字母，共 16 字符。
summary.en: A card with 4 holes on a 4×4 grid; rotate 90° three times filling a group each time — 16 chars total.

summary.zh: 用 n×n 矩阵在 mod 26 上对明文分块做线性变换，是多表替换的矩阵推广。
summary.en: Encrypts plaintext blocks by an n×n matrix multiplication mod 26 — the matrix generalization of polyalphabetic ciphers.

summary.zh: HMAC 提取-扩展派生密钥。
summary.en: HMAC extract-expand key derivation.

summary.zh: 64 位 Feistel 商业密码。
summary.en: 64-bit Feistel commercial cipher.

summary.zh: IDEA：8.5 轮，混合模 2^16 加/乘/异或。
summary.en: IDEA: 8.5 rounds mixing mod-2^16 add/mul/xor.

summary.zh: 吸收-挤压的可变长度哈希。
summary.en: Absorb-squeeze variable-length hashing.

summary.zh: 由关键字生成替换表：先去重填入关键字字母，再顺次补全剩余字母。
summary.en: Build a substitution table from a keyword: place unique keyword letters first, then remaining alphabet.

summary.zh: 64 位分组 NESSIE 候选。
summary.en: 64-bit block NESSIE candidate.

summary.zh: MARS：IBM AES 候选，分层结构（前向/核心/后向）。
summary.en: MARS: IBM AES finalist with layered structure (forward/core/backward).

summary.zh: MD2：Rivest 8 位哈希，针对 8 位机优化。
summary.en: MD2: Rivest 8-bit hash optimized for 8-bit machines.

summary.zh: MD4：Rivest 128 位哈希，3 轮 16 步。
summary.en: MD4: Rivest 128-bit hash, 3 rounds of 16 steps.

summary.zh: 概率素性测试，密码学常用。
summary.en: Probabilistic primality test.

summary.zh: NESSIE 推荐的 128 位分组密码。
summary.en: 128-bit block cipher (NESSIE).

summary.zh: 密钥流独立于明文。
summary.en: Keystream independent of plaintext.

summary.zh: 带迭代次数的口令派生。
summary.en: Iterated password-based derivation.

summary.zh: 用 256 字节查找表生成 8 位哈希。
summary.en: 8-bit hash via 256-byte table.

summary.zh: 64 位广义 Feistel 轻量密码。
summary.en: 64-bit generalized Feistel lightweight cipher.

summary.zh: 基于模 2^130-5 的一次性 MAC。
summary.en: One-time MAC mod 2^130-5.

summary.zh: 5×5 方阵把字母映射为两位坐标（I/J 合并），可自定义关键字打乱布局。
summary.en: 5×5 square maps each letter to a two-digit coordinate (I/J merged), optionally scrambled by a keyword.

summary.zh: 面向 RFID 的 64 位轻量密码。
summary.en: Lightweight 64-bit cipher for RFID.

summary.zh: RSA 设计的 64 位分组密码。
summary.en: 64-bit block cipher by RSA Security.

summary.zh: 经典 RC4 的教学实现：KSA 初始化 256 字节状态，PRGA 生成密钥流，逐字节异或。
summary.en: Educational RC4: KSA initializes a 256-byte state, PRGA emits keystream bytes, XORed with plaintext.

summary.zh: RC5：Rivest 的参数化 Feistel，加法 + 数据依赖旋转。
summary.en: RC5: Rivest parameterized Feistel with addition + data-dependent rotation.

summary.zh: RC6：RC6 加入乘法运算与 4 个寄存器。
summary.en: RC6: extends RC5 with multiplication and 4 working registers.

summary.zh: RIPEMD-160：双并行 MD4 风格 160 位哈希。
summary.en: RIPEMD-160: dual parallel MD4-style 160-bit hash.

summary.zh: 凯撒密码的推广，把每个字母在字母表中旋转 N 位（ROT13 为自反特例）。
summary.en: Generalization of Caesar shifting each letter by N (ROT13 is the self-inverse special case).

summary.zh: 把可打印 ASCII（33–126）旋转 47 位，加密两次即还原。
summary.en: Rotate printable ASCII (33–126) by 47 positions; applying twice restores the original.

summary.zh: Daniel Bernstein 设计的 ARX 流密码，20 轮四分之一轮变换，输出 64 字节密钥流块。
summary.en: An ARX stream cipher by Daniel Bernstein: 20 rounds of quarter-round transforms emit a 64-byte keystream block.

summary.zh: SEED：韩国 KISA 标准 16 轮 Feistel。
summary.en: SEED: Korean KISA-standard 16-round Feistel.

summary.zh: Serpent：AES 候选，32 轮 SPN，保守安全裕度。
summary.en: Serpent: AES finalist, 32-round SPN, conservative security margin.

summary.zh: SHACAL：把 SHA-1 当分组密码（密钥=消息）。
summary.en: SHACAL: SHA-1 used as a block cipher (key = message).

summary.zh: SHAKE128：基于 Keccak 的可扩展输出函数（XOF）。
summary.en: SHAKE128: Keccak-based extendable output function (XOF).

summary.zh: AES 前身的 SPN。
summary.en: SPN predecessor of AES.

summary.zh: NSA 设计的轻量 Feistel。
summary.en: Lightweight Feistel by NSA.

summary.zh: Skipjack：NSA 设计 80 位密钥 32 轮，A/B 两类规则。
summary.en: Skipjack: NSA-designed 80-bit-key 32-round cipher with Rule A/B.

summary.zh: NSA 设计的软件友好 ARX。
summary.en: Software-friendly ARX by NSA.

summary.zh: AES 前身，128 位 SPN。
summary.en: AES predecessor, 128-bit SPN.

summary.zh: 不规则的 3 行棋盘：首行 8 个常用字母为 1 位码，其余为 2 位码。
summary.en: An irregular 3-row checkerboard: 8 common letters map to 1-digit codes, the rest to 2-digit codes.

summary.zh: 128 位密钥、64 位分组的 Feistel 分组密码，32 轮，结构极简。
summary.en: A Feistel block cipher with a 128-bit key and 64-bit block over 32 rounds — famously compact.

summary.zh: TEA：32 轮 Feistel，加法 + 移位 + delta 常量。
summary.en: TEA: 32-round Feistel with add + shift + delta constant.

summary.zh: 把 27 字符排进 3 层 3×3 立方体，每字符分数化为 3 个坐标，按周期重组。
summary.en: Arrange 27 symbols in a 3-layer 3×3 cube; each char fractionates into 3 coordinates, regrouped by period.

summary.zh: eSTREAM 硬件友好流密码。
summary.en: eSTREAM hardware-friendly stream cipher.

summary.zh: Twofish：AES 候选，Feistel + 密钥相关 S 盒。
summary.en: Twofish: AES finalist, Feistel with key-dependent S-boxes.

summary.zh: 把经典维吉尼亚扩展到 A-Z + 0-9 共 36 字符表，多表替换。
summary.en: Extends classical Vigenère to a 36-symbol alphabet (A-Z, 0-9), still polyalphabetic.

summary.zh: Whirlpool：NESSIE 推荐的 512 位海绵/分组哈希。
summary.en: Whirlpool: NESSIE-recommended 512-bit sponge/block hash.

summary.zh: TEA 的改进版：用 key[(sum & 3)…] 选择密钥字，结构更难被差分攻击。
summary.en: Improved TEA variant: selects key words via key[(sum&3)…], resisting related-key attacks better.

summary.zh: 可变长度的块密码：一次加密整个 32 位字数组，无需分组模式。
summary.en: A variable-length block cipher: encrypts an entire array of 32-bit words at once — no block mode needed.

summary.zh: DES玩具版属于crypto类别。
summary.en: DES (Toy) is a crypto algorithm.

summary.zh: DH密钥交换属于crypto类别。
summary.en: Diffie-Hellman is a crypto algorithm.

summary.zh: HMAC消息认证属于crypto类别。
summary.en: HMAC is a crypto algorithm.

summary.zh: MD5哈希属于crypto类别。
summary.en: MD5 is a crypto algorithm.

summary.zh: Playfair密码属于crypto类别。
summary.en: Playfair Cipher is a crypto algorithm.

summary.zh: 5×5 方阵把字母映射成两位数字（I/J 合并）。
summary.en: A 5×5 grid maps each letter to a two-digit number (I/J merged).

summary.zh: 按 Z 字形把字符分到 n 条「栏」后逐栏读取。
summary.en: Writes characters in a zigzag across n "rails", then reads rail by rail.

summary.zh: RC4流密码属于crypto类别。
summary.en: RC4 is a crypto algorithm.

summary.zh: 凯撒密码 shift=13 的特例，自对合（加密=解密）。
summary.en: Caesar with shift=13; involutive (encryption equals decryption).

summary.zh: RSA（玩具版）属于crypto类别。
summary.en: RSA (Toy) is a crypto algorithm.

summary.zh: 维吉尼亚变体：密钥是长文本（书的一页）。
summary.en: A Vigenère variant whose key is a long text (e.g., a page of a book).

summary.zh: SHA-1哈希属于crypto类别。
summary.en: SHA-1 is a crypto algorithm.

summary.zh: SHA-256属于crypto类别。
summary.en: SHA-256 is a crypto algorithm.

summary.zh: Keccak 海绵结构：吸收 + 挤出，简化教学版。
summary.en: Keccak sponge construction: absorb + squeeze (simplified teaching version).

summary.zh: SHA-512哈希属于crypto类别。
summary.en: SHA-512 is a crypto algorithm.

summary.zh: 维吉尼亚密码属于crypto类别。
summary.en: Vigenère Cipher is a crypto algorithm.

summary.zh: k 个哈希函数驱动的位数组：插入置位，查询全 1 才可能存在。
summary.en: A bit array driven by k hash functions: set bits on insert; a query needs all bits set to possibly exist.

summary.zh: 一致性哈希属于hashing类别。
summary.en: Consistent Hashing is a hashing algorithm.

summary.zh: 二维计数草图：d 个哈希 × w 列取最小值，估计元素频率（只高估）。
summary.en: A 2-D counting sketch: d hashes × w columns, take the min to estimate frequency (never underestimates).

summary.zh: 位数组升级为计数数组，支持删除；查询仍无假阴性、可能有假阳性。
summary.en: Replace bits with counters to support deletion; queries still have no false negatives, possible false positives.

summary.zh: 布谷鸟哈希属于hashing类别。
summary.en: Cuckoo Hashing is a hashing algorithm.

summary.zh: 支持删除的近似集合查询：每桶 4 槽指纹 + 双哈希踢出。
summary.en: A deletion-capable approximate set membership test: 4-slot fingerprint buckets with two-hash cuckoo eviction.

summary.zh: 冲突时步长用第二个哈希函数 h2(k)，彻底消除聚集。
summary.en: On collision step by a second hash function h2(k), eliminating clustering.

complexity.time: O(1) 期望 / O(n) 最坏

summary.zh: 用两对独立的 (base, P) 同时哈希，碰撞概率降至约 1/(P1·P2)。
summary.en: Hash simultaneously with two independent (base, P) pairs, dropping collisions to ~1/(P1·P2).

summary.zh: 逐字节异或后再乘 FNV 素数，简单快速的非加密哈希。
summary.en: XOR each byte then multiply by the FNV prime; a simple fast non-cryptographic hash.

summary.zh: Zlib 用的轻量校验和：两个模 65521 的累加和。
summary.en: Lightweight zlib checksum: two running sums mod 65521.

summary.zh: Bernstein 经典变体 hash*33^c（XOR 版 DJB2）。
summary.en: Bernstein classic variant hash*33^c (the XOR variant of DJB2).

summary.zh: BLAKE2b 哈希：基于 ChaCha 的压缩函数，比 SHA-2 快且抗碰撞。
summary.en: BLAKE2b hash: ChaCha-style compression, faster than SHA-2 and collision-resistant.

summary.zh: BLAKE2bp：BLAKE2 的并行 4 路变种，针对长输入优化。
summary.en: BLAKE2bp: 4-way parallel variant of BLAKE2, optimized for long inputs.

summary.zh: BLAKE2sp：8 路并行 BLAKE2 变种，针对短输入 SIMD 优化。
summary.en: BLAKE2sp: 8-way parallel BLAKE2 variant tuned for short-input SIMD.

summary.zh: BLAKE3：可并行化的 Merkle 树式哈希，比 BLAKE2 更快，支持 XOF。
summary.en: BLAKE3: parallelizable Merkle-tree hash, faster than BLAKE2, supports XOF.

summary.zh: BLAKE3 变体：Merkle 树式并行哈希，比 BLAKE2 更快。
summary.en: BLAKE3 variant: Merkle-tree parallel hash, faster than BLAKE2.

summary.zh: 位数组+k 个哈希，空间高效成员查询，有假阳性无假阴性。
summary.en: Bit array + k hashes; space-efficient membership with false positives, no false negatives.

summary.zh: Google CityHash32：针对短键优化的 32 位非加密哈希。
summary.en: Google CityHash32: 32-bit non-crypto hash optimized for short keys.

summary.zh: Google CityHash64：64 位非加密哈希，针对中等长度字符串优化。
summary.en: Google CityHash64: 64-bit non-crypto hash tuned for medium-length strings.

summary.zh: CityHash64：Google 为短字符串优化的 64 位哈希，被用于 hash 表分桶。
summary.en: CityHash64: Google-optimized 64-bit hash for short strings, used for hash table bucketing.

summary.zh: 基于块密码的 MAC，用子密钥对最后块特殊处理，验证完整性。
summary.en: Block-cipher-based MAC using subkeys for the final block; verifies integrity.

summary.zh: 用计数器代替位支持删除，应对插入/删除流。
summary.en: Uses counters instead of bits to support deletion under insert/delete streams.

summary.zh: 循环冗余校验：基于多项式除法检测数据传输错误。
summary.en: Cyclic redundancy check: polynomial division for detecting transmission errors.

summary.zh: 模拟布谷鸟哈希插入的踢出链，分析失败阈值。
summary.en: Simulate the eviction chain during cuckoo-hash insertion; analyze the failure threshold.

summary.zh: 循环多项式哈希：用字节旋转异或实现 O(1) 滚动，Buzhash 的现代变体。
summary.en: Cyclic polynomial hash: byte-rotated XOR achieves O(1) rolling; modern Buzhash variant.

summary.zh: 经典字符串哈希：hash = hash*33 + c，初值 5381，简单高效。
summary.en: Classic string hash: hash = hash*33 + c, starting at 5381, simple and efficient.

summary.zh: Google FarmHash32：CityHash 的后继，针对短字符串优化。
summary.en: Google FarmHash32: successor to CityHash, tuned for short strings.

summary.zh: FarmHash64：CityHash 的继任者，Google 为字符串哈希优化，避免 SIMD 依赖。
summary.en: FarmHash64: CityHash successor optimized by Google for string hashing without SIMD dependencies.

summary.zh: FastHash 32 位：每 4 字节混合 + 末尾finalize，追求速度。
summary.en: FastHash 32-bit: mix per 4 bytes plus a finalize step, optimized for speed.

summary.zh: 把串视作多项式对不可约多项式取模，理论可证低碰撞。
summary.en: Treat string as a polynomial mod an irreducible one; provably low collisions.

summary.zh: Fowler-Noll-Vo 非加密哈希：offset basis 异或再乘素数，分布均匀速度快。
summary.en: Fowler-Noll-Vo non-crypto hash: XOR offset basis then multiply prime; fast, well-distributed.

summary.zh: FNV-1a 64 位：逐字节 hash=(hash^byte)*prime，用 BigInt。
summary.en: FNV-1a 64-bit: per byte hash=(hash^byte)*prime, using BigInt.

summary.zh: FNV-1a 64 位：hash ^= c; hash *= 1099511628211，BigInt 实现。
summary.en: FNV-1a 64-bit: hash ^= c; hash *= 1099511628211, BigInt implementation.

summary.zh: 几何哈希：把 2D 点集在仿射变换下规范化后哈希，用于点模式匹配。
summary.en: Geometric hashing: hash 2D point sets after affine-invariant normalization for point-pattern matching.

summary.zh: 把浮点数量化到指数桶，适合对数尺度数据的快速分桶。
summary.en: Quantize floats into exponential buckets; fast bucketing for log-scale data.

summary.zh: GOST：俄罗斯标准的密码学哈希（GOST R 34.11）。
summary.en: GOST: Russian standard cryptographic hash (GOST R 34.11).

summary.zh: 开放寻址变体：键必须在家的 H 邻域内，利用位图维护邻近性。
summary.en: Open-addressing variant: keys stay within H of home; a bitmap tracks neighborhood.

summary.zh: 用桶记录前导零最大值，常数内存估计基数，误差约 1.04/√m。
summary.en: Buckets track max leading-zero counts; constant memory cardinality estimate, error ~1.04/√m.

summary.zh: 整数组合哈希：移位+加法+异或混合，适合小整数键快速散列。
summary.en: Integer-combine hash via shift+add+xor mixing; fast for small integer keys.

summary.zh: Bob Jenkins 一次一击哈希：hash+=c; hash+=(hash<<10); hash^=(hash>>6)。
summary.en: Bob Jenkins one-at-a-time hash: hash+=c; hash+=(hash<<10); hash^=(hash>>6).

summary.zh: Bob Jenkins 的 32 位逐字节哈希：每字节加+移位混合。
summary.en: Bob Jenkins 32-bit per-byte hash: each byte added then mixed by shifts.

summary.zh: 分析线性探查下负载因子与平均探查次数的关系。
summary.en: Analyze the relationship between load factor and expected probe count under linear probing.

summary.zh: 局部敏感哈希（SimHash）：相似输入映射到相近哈希，用于近似最近邻与去重。
summary.en: Locality-sensitive hash (SimHash): similar inputs map to similar hashes; used for ANN and dedup.

summary.zh: Bob Jenkins lookup3：32 位，按 12 字节块使用 a/b/c 三寄存器混合。
summary.en: Bob Jenkins lookup3: 32-bit, mixes a/b/c registers over 12-byte chunks.

summary.zh: MD2：Rivest 1989 的 8 位字节级哈希，针对 8 位机优化。
summary.en: MD2: Rivest 1989 byte-level hash optimized for 8-bit machines.

summary.zh: MD4：Rivest 1990 的 128 位消息摘要，已被攻破但有历史意义。
summary.en: MD4: Rivest 1990 128-bit digest, broken but historically significant.

summary.zh: 用 k 个哈希的最小值估计 Jaccard 相似度，用于近重复检测。
summary.en: Use k min-hash values to estimate Jaccard similarity for near-duplicate detection.

summary.zh: Murmur3 fmix32 雪崩函数：三次异或-乘法混合，将弱散列打乱为均匀分布。
summary.en: Murmur3 fmix32 avalanche: three xor-multiply mixes turn weak hashes into uniform distribution.

summary.zh: Austin Lee Bykov 的 MurmurHash2：32 位非加密、按 4 字节块混合 m=0x5bd1e995。
summary.en: Austin Lee Bykov MurmurHash2: 32-bit non-crypto, 4-byte chunks mixed with m=0x5bd1e995.

summary.zh: MurmurHash2A：Murmur2 的改进版，尾部混合更稳健。
summary.en: MurmurHash2A: improved Murmur2 with sturdier tail mixing.

summary.zh: MurmurHash3 x64 128 位变体，用一对 64 位状态输出 128 位哈希。
summary.en: MurmurHash3 x64 128-bit variant using a pair of 64-bit states to emit a 128-bit hash.

summary.zh: 高性能非加密哈希：种子+混合+最终雪崩，广泛用于哈希表。
summary.en: High-perf non-crypto hash: seed + mix + final avalanche; widely used in hash tables.

summary.zh: Jenkins One-At-A-Time：加字节+移位+加法混合，碰撞率低。
summary.en: Jenkins One-At-A-Time: add byte + shifts + adds; low collision rate.

summary.zh: 只哈希键的部分位段，加速分布不均键的快速分片。
summary.en: Hash only selected bit-fields of a key; speeds sharding for skewed keys.

summary.zh: Paul Hsieh 的 SuperFast 哈希：按 4 字节块处理，带 get16/rot 移位。
summary.en: Paul Hsieh SuperFast hash: processes 4-byte chunks with get16 and rotation.

summary.zh: 用 256 字节随机表逐字节异或查表，单遍快速生成 8 位哈希。
summary.en: XOR-lookup against a 256-byte random table; single-pass fast 8-bit hash.

summary.zh: 对静态键集构造无冲突哈希，查询 O(1) 且无假阳性。
summary.en: Construct a collision-free hash for a static key set; O(1) lookup, no false positives.

summary.zh: ELF 文件符号表哈希：高位影响低位，分散前缀相似字符串。
summary.en: ELF symbol-table hash: high bits fold into low bits, dispersing similar prefixes.

summary.zh: 把字符串视作多项式系数，模大素数求值，支持双模防碰撞。
summary.en: Treat string as polynomial coefficients evaluated mod a large prime; pair mods to avoid collisions.

summary.zh: 滑动窗口哈希 O(1) 更新：减去离开位、乘基数、加进入位。
summary.en: Sliding-window hash in O(1): subtract outgoing, multiply base, add incoming.

summary.zh: RIPEMD：欧洲研发的 128 位哈希，两条并行链。
summary.en: RIPEMD: European 128-bit hash with two parallel chains.

summary.zh: RIPEMD-160：160 位强化版，仍用于比特币地址。
summary.en: RIPEMD-160: strengthened 160-bit version, still used in Bitcoin addresses.

summary.zh: 线性探查变体：插入时让"更富"(探查少)的元素让位给"更穷"的，均衡探查距离。
summary.en: Linear-probe variant: on insert, evict a richer (closer) element to help a poorer one; balances probe distance.

summary.zh: 滚动哈希：滑动窗口下 O(1) 更新的多项式哈希，用于 Rabin-Karp / 字符串匹配。
summary.en: Rolling hash: O(1) sliding-window polynomial hash used for Rabin-Karp string matching.

summary.zh: SDBM 数据库使用的字符串哈希：hash = c + hash*65599。
summary.en: String hash used by the SDBM database: hash = c + hash*65599.

summary.zh: Shabal：可变长度密码学哈希，使用宽管线和复杂轮函数。
summary.en: Shabal: variable-length cryptographic hash using a wide pipeline and complex round function.

summary.zh: SHAKE128：SHA-3 系列的可扩展输出函数 (XOF)。
summary.en: SHAKE128: extendable-output function (XOF) from the SHA-3 family.

summary.zh: SHAKE256：SHA-3 系列高安全级别的 XOF。
summary.en: SHAKE256: higher-security XOF from the SHA-3 family.

summary.zh: 把文档特征加权求和后符号化，得到对局部修改鲁棒的指纹。
summary.en: Weighted feature sum then sign-binarize; yields a fingerprint robust to local edits.

summary.zh: SipHash-2-4：ARX 流密码式哈希，抗碰撞，用于哈希表防 HashDoS。
summary.en: SipHash-2-4: ARX stream-cipher-style hash, collision-resistant, used to defend hash tables from HashDoS.

summary.zh: ARX 结构带密钥哈希，抗碰撞攻击，哈希表默认选择。
summary.en: Keyed ARX hash resistant to collision attacks; default in many hash tables.

summary.zh: Spectral：基于矩阵变换的密码学哈希，模拟频谱扩散。
summary.en: Spectral: matrix-transform-based cryptographic hash simulating spectral diffusion.

summary.zh: SpookyHash V2：Bob Jenkins 设计的高速 64 位哈希，用于非加密场景。
summary.en: SpookyHash V2: high-speed 64-bit hash by Bob Jenkins for non-cryptographic use.

summary.zh: Paul Hsieh SuperFastHash 的别名实现（与 paul-hsieh 算法同源）。
summary.en: An alias-family implementation of Paul Hsieh SuperFastHash (same source as paul-hsieh).

summary.zh: 表格哈希：用三维随机表把字符串映射为 64 位，3-独立、O(1) 查表。
summary.en: Tabulation hashing: 3-dimensional random table maps strings to 64 bits, 3-independent, O(1) lookup.

summary.zh: 查表法：每字节查随机表后异或，3-独立但极快，适合简单哈希表。
summary.en: Zobrist-style tabulation: XOR per-byte table lookups; 3-independent yet extremely fast.

summary.zh: 随机选 h_{a,b}(x)=((ax+b) mod p) mod m，碰撞概率 ≤ 1/m。
summary.en: Randomly pick h_{a,b}(x)=((ax+b) mod p) mod m; collision prob <= 1/m.

summary.zh: Whirlpool：512 位 AES-inspired 哈希，NESSIE 选用。
summary.en: Whirlpool: 512-bit AES-inspired hash selected by NESSIE.

summary.zh: wyhash：当前最快的 64 位通用哈希之一，用于浏览器与游戏。
summary.en: wyhash: one of the fastest general-purpose 64-bit hashes, used in browsers and games.

summary.zh: XXH3 用固定 secret 与输入字交错乘加，达到 SIMD 友好高吞吐。
summary.en: XXH3 interleaves input with a fixed secret via multiply-add; SIMD-friendly high throughput.

summary.zh: XXH3：xxHash 第 3 代，混合了通用与 SIMD 路径，当前最快的 64 位哈希。
summary.en: XXH3: 3rd generation xxHash combining scalar and SIMD paths, the fastest 64-bit hash to date.

summary.zh: xxHash 64 位：4×64 位累加器 + 末尾合并，极快非加密哈希。
summary.en: xxHash 64-bit: four 64-bit accumulators plus a final merge; an ultra-fast non-cryptographic hash.

summary.zh: 棋盘每格每状态预生成随机数，整体哈希为异或和，支持增量更新。
summary.en: Precompute random per cell-state; board hash is XOR sum, incrementally updatable.

summary.zh: Zobrist 哈希：用 64 位随机数为棋盘每个 (格, 棋子) 预生成，XOR 得到局面哈希，支持增量更新。
summary.en: Zobrist hash: pre-generated 64-bit randoms per (square, piece); XOR gives position hash with incremental updates.

summary.zh: 开放寻址 + 邻域约束：键必须落在 hash 后的 H 步窗口内，用位图记录。
summary.en: Open addressing with a bounded neighborhood H: each key stays within H slots of its home, tracked by a bitmap.

summary.zh: 用 ~KB 级内存估计海量数据基数（不同元素个数），误差约 0.8%。
summary.en: Estimate cardinality (distinct count) of massive streams with kilobytes of memory, ~0.8% error.

summary.zh: 冲突时顺次探测下一槽 (i+1, i+2, …)，遇到空槽即落位。
summary.en: On collision probe the next slot (i+1, i+2, …) until an empty slot is found.

complexity.time: O(1) 期望 / O(n) 最坏

summary.zh: 用 k 个最小哈希签名估计 Jaccard 相似度 |A∩B| / |A∪B|。
summary.en: Estimate Jaccard similarity |A∩B| / |A∪B| via k minimum-hash signatures.

summary.zh: 「乘 + 旋转 + 异或」的非加密哈希，分布均匀，广泛用于哈希表。
summary.en: A non-cryptographic "multiply-rotate-xor" hash with uniform distribution, widely used in hash tables.

summary.zh: 开放寻址哈希属于hashing类别。
summary.en: Open Addressing Hash is a hashing algorithm.

complexity.time: O(1) 期望 / O(n) 最坏

summary.zh: 用一张 256 字节置换表逐字节查表+异或，得到任意位宽哈希。
summary.en: Per-byte table lookup + XOR over a 256-byte permutation yields any-width hash.

summary.zh: 为固定键集构造无冲突哈希：一级分桶、桶内二级重哈希至零碰撞。
summary.en: Build a collision-free hash for a fixed key set: first-level bucketing, second-level rehash per bucket to zero collisions.

summary.zh: 竞赛常用：H = Σ s[i]·base^(n-1-i) mod P，窗口可在 O(1) 内向右滚动一位。
summary.en: Contest staple: H = Σ s[i]·base^(n-1-i) mod P; a window rolls right one step in O(1).

summary.zh: 冲突时探测 h+i² (i=1,2,3,…) 避免线性主聚集。
summary.en: On collision probe h+i² (i=1,2,3,…) to avoid primary clustering.

complexity.time: O(1) 期望 / O(n) 最坏

summary.zh: 把字节串视为大整数的系数，在模 P 下做多项式求值，得到滚动指纹。
summary.en: Treat bytes as coefficients of a polynomial, evaluate mod P for a rolling fingerprint.

summary.zh: 开放寻址中「劫富济贫」：探测时按 PSL 抢占更近的槽，降低最大探测长度。
summary.en: Open addressing that "steals from the rich": displace by probe-length to flatten the worst-case probe distance.

summary.zh: 对每个特征哈希的每一位做 ± 加权累加，取符号得定长指纹；相似文档指纹相近。
summary.en: Accumulate each feature hash bit with ± weight, take sign for a fixed-length fingerprint; similar docs stay close.

summary.zh: 随机从族 H={hₐ,b} 选取，对任意 x≠y 碰撞概率 ≤ 1/m，对抗恶意输入。
summary.en: Pick randomly from H={hₐ,b}; for any x≠y collision prob ≤ 1/m, defeating adversarial inputs.

summary.zh: 「乘大常数 + 每四字节一累加旋转」的极快非加密哈希，性能近内存带宽。
summary.en: A blazing non-cryptographic hash (multiply-large-constant + per-4-byte accumulate-rotate), near memory bandwidth.

summary.zh: 为每个(棋子,格子)预置随机数，棋盘状态即所有占用项的异或和。
summary.en: Pre-fill a random number per (piece, square); a board state is the XOR of all occupied entries.

complexity.time: O(1) 增量 / O(cells) 全算

summary.zh: 判定某队能否追上分区第一名：把剩余比赛建模为最大流，比较理论最大胜场。
summary.en: Decide whether a team can still win the division: model remaining games as max flow, compare theoretical max wins.

summary.zh: 由最大匹配构造最小点覆盖（König 定理）：覆盖大小 = 最大匹配数。
summary.en: Build a minimum vertex cover from a maximum matching (König's theorem); cover size = matching size.

summary.zh: Edmonds 的「花朵收缩」算法，求一般图（非二分图）的最大匹配。
summary.en: Edmonds' blossom-shrinking algorithm for maximum matching on general (non-bipartite) graphs.

summary.zh: 有上下界容量的环流可行性：构造超级源汇 + 强制下界流量，跑最大流判定。
summary.en: Feasibility of a circulation with lower/upper bounds: super source/sink + forced lower-bound flow + max-flow check.

summary.zh: 分层网络 + DFS 求阻塞流，复杂度 O(V²·E)，单位容量图更快。
summary.en: Level graph plus DFS blocking flow; O(V²·E) and faster on unit-capacity graphs.

summary.zh: Dinic 上叠加容量缩放：每轮只处理残量 ≥ 阈值 的边，阈值逐轮减半。
summary.en: Dinic with capacity scaling: each round only edges with residual >= threshold are used; threshold halves each round.

summary.zh: 用 BFS 找最短增广路的 Ford-Fulkerson，保证 O(V·E²)。
summary.en: Ford-Fulkerson with BFS shortest augmenting paths; guaranteed O(V·E²).

summary.zh: 最大流 Ford-Fulkerson属于network类别。
summary.en: Ford-Fulkerson Max Flow is a network algorithm.

summary.zh: 用 V-1 次最大流构造一棵树，树上每对节点的瓶颈即原图最小割容量。
summary.en: Build a tree in V-1 max-flow calls whose path bottleneck gives the original min-cut between any pair.

summary.zh: 每轮 BFS 找多条最短增广路并行增广，O(E·√V)。
summary.en: Each round BFS finds many shortest augmenting paths at once; O(E·√V).

summary.zh: 对每个左侧点 DFS 找增广路，O(V·E) 求二分图最大匹配。
summary.en: For each left vertex, DFS an augmenting path; O(V·E) bipartite maximum matching.

summary.zh: 把像素前景/背景二分建模为 s-t 最小割：源=前景，汇=背景。
summary.en: Model foreground/background pixel partitioning as an s-t min-cut: source=foreground, sink=background.

summary.zh: 把「在每时刻最多选 k 个不冲突区间」的最大选择问题建模为最大流。
summary.en: Model "select max non-conflicting intervals with at most k per time" as a max-flow problem.

summary.zh: 二分图最大匹配：逐个左点 DFS 找增广路，复杂度 O(V·E)。
summary.en: Maximum bipartite matching via per-left-vertex DFS augmenting paths; O(V·E).

summary.zh: 先求任意最大流，再反复消去残量网络中的负费用环，直到无负环。
summary.en: First find any max flow, then repeatedly cancel negative-cost cycles in the residual graph.

summary.zh: 在最大流基础上求总费用最小：SPFA 找费用最短增广路逐次增广。
summary.en: Among maximum flows pick the one with minimum total cost; SPFA-based augmenting paths.

summary.zh: 最小割属于network类别。
summary.en: Min Cut is a network algorithm.

summary.zh: 分层网络中找「潜在通过量」最小的节点为瓶颈，O(V³) 两阶段推进。
summary.en: In the level graph, repeatedly find the minimum "potential throughput" node as the bottleneck; O(V³).

summary.zh: 用并查集合并共享邮箱的账户。
summary.en: Merge accounts sharing emails via union-find.

summary.zh: 由排序后的单词列表推导字母顺序（拓扑排序）。
summary.en: Infer letter order from sorted words (topo sort).

summary.zh: DAG 中所有从 0 到 n-1 的路径。
summary.en: All paths from 0 to n-1 in a DAG.

summary.zh: Tarjan 算法求无向图割点。
summary.en: Tarjan algorithm for articulation points.

summary.zh: 在 n×n 代价方阵上求一一对应的最小总代价分配，归约为最小费用最大流。
summary.en: Solve the minimum-cost one-to-one assignment on an n×n cost matrix via reduction to min-cost max flow.

summary.zh: 在 m×n（m≠n）代价矩阵上求最小代价分配，用零代价虚拟行/列补成方阵。
summary.en: Solve minimum-cost assignment on an m×n (m!=n) cost matrix by padding with zero-cost dummy rows or columns into a square.

summary.zh: 每轮选取瓶颈容量最大的增广路（类似 Dijkstra 的最大带宽路径），加快收敛。
summary.en: Each round pick the augmenting path with the largest bottleneck capacity (a widest-path / maximum-bandwidth variant of Dijkstra) to speed convergence.

summary.zh: 允许负权边的单源最短路，可检测负环。
summary.en: Single-source shortest path allowing negative edges; detects negative cycles.

summary.zh: 邻接表上 BFS，记录访问顺序与层。
summary.en: BFS on adjacency list with levels.

summary.zh: 对二分图边贪心匹配。
summary.en: Greedy matching on a bipartite graph.

summary.zh: 在分层图中用 DFS（当前弧优化）求一条阻塞流：每条 s-t 路径至少一条边饱和。
summary.en: Use DFS with current-arc optimization on the level graph to find a blocking flow where every s-t path has at least one saturated edge.

summary.zh: Tarjan 算法求无向图桥。
summary.en: Tarjan algorithm for bridges.

summary.zh: Bellman-Ford 限制 K 步求最便宜航班。
summary.en: Cheapest flight within K stops (Bellman-Ford bounded).

summary.zh: 判定每条边带流量下界 l(e) 与上界 c(e) 的网络是否存在满足容量与守恒的环流。
summary.en: Decide whether a network with per-edge lower bounds l(e) and upper bounds c(e) admits a circulation satisfying capacity and conservation.

summary.zh: 在距离阈值内邻居最少的城市编号。
summary.en: City with fewest reachable neighbors within distance threshold.

summary.zh: 深拷贝无向图节点（带邻居）。
summary.en: Deep-copy an undirected graph node with neighbors.

summary.zh: 贪心给图节点着色（相邻不同色）。
summary.en: Greedy vertex coloring.

summary.zh: 求无向图连通分量数。
summary.en: Count connected components in an undirected graph.

summary.zh: 判断 prerequisites 是否能完成（拓扑判环）。
summary.en: Whether all courses can be finished (cycle detection).

summary.zh: DFS 判断无向图是否有环。
summary.en: DFS cycle detection in an undirected graph.

summary.zh: 邻接表上递归 DFS，记录访问顺序。
summary.en: Recursive DFS on an adjacency list.

summary.zh: 非负权重图单源最短路。
summary.en: Single-source shortest path on a non-negative weighted graph.

summary.zh: 判断无向图是否存在欧拉路径/回路。
summary.en: Check if an undirected graph has an Euler path/circuit.

summary.zh: 在图中找必然到达终点的节点（无出边或全指向安全节点）。
summary.en: Nodes guaranteed to reach a terminal (no cycle reachable).

title.zh: 两点不相交路径（最大流法）

summary.zh: 用单位容量最大流判断 s→t 是否存在两条点不相交路径并输出它们。
summary.en: Use unit-capacity max-flow to find (if any) two vertex-disjoint s→t paths.

summary.zh: 将二分图最大匹配归约为最大流：超级源连左部、左部连右部、右部连超级汇。
summary.en: Reduce bipartite maximum matching to max flow: super-source to left, left to right, right to super-sink, all unit capacities.

summary.zh: 将任意 s-t 流唯一分解为若干源汇路径流与若干环流之和。
summary.en: Uniquely decompose any s-t flow into a sum of source-to-sink path flows plus circulation cycles.

title.zh: k 条边不相交路径（最大流法）

summary.zh: 用单位容量最大流求 s→t 的最多 k 条边不相交路径。
summary.en: Use unit-capacity max-flow to find up to k edge-disjoint s→t paths.

summary.zh: 将含超额流的预流通过反向推送复原为满足守恒的合法流。
summary.en: Restore a preflow with excess back into a conservation-respecting feasible flow by pushing excess backward.

summary.zh: 在每条边带流量下界的源汇网络中求满足下界约束的最大流。
summary.en: Find a maximum source-sink flow when every edge has a lower-bound requirement.

summary.zh: 每条边除上界外还有下界：先构造满足下界的可行流，再在残量图上继续增广求最大流。
summary.en: Each edge has both a lower and upper bound: first build a feasible flow satisfying the lower bounds, then keep augmenting on the residual graph for max flow.

summary.zh: 动态规划求全源最短路，支持负权。
summary.en: All-pairs shortest path via DP; supports negative weights.

summary.zh: 用 Gusfield 算法（无需节点收缩）构造 Gomory-Hu 树，支持任意节点对最小割查询。
summary.en: Build a Gomory-Hu tree via Gusfield's algorithm (no node contraction), enabling arbitrary pairwise min-cut queries.

summary.zh: 把网格中连通的同色区域改为新颜色。
summary.en: Change connected same-color region to a new color.

summary.zh: 八方向网格从左上到右下最短路径长度。
summary.en: 8-direction shortest path from top-left to bottom-right.

summary.zh: BFS 染色法判断二分图。
summary.en: BFS two-coloring to test bipartiteness.

summary.zh: 数组中从 start 出发，每次左/右跳 arr[i] 步，能否到达 0。
summary.en: From start, jump ±arr[i]; can reach a 0?

summary.zh: 从房间0出发用钥匙能否访问所有房间。
summary.en: Can visit all rooms starting from room 0 with keys.

summary.zh: 按边权排序 + 并查集构造 MST。
summary.en: Sort edges by weight, union-find to build MST.

summary.zh: 用 BFS 按到源点距离为残量图节点分层，是 Dinic 算法的核心子步骤。
summary.en: Layer residual-graph nodes by BFS distance from the source; a core subroutine of Dinic's algorithm.

summary.zh: 拓扑排序+DP 求 DAG 最长路径长度。
summary.en: Topo sort + DP for longest path in a DAG.

summary.zh: 网格中 1 连通块的最大面积。
summary.en: Maximum area of connected 1s in a grid.

summary.zh: 用 BFS 分层 + DFS 同时找多条最短增广路，O(E·√V) 求二分图最大匹配。
summary.en: BFS layering plus DFS finds multiple shortest augmenting paths per phase, O(E·√V) max matching.

summary.zh: 引入超级汇点连接所有汇点，将多汇最大流归约为单源单汇最大流。
summary.en: Reduce multi-sink max flow to single-source single-sink by adding a super-sink connected from every sink.

summary.zh: 引入超级源点连接所有源点，将多源最大流归约为单源单汇最大流。
summary.en: Reduce multi-source max flow to single-source single-sink by adding a super-source connected to every source.

summary.zh: 通过节点分裂（拆为入点/出点）将节点容量转化为边容量，再求最大流。
summary.en: Convert node capacities to edge capacities by splitting each node into an in-vertex and out-vertex, then solve max flow.

summary.zh: 将每条无向边替换为两条等容量有向边，在有向残量图上求源汇最大流。
summary.en: Replace each undirected edge with two opposite directed edges of equal capacity, then run max flow on the directed residual graph.

summary.zh: 在带容量与费用图上找最小费用环流：先给一个可行环流，反复用 SPFA 找负费用环并沿环增广。
summary.en: Find a min-cost circulation on a capacitated, costed graph: start from a feasible circulation, then repeatedly find a negative-cost cycle (SPFA) and augment along it.

summary.zh: 先求任意最大流，再用 SPFA 检测并消除残量图中的负费用环直至无负圈。
summary.en: Start from any max flow, then detect and cancel negative-cost cycles in the residual graph via SPFA until none remain.

title.zh: 含负费用边的最小费用流

summary.zh: 用 Johnson 势能（Bellman-Ford 预处理）消除负费用边，再用 Dijkstra 增广。
summary.en: Use Johnson potentials (Bellman-Ford preprocessing) to eliminate negative-cost edges, then augment via Dijkstra.

title.zh: Stoer-Wagner 全局最小割（带合并记录）

summary.zh: 用 Stoer-Wagner 算法求无向加权图的全局最小割，并记录每轮的顶点合并过程。
summary.en: Compute the global minimum cut of an undirected weighted graph via Stoer-Wagner, recording each phase vertex merge.

summary.zh: 找树图的中心节点（作为根时高度最小）。
summary.en: Find centroid nodes of a tree (minimal height roots).

summary.zh: 信号从某节点发出，求所有节点收到的最短时间（Dijkstra 后取最大）。
summary.en: Max distance from source after Dijkstra = time to reach all.

summary.zh: 网格中 1 连通块数量。
summary.en: Count connected components of 1s in a grid.

summary.zh: 从 0000 转动到目标，避开 deadends 的最少步数。
summary.en: Min turns from 0000 to target avoiding deadends.

summary.zh: 找能同时流向两大洋的格子。
summary.en: Cells that can flow to both oceans.

summary.zh: 贪心选最小权边扩展生成树。
summary.en: Greedy MST by growing from a source with min edges.

summary.zh: 用 Hierholzer 算法从机票重建字典序最小的欧拉路径。
summary.en: Lexicographically smallest Eulerian itinerary via Hierholzer.

summary.zh: 无向图加一条边成环，找出那条多余边。
summary.en: Find the extra edge that creates a cycle.

summary.zh: 每分钟四向传染，求所有橘子腐烂的最少分钟。
summary.en: Min minutes to rot all oranges (4-dir per minute).

summary.zh: 判断 == 与 != 方程组是否自洽（并查集）。
summary.en: Check consistency of == and != equations via union-find.

summary.zh: 每轮用 BFS 找一条最短（边数最少）的 s-t 增广路，等价于 Edmonds-Karp。
summary.en: Each round use BFS to find a shortest (fewest-hop) s-t augmenting path; equivalent to Edmonds-Karp.

summary.zh: BFS 求蛇梯棋从 1 到 n² 的最少步数。
summary.en: Min moves from 1 to n^2 in snakes and ladders.

summary.zh: 从多个源点出发，求所有节点最近源的距离。
summary.en: Multi-source BFS: nearest source distance for each node.

summary.zh: Kosaraju 算法求有向图强连通分量。
summary.en: Kosaraju SCC on a directed graph.

summary.zh: 把被 X 完全围绕的 O 翻转为 X（边界相连的 O 保留）。
summary.en: Flip O to X if fully surrounded (border-connected Os kept).

summary.zh: 树形公司层级通知，求通知所有人时间。
summary.en: Time to inform all employees in a hierarchy tree.

summary.zh: BFS 入度法对 DAG 拓扑排序。
summary.en: Kahn BFS in-degree based topological sort.

summary.zh: 在供应点与需求点间以单位运费矩阵求最小总运费的运输方案。
summary.en: Find a minimum-cost shipping plan between supply and demand nodes given a unit-cost matrix.

summary.zh: 允许中间节点既收又发的最小费用流：供应点经转运点送达需求点。
summary.en: A min-cost flow allowing intermediate nodes to both receive and forward: supply reaches demand via transshipment nodes.

summary.zh: 带路径压缩与按秩合并的并查集。
summary.en: Disjoint-set with path compression and union by rank.

summary.zh: 每个房间填到最近门的距离（-1 墙、INF 空、0 门）。
summary.en: Fill each empty room with distance to nearest gate.

summary.zh: 判断能否用两水壶（容量x,y）与无限水准确量出 z。
summary.en: Measure exactly z using jugs of capacity x and y.

summary.zh: BFS 找 beginWord 到 endWord 最短转换序列长度（每次改一个字母）。
summary.en: Shortest transformation length changing one letter per step.

summary.zh: 把最小费用流转为生成树基解，反复用「负费用入边换正费用出边」迭代。
summary.en: Reframe min-cost flow as a spanning-tree basic solution; iteratively swap a negative-cost entering edge for a positive-cost leaving edge.

title.zh: 露天矿开采（最大权闭合子图）

summary.zh: 在「挖某块必先挖上方所有块」约束下，求利润最大的开采集合：转最大权闭合子图。
summary.en: Maximize profit of mined blocks under "must mine above first" precedence: reduce to max-weight closure.

title.zh: 项目选择（最大权闭合子图）

summary.zh: 选项目获利且依赖必须先选：转化为最大权闭合子图 → 最小割求解。
summary.en: Pick profitable projects honoring dependencies: reduce to max-weight closure → min-cut.

summary.zh: 高度标号 + 推送/重标操作，复杂度 O(V²·E)，gap/relabel 优化更快。
summary.en: Height labels with push/relabel operations; O(V²·E), faster with gap heuristics.

summary.zh: Goldberg 的预流推进变体：用链表维护待处理节点，重标后将其移到队首，O(V³)。
summary.en: Goldberg's push-relabel variant: a linked list of active nodes, move a relabeled node to the front; O(V³).

summary.zh: 通过 n-1 次「最大相邻序」收缩求无向加权图的全局最小割，O(V³)。
summary.en: Contract via maximum-adjacency ordering n-1 times to get the global min-cut; O(V³).

summary.zh: 每次在残量网络中找费用最短的 s→t 路增广，用 Johnson 势能处理负费用边。
summary.en: Repeatedly augment along the shortest (by cost) s→t path in the residual graph; Johnson potentials handle negative-cost edges.

summary.zh: Edmonds 的最大权匹配：用对偶变量（顶点标号 z_u）+ 花朵收缩解 primal-dual。
summary.en: Edmonds' maximum-weight matching: primal-dual via vertex duals z_u and blossom contraction.

summary.zh: 递归下降把中缀表达式构建为抽象语法树（AST）节点。
summary.en: Recursive-descent builds an abstract syntax tree (AST) from an infix expression.

summary.zh: 状态机逐字符解析 CSV：支持引号字段、引号转义（""）、字段内换行。
summary.en: A character-by-character state machine for CSV: quoted fields, escaped quotes (""), and embedded newlines.

summary.zh: CNF 文法下自底向上二维 DP，判断输入串是否可推导。
summary.en: Bottom-up 2-D dynamic programming under a CNF grammar to decide if a string is derivable.

summary.zh: 任意 CFG 的 O(n³) 分析：在每个位置建立状态集，扫描/完成/预测三步。
summary.en: An O(n³) parser for any CFG: build a state set at each position via scan, complete, and predict.

summary.zh:
解析反斜杠转义：\
 \\t \\\\ \" \\xHH \\uHHHH 等。
summary.en:
Parse backslash escapes: \
 \\t \\\\ \" \\xHH \\uHHHH etc.

summary.zh: 从后缀表达式用栈构建表达式树，再后序遍历求值。
summary.en: Build an expression tree from postfix via a stack, then post-order evaluate.

summary.zh: 广义 LR（GLR）解析器维护一组并行的 LR 栈头，可在移进-归约冲突处分裂，从而解析歧义或有歧义文法并生成解析森林。
summary.en: A Generalized LR (GLR) parser maintains a set of parallel LR stack heads that split on shift/reduce conflicts, allowing it to parse ambiguous grammars and yield a shared packed parse forest.

summary.zh: 中缀表达式求值属于parsing类别。
summary.en: Infix Expression Evaluation is a parsing algorithm.

summary.zh: 递归下降解析 JSON：null/bool/number/string/array/object。
summary.en: Recursive-descent parsing of JSON: null/bool/number/string/array/object.

summary.zh: 合并同心 LR(1) 状态（相同 LR(0) 核心）：状态数≈SLR，能力近 LR(1)。
summary.en: Merge LR(1) states sharing the same LR(0) core: state count near SLR, power near LR(1).

summary.zh: 词法分析器生成器把一组「token 规则」（正则式 → 类型）先编译为 NFA，再用子集构造法转为 DFA，最后对输入做最长匹配扫描。
summary.en: A lexer generator compiles a set of token rules (regex → kind) into an NFA, converts it to a DFA via subset construction, then scans input with longest-match.

summary.zh: 自顶向下、表驱动：用栈 + 当前输入 token 查预测表选产生式。
summary.en: Top-down, table-driven: use a stack plus the current input token to pick productions from a predictive table.

summary.zh: 规范 LR：LR(0) 项目附加 1-token 向前看，构造最强移进-归约表。
summary.en: Canonical LR: LR(0) items augmented with one-token lookahead, producing the most powerful shift-reduce table.

title.zh: 数学表达式解析（含函数）

summary.zh: 递归下降解析含一元负号、函数调用（sin/max/...）与 +−*/^ 的表达式。
summary.en: Recursive descent parsing with unary minus, function calls (sin/max/...) and +−*/^.

summary.zh: 用算符优先关系表（栈顶 vs 输入）移进-归约解析表达式。
summary.en: Shift-reduce using an operator-precedence table comparing stack top vs input.

summary.zh: PEG + 记忆化：每位置缓存解析结果，保证线性时间无回溯。
summary.en: PEG with memoization: cache a parse result at each position for guaranteed linear time without backtracking.

summary.zh: 构造 AC 自动机，一次扫描文本同时匹配多模式。
summary.en: Build an automaton to scan text once and match many patterns simultaneously.

summary.zh: 用自底向上重写把一棵 AST 函数式地变换成另一棵等价/优化 AST。
summary.en: Bottom-up rewrite to functionally transform one AST into an equivalent / optimized AST.

summary.zh: 在不改变节点类的前提下，用访问者遍历 AST 并对各节点类型分派操作。
summary.en: Traverse an AST and dispatch per-node-type operations via a visitor, without changing node classes.

summary.zh: 巴科斯范式：用 <非终结符> ::= 展开式 描述上下文无关文法。
summary.en: Backus-Naur Form: describes context-free grammars via <non-terminal> ::= expansion.

summary.zh: 把 CFG 改写为 A → BC | a 形式，是 CYK 的前置。
summary.en: Convert a CFG to Chomsky Normal Form (A → BC | a), a precondition for CYK.

summary.zh: 编译期对全由常量组成的子表达式求值，替换为字面量节点。
summary.en: Evaluate sub-expressions made entirely of constants at compile time and replace them with literal nodes.

summary.zh: 逐块输入、跨块保留状态地解析 CSV（支持引号、换行）。
summary.en: Parse CSV incrementally across chunks, handling quotes and embedded newlines.

summary.zh: 删除对程序结果无影响的语句：不可达代码与未使用定义。
summary.en: Remove statements that cannot affect program output: unreachable code and unused definitions.

summary.zh: Hopcroft 算法把 DFA 划分到等价类，得到状态数最少的等价 DFA。
summary.en: Partition a DFA into equivalence classes to get the minimal equivalent DFA.

summary.zh: 在 BNF 基础上加入 () 分组、[] 可选、{} 或 * 重复、+ 至少一次等便捷算子。
summary.en: Extends BNF with () grouping, [] optionality, {}/* repetition, + one-or-more operators.

summary.zh: 遇错时跳过 token 直到同步点，尽量继续解析以报告更多错误。
summary.en: Skip tokens to a synchronizing set on error and resume parsing.

summary.zh: 不动点迭代求每个非终结符可推出的首终结符集（含 ε）。
summary.en: Fixpoint iteration for the leading-terminal set (including ε) of every non-terminal.

summary.zh: 不动点迭代求每个非终结符在某个句型中可紧随的终结符集。
summary.en: Fixpoint iteration for the terminal set that may immediately follow each non-terminal.

summary.zh: 启发式检测文法歧义（共享 FIRST 集 / 同时左右递归）。
summary.en: Heuristically flag patterns that often cause ambiguity.

summary.zh: 找出文法中可达与不可达非终结符，便于裁剪无用产生式。
summary.en: Find reachable vs unreachable non-terminals to prune useless productions.

summary.zh: 用路径表达式查询嵌套 JSON 数据。
summary.en: Query nested JSON with path expressions like $.a.b[0].c.

summary.zh: 把 LR(1) 项目集中「同心」（LR(0) 核相同）的状态合并，压缩成 LALR(1) 自动机。
summary.en: Merge LR(1) item-set states sharing the same LR(0) core to obtain the compact LALR(1) automaton.

summary.zh: 把共享前缀的产生式拆为公共前缀 + 新非终结符。
summary.en: Split alternatives sharing a common prefix into prefix plus a new non-terminal.

summary.zh: 把直接左递归文法改写为等价的右递归形式，便于自顶向下解析。
summary.en: Rewrite a directly left-recursive grammar into an equivalent right-recursive form.

summary.zh: 支持状态切换的词法分析器：不同上下文使用不同规则集。
summary.en: A lexer that switches rule sets based on a current state.

summary.zh: 由 FIRST/FOLLOW 集生成 M[非终结符][终结符] = 产生式的预测分析表。
summary.en: Build the predictive M[nonterminal][terminal] = production table from FIRST/FOLLOW sets.

summary.zh: 输出依附于转移的有限状态机。
summary.en: FSM whose output depends on the current transition, not the state.

summary.zh: 输出依附于状态的有限状态机。
summary.en: FSM whose output is a function of state only.

summary.zh: 允许 ε 转移的非确定有限自动机，用 ε-闭包 + 子集构造跑输入。
summary.en: Nondeterministic finite automaton with epsilon-moves, run via epsilon-closure.

summary.zh: 带栈的有限自动机，识别上下文无关语言。
summary.en: A finite automaton augmented with a stack; recognizes context-free languages.

summary.zh: 在目标/中间代码的小窗口内做局部模式替换：冗余 load/store、代数恒等、强度削减。
summary.en: Local pattern replacement within a small sliding window of target/IR: redundant load/store, algebraic identities, strength reduction.

summary.zh: 每条产生式的预测集：FIRST(α) 并（若 α 可空则 FOLLOW(A)）。
summary.en: Per-production predict set: FIRST(α) unioned with FOLLOW(A) when α is nullable.

title.zh: 正则表达式 AST 构建

summary.zh: 递归下降解析正则字符串为抽象语法树（连接/选择/星/加/问/字面）。
summary.en: Recursive-descent parse of a regex string into an AST (concat / alt / star / plus / opt / literal).

summary.zh: 用叉积 DFA + DFS 检查两个自动机是否语言相同。
summary.en: Build the product automaton and DFS to check two DFAs accept the same language.

summary.zh: 用 Moore 划分迭代法把 DFA 合并等价状态到最少。
summary.en: Iteratively partition DFA states with Moore algorithm to collapse equivalent states.

summary.zh: 在 AST 层面对正则做代数化简：扁平化、消去空、合并冗余字符。
summary.en: Algebraically simplify a regex AST: flatten nested nodes, eliminate ε, merge redundant chars.

summary.zh: 把正则表达式编译成 ε-NFA。
summary.en: Compile a regular expression to an epsilon-NFA with linear states.

summary.zh: 用调度场把正则（含 | * ·）转为后缀，便于 Thompson 构造。
summary.en: Insert explicit concat then run shunting yard to get postfix.

summary.zh: 用栈对后缀表达式求值：遇操作数入栈，遇运算符弹栈计算。
summary.en: Evaluate a postfix (RPN) expression with a stack.

summary.zh: 用嵌套作用域链表实现「内层屏蔽外层」的名字查找（词法作用域）。
summary.en: Linked nested scopes implementing lexical lookup where inner declarations shadow outer ones.

summary.zh: 在 LR(0) 项目集规范族 + SLR FOLLOW 集上检测 shift/reduce 与 reduce/reduce 冲突。
summary.en: Detect shift/reduce and reduce/reduce conflicts on the LR(0) automaton with SLR FOLLOW sets.

summary.zh: 对字符串所有后缀排序得到索引数组，是字符串处理基础结构。
summary.en: Sort all suffixes to get an index array; foundational for string algorithms.

summary.zh: 用哈希表登记变量/函数的声明信息，支持插入、查找、重复定义检测。
summary.en: A hash table recording variable/function declarations, with insert, lookup, and redefinition checks.

summary.zh: 用双向纸带 + 有限状态控制模拟图灵机，识别递归可枚举语言。
summary.en: Simulate a Turing machine: bidirectional tape + finite control.

summary.zh: 自底向上为表达式 AST 推导类型，并报告不兼容运算。
summary.en: Bottom-up infer types for an expression AST and report incompatible operations.

summary.zh: 解析器组合子把「小解析器」用高阶函数（seq / choice / many / map）组合成「大解析器」，每个组合子是返回 (结果,新位置) 或失败的纯函数。
summary.en: Parser combinators build large parsers from small ones via higher-order functions (seq / choice / many / map); each combinator is a pure function returning (result, newPos) or failure.

complexity.time: O(n) 线性 / 回溯指数

title.zh: PEG 表达式解析器（文法串编译）

summary.zh: PEG 表达式解析器把 PEG 文法源码字符串（如 Expr <- Term ("+" Term)*）解析为表达式树，再递归求值做匹配。
summary.en: A PEG expression parser parses a PEG grammar source string (e.g. Expr <- Term ("+" Term)*) into an expression tree, then evaluates it recursively to perform matching.

summary.zh: 用左/右结合力表驱动表达式解析，简洁处理优先级与结合性。
summary.en: Driven by left/right binding-power tables, it handles precedence and associativity concisely.

summary.zh: 递归下降解析属于parsing类别。
summary.en: Recursive Descent Parser is a parsing algorithm.

summary.zh: 把 ε-NFA 的状态集合作为 DFA 单一状态，子集构造 + ε-闭包消去非确定性。
summary.en: Treat each set of ε-NFA states as a single DFA state; subset construction plus ε-closure removes nondeterminism.

summary.zh: Thompson 构造：把正则（拼接/选择/星号）转为等价的 ε-NFA。
summary.en: Thompson construction: convert a regex (concat / alternation / star) to an equivalent ε-NFA.

summary.zh: 调度场算法属于parsing类别。
summary.en: Shunting Yard is a parsing algorithm.

summary.zh: LR(0) 项目集 + FOLLOW 集消解冲突：自底向上、表驱动。
summary.en: LR(0) item sets plus FOLLOW sets to resolve conflicts; bottom-up and table-driven.

summary.zh: 用确定有限自动机逐字符扫描，把源码切成记号流。
summary.en: Scan source character-by-character with a DFA to produce a token stream.

summary.zh: 逐行解析 TOML 子集：节、键值对（字符串/整数/布尔/数组）。
summary.en: Line-based parser for a TOML subset: sections, key/value (string/int/bool/array).

summary.zh: tree-sitter 风格增量解析器在编辑后只重解析受影响区间的子树，并自带错误恢复（遇错不中断、用通配节点收集意外 token）。
summary.en: A tree-sitter-style incremental parser re-parses only the subtrees in edited ranges after a change, and performs error recovery (continues on error, collecting unexpected tokens into wildcard nodes).

summary.zh: 解析 URL 为协议/认证/主机/端口/路径/查询参数/锚点。
summary.en: Parse a URL into scheme/auth/host/port/path/query/fragment.

summary.zh: 事件驱动 SAX 风格：逐标签触发 start/text/end 事件，不建树。
summary.en: Event-driven SAX style: emit start/text/end events per tag without building a tree.

title.zh: Yacc 风格解析器（动作表驱动）

summary.zh: Yacc 风格解析器由 LALR(1) 动作表（ACTION/GOTO）驱动移进-归约，并在每条归约规则上挂载语义动作（$$ = $1 op $2）计算属性值。
summary.en: A Yacc-style parser is driven by an LALR(1) action table (ACTION/GOTO) performing shift-reduce, with a semantic action attached to each reduction rule ($$ = $1 op $2) to compute attribute values.

summary.zh: Linux CFS：按虚拟运行时间（vruntime）最小者调度，红黑树维护就绪队列。
summary.en: Linux CFS: schedule the task with the smallest virtual runtime (vruntime); ready queue held in a red-black tree.

summary.zh: 静态优先级：相对截止期越短优先级越高（截止期可与周期不同）。
summary.en: Static priority: shorter relative deadline = higher priority (deadline may differ from period).

summary.zh: 为每个流维护赤字计数器，累加量子直到够发队首包。
summary.en: Each flow keeps a deficit counter incremented by a quantum until it can send the head packet.

summary.zh: 实时抢占式调度：每个时刻运行绝对截止期最早的就绪作业，利用率 100% 可调度。
summary.en: Preemptive real-time scheduling: at each instant run the ready job with the earliest absolute deadline; 100% utilization is schedulable.

summary.zh: 按用户/组分配 CPU 份额，避免某用户多进程独占。
summary.en: Allocate CPU shares per user/group so one user with many processes cannot dominate.

summary.zh: 最简单的非抢占式调度：按到达顺序依次执行，先到先得。
summary.en: Simplest non-preemptive policy: run jobs in arrival order, first come first served.

summary.zh: 承诺每个进程至少获得 1/n 的 CPU；按实际/应得比最低者优先。
summary.en: Promise each process at least 1/n of CPU; run the process with lowest actual/entitled ratio.

summary.zh: 非抢占式调度：每次选响应比 (wait+burst)/burst 最高的作业，兼顾短作业与防饥饿。
summary.en: Non-preemptive policy: pick the job with the highest response ratio (wait+burst)/burst, balancing short jobs and starvation avoidance.

summary.zh: 贪心选最早结束的不相交区间，最大化可选活动数。
summary.en: Greedy pick the earliest-finishing non-overlapping interval to maximize the number of activities.

title.zh: 带截止期限的作业排序（贪心）

summary.zh: 每作业有利润与截止期，单位时间作业，贪心选最大利润可行调度。
summary.en: Each job has profit and deadline, unit-time each; greedily pick max-profit feasible schedule.

summary.zh: 动态优先级：每步重算 laxity = D − 剩余执行 − 时间，选最小者。
summary.en: Dynamic priority: each tick recompute laxity = D − remaining − time and run the smallest.

summary.zh: 概率性调度：每进程持彩票数正比于优先级，每轮随机抽取决定运行者。
summary.en: Probabilistic scheduling: each process holds tickets proportional to its priority; a random draw each round picks the runner.

summary.zh: 把固定总容量公平分给有上界需求的多方：让最小份额尽可能大。
summary.en: Allocate fixed capacity to bounded-demand parties so the smallest share is as large as possible.

summary.zh: 进程可在队列间迁移：用完时间片降级，I/O 促留高优先级，兼顾响应与吞吐。
summary.en: Processes migrate between queues: demoted when they exhaust their quantum, kept high for I/O; balances responsiveness and throughput.

summary.zh: 按截止时间排序依次调度，超时就剔除最长作业，最小化延迟作业数。
summary.en: Sort by deadline and schedule in order; when late, drop the longest job — minimizes the number of late jobs.

summary.zh: 进程按类型分入固定优先级队列，队列间用固定优先级抢占调度。
summary.en: Processes are placed into fixed-priority queues by type; queues are scheduled by fixed priority with preemption.

summary.zh: 优先级调度属于scheduling类别。
summary.en: Priority Scheduling is a scheduling algorithm.

summary.zh: 实时周期任务静态优先级调度：周期越短优先级越高，利用率须满足 Liu-Layland 上界。
summary.en: Static-priority real-time scheduling for periodic tasks: shorter period means higher priority; utilization must satisfy the Liu-Layland bound.

summary.zh: 轮转调度属于scheduling类别。
summary.en: Round Robin is a scheduling algorithm.

summary.zh: 等待越久优先级越高，防止饥饿。
summary.en: Priority increases with wait time, prevents starvation.

summary.zh: 按到达时间升序调度（同 FCFS 但显式排序）。
summary.en: Schedule by ascending arrival time.

summary.zh: 按提交顺序无切换执行批处理作业。
summary.en: Run batch jobs in submission order, no switches.

summary.zh: 按 vruntime 最小选择，模拟 Linux CFS。
summary.en: Pick min vruntime, simulating Linux CFS.

summary.zh: CFS虚拟运行时调度v2。
summary.en: CFS VRuntime Scheduling v2.

summary.zh: 统计调度段中的上下文切换次数。
summary.en: Count context switches in schedule segments.

summary.zh: 把交互进程成组绑定到同一时间窗，减少同步等待。
summary.en: Bind interacting processes into the same scheduling window to reduce sync latency.

summary.zh: 从调度结果计算 CPU 利用率。
summary.en: Compute CPU utilization from schedule result.

summary.zh: 静态表驱动：把周期任务安排到固定小循环（帧）中循环执行，时序完全确定。
summary.en: Static table-driven: periodic tasks are laid out into fixed minor frames that repeat, giving fully deterministic timing.

summary.zh: 相对截止时间短者优先（静态）。
summary.en: Shorter relative deadline = higher priority (static).

title.zh: 截止单调响应时间分析

summary.zh: DM 的精确可调度性：按相对截止期升序定优先级，迭代求响应时间 R 与 D 比较。
summary.en: Exact schedulability for DM: priority by relative deadline ascending; iterate response time R and compare to D.

summary.zh: 实时调度：选截止时间最早的进程。
summary.en: Real-time: pick process with earliest deadline.

summary.zh: 最早截止期优先v2。
summary.en: EDF Scheduling v2.

summary.zh: 公平队列v2。
summary.en: Fair Queue v2.

summary.zh: 按份额反比设定步幅，每轮选 pass 值最小的进程，长期精确按权重分配 CPU。
summary.en: Set stride inversely proportional to weight; pick the min-pass process each round to allocate CPU in exact proportion.

summary.zh: FCFS 加上进程切换固定开销。
summary.en: FCFS with fixed context-switch overhead.

summary.zh: 多级优先级队列，进程用完时间片降级，I/O 阻塞不降级，兼顾响应与公平。
summary.en: Multiple priority queues; a process using up its quantum is demoted while I/O-blocked ones stay, balancing response and fairness.

summary.zh: 相关线程作为一个整体同时调度到多核，避免忙等。
summary.en: Schedule related threads as a group across cores simultaneously to avoid busy-waiting.

summary.zh: 从段列表构建文本甘特图。
summary.en: Build text Gantt chart from segments.

summary.zh: 长作业优先分配到当前最闲的机器。
summary.en: Assign longest job to least-loaded machine (LPT).

summary.zh: 按用户/组均分 CPU 时间。
summary.en: Distribute CPU time fairly across users/groups.

title.zh: 抢占式最高响应比优先

summary.zh: HRRN 的抢占式变体：每次有新进程到达时重算响应比，可抢占当前运行进程。
summary.en: Preemptive variant of HRRN: recompute response ratios on every arrival and preempt the running process.

summary.zh: 非抢占选最高优先级，同优先级 FCFS。
summary.en: Non-preemptive, highest priority, FCFS tie.

summary.zh: 响应比 = (等待+burst)/burst，选最大。
summary.en: Response ratio = (wait+burst)/burst, pick max.

summary.zh: 从甘特段中找出所有 CPU 空闲区间。
summary.en: Find all CPU idle intervals from Gantt segments.

summary.zh: 短量子保持响应性，适用于交互系统。
summary.en: Short quantum for responsiveness in interactive systems.

summary.zh: I/O 密集（短 CPU 段）的进程优先。
summary.en: Favor I/O-bound (short CPU burst) processes.

summary.zh: 维护作业池，按策略函数选下一个。
summary.en: Maintain job pool, pick next via policy function.

summary.zh: 按应得份额与已得份额之差最大者优先调度，逼近目标配额。
summary.en: Schedule the process whose (entitled − received) gap is largest, converging to target quotas.

summary.zh: 后到达的进程先执行（栈式）。
summary.en: Last-arrived process runs first (stack).

summary.zh: 实时调度：选松弛度最小的进程。
summary.en: Real-time: pick process with least laxity.

summary.zh: 最低松弛度优先v2。
summary.en: LLF Scheduling v2.

summary.zh: 按彩票数概率抽签选进程。
summary.en: Probabilistically pick process by ticket count.

summary.zh: 彩票调度v2。
summary.en: Lottery Scheduling v2.

summary.zh: 从甘特段计算等待/周转/响应时间。
summary.en: Compute wait/turnaround/response from Gantt segments.

summary.zh: 反馈式变体：根据进程近期 CPU 使用行为动态调整其时间片大小。
summary.en: Feedback variant: dynamically tune each process quantum based on its recent CPU-usage behavior.

summary.zh: LPT 贪心：任务按耗时降序，每次分给当前负载最小的核。
summary.en: LPT greedy: sort tasks descending by duration, assign each to the least-loaded core.

complexity.time: O(n log n + n log p)

summary.zh: 把 FCFS 队列分发到多个核心。
summary.en: Distribute FCFS queue across multiple cores.

summary.zh: 多级队列，降级运行过久的进程。
summary.en: Multi queues with demotion for long-running processes.

summary.zh: 多个优先级队列，进程从高优先级开始，用尽时间片后降级，兼顾响应时间和吞吐量。
summary.en: Multiple priority queues; processes start high and demote after using up their quantum, balancing responsiveness and throughput.

summary.zh: 按类型分到不同队列，固定优先级调度。
summary.en: Categorize into queues, fixed-priority scheduling.

summary.zh: 检查周期任务集是否可调度（RMS 利用率上界）。
summary.en: Check schedulability via RMS utilization bound.

summary.zh: 任务有先序约束，按拓扑序调度。
summary.en: Schedule tasks with precedence via topological order.

summary.zh: 每资源预设天花板（所有可能用者的最高优先级），持有时立即升至此优先级，杜绝死锁与反转。
summary.en: Each resource has a precomputed ceiling (highest priority of all potential users); a holder is instantly raised to it, preventing deadlock and inversion.

summary.zh: 运行后降低优先级，防止独占。
summary.en: Demote priority after running, prevent monopoly.

summary.zh: 低优先级持锁者临时继承等待者的高优先级。
summary.en: Lock holder temporarily inherits waiter priority.

summary.zh: 非抢占式优先级调度（数字小优先级高）。
summary.en: Non-preemptive priority scheduling (smaller = higher).

summary.zh: 高优先级进程到达时抢占当前。
summary.en: Preempt when higher-priority process arrives.

summary.zh: 每次选当前已到达中优先级最高（数值最小）的进程运行，新进程可抢占。
summary.en: Always run the highest-priority (lowest number) arrived process; a new arrival can preempt the running one.

summary.zh: 线程倾向在原核运行以利用缓存，迁移仅在失衡时发生。
summary.en: Threads prefer their home core for cache locality; migration only on imbalance.

summary.zh: 枚举量子大小找使平均等待最小的值。
summary.en: Search quantum size minimizing avg wait.

summary.zh: 周期任务，周期短者优先（静态优先级）。
summary.en: Periodic tasks, shorter period = higher priority (static).

title.zh: 速率单调响应时间分析 (RTA)

summary.zh: RMS 精确可调度性测试：迭代求响应时间 R = C + Σ⌈R/T⌉·C，与 D 比较。
summary.en: Exact schedulability test for RMS: iteratively compute response time R = C + Σ⌈R/T⌉·C and compare to D.

summary.zh: 速率单调调度v3。
summary.en: Rate Monotonic v3.

title.zh: 周期任务最早截止期优先

summary.zh: 实时周期任务的 EDF：每周期作业的截止期 = 释放 + D，按最近绝对截止期抢占式调度。
summary.en: EDF for periodic real-time tasks: each jobs deadline = release + D; preemptively schedule by nearest absolute deadline.

summary.zh: 计算各进程在某时刻的响应比。
summary.en: Compute response ratio of each process at a time.

summary.zh: 每个进程分配固定时间片，轮流执行。
summary.en: Each process gets a fixed quantum, taking turns.

summary.zh: 每个进程按时间片轮转执行；可对不同进程或优先级使用不同长度的时间片。
summary.en: Each process runs in turn for a time slice; different quantum lengths may be used per process or priority.

summary.zh: RR 变体：新到达进程排队尾等待「老」进程接纳，接纳后进入轮转池。
summary.en: RR variant: newly arrived processes wait in a holding queue until accepted by the active pool.

summary.zh: 公平份额思想：每次选累计已获得 CPU 时间最少的进程运行一个时间片。
summary.en: Fair-share idea: each round pick the process with the least accumulated CPU time and run it for one slice.

summary.zh: 非抢占式：从就绪进程中选估计执行时间最短者运行，降低平均等待。
summary.en: Non-preemptive: among ready processes pick the one with the shortest estimated run time, lowering average wait.

summary.zh: 用历史估计下次 burst（指数平滑）。
summary.en: Estimate next burst via exponential averaging.

summary.zh: 非抢占式最短作业优先调度。
summary.en: Non-preemptive shortest job first.

summary.zh: 新进程到达且 burst 更短时抢占。
summary.en: Preempt when new arrival has shorter burst.

summary.zh: 每进程执行完才切换的简化版。
summary.en: Simplified version that switches only on completion.

summary.zh: 抢占式 SJF，每次选剩余时间最短。
summary.en: Preemptive SJF: pick min remaining time each tick.

summary.zh: 步幅调度v2。
summary.en: Stride Scheduling v2.

summary.zh: 单位时间完成的进程数。
summary.en: Number of processes completed per unit time.

summary.zh: 把周期固定为等长时间槽，每槽分配一个任务，剩余 slack 留给偶发任务。
summary.en: Divide the period into equal time slots, assign one task per slot, and leave slack for sporadic jobs.

summary.zh: 从完成时间和到达时间算周转。
summary.en: Compute turnaround from finish and arrival.

summary.zh: I/O 阻塞进程进入更高优先级队列。
summary.en: I/O-blocked processes get a higher-priority queue.

summary.zh: 从周转和 burst 算等待时间。
summary.en: Compute wait time from turnaround and burst.

summary.zh: 按权重分配 CPU 比例。
summary.en: Allocate CPU proportionally by weight.

summary.zh: 最短作业优先属于scheduling类别。
summary.en: Shortest Job First is a scheduling algorithm.

title.zh: 最短处理时间（非抢占 SPT）

summary.zh: 非抢占式：CPU 空闲时选就绪队列中处理时间最短的作业运行。
summary.en: Non-preemptive: when idle, pick the ready job with the shortest processing time.

summary.zh: 单机带权总完工：按 wj/pj 降序（WSPT）调度最优。
summary.en: Single-machine weighted completion: order by wj/pj descending (WSPT) is optimal.

summary.zh: SJF 的抢占式版本：每当新进程到达且剩余更短时立即抢占当前运行进程。
summary.en: Preemptive variant of SJF: preempt the running process when a newly arrived job has shorter remaining time.

summary.zh: 按权重反比分配：每进程有 stride=K/weight，每次选 passes 最小者运行并累加。
summary.en: Distribute CPU inversely to weight: each task has stride=K/weight; always run the task with smallest passes and advance it.

summary.zh: 为每个流按权重计算虚拟完成时间，按其升序服务。
summary.en: Compute a virtual finish time per flow by weight and serve in ascending order.

summary.zh: 用一个大整数 x 编码整条符号流，单符号概率近似熵。
summary.en: Encodes a whole symbol stream into one large integer x with near-entropy per-symbol rates.

summary.zh: 算术编码属于compression类别。
summary.en: Arithmetic Coding is a compression algorithm.

summary.zh: 借助静态字典把高频子串替换成引用。
summary.en: Replaces frequent substrings with references to a static dictionary.

summary.zh: BWT变换属于compression类别。
summary.en: Burrows-Wheeler Transform is a compression algorithm.

summary.zh: IBM 842 硬件加速格式：固定模板检测 + 短回引，面向高吞吐。
summary.en: IBM 842 hardware-accelerated format: fixed-template detection plus short back-references, tuned for throughput.

summary.zh: ANS 综合：演示 rANS/tANS 的统一状态机模型。
summary.en: ANS overview: demonstrate the unified state-machine model behind rANS/tANS.

title.zh: 上下文自适应算术编码

summary.zh: 依上下文动态调整概率的算术编码。
summary.en: Arithmetic coding with context-driven probability.

summary.zh: 算术编码：用 [low, high) 区间表示整个消息，分数位编码。
summary.en: Arithmetic coding: a [low, high) interval represents the whole message; fractional bits.

summary.zh: 对 0/1 序列做算术编码。
summary.en: Arithmetic coding over bit sequences.

summary.zh: 用整数区间 [lo, hi) 替代浮点，逐符号缩放并按需 renormalize 输出比特。
summary.en: Use integer intervals [lo, hi) instead of floats, scaling per symbol with renormalization to emit bits.

summary.zh: 6-bit 一组的二进制到文本编码。
summary.en: 6-bit binary-to-text encoding.

summary.zh: 5 字节编为 5 个 85 进制字符。
summary.en: 5 bytes to 5 base-85 chars.
